jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** We are seeking a dynamic and innovative AI Engineer to join our forward\-thinking technology team. In this role, you will leverage cutting\-edge machine learning frameworks, statistical modeling, and big data systems to develop, evaluate, and deploy advanced AI models. Your expertise will drive the creation of scalable AI solutions that transform complex data into actionable insights, enabling smarter decision\-making across various business functions. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work with state\-of\-the\-art cloud services, natural language processing, generative AI, and large\-scale data analytics to shape the future of intelligent systems. **Duties** * Design, develop, and implement machine learning and AI models using frameworks such as TensorFlow and other machine learning tools. * Conduct statistical analysis and modeling to support research initiatives and predictive analytics projects. * Build and optimize big data systems utilizing Hadoop, Spark, and ETL processes for efficient data ingestion and processing. * Develop scalable AI solutions leveraging cloud\-based machine learning services on platforms like AWS. * Collaborate with data engineers to design robust database architectures and SQL databases for storing and retrieving large datasets. * Evaluate model performance through rigorous testing, validation, and deployment strategies to ensure accuracy and scalability. * Implement natural language processing techniques for applications involving text analysis, chatbots, or language understanding. * Utilize statistical analysis tools such as SAS or R to extract insights from complex datasets for research purposes. * Integrate AI models into production environments ensuring seamless deployment, monitoring, and maintenance. * Engage in data mining activities using Talend or similar tools to uncover hidden patterns that inform strategic decisions. **Skills** * Proficiency in programming languages including Python, Java, C, VBA, Bash (Unix shell), with a focus on AI/ML development. * Extensive experience with machine learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, Spark MLlib, and other related tools. * Strong knowledge of big data systems including Hadoop ecosystems and Spark implementation for large\-scale data processing. * Hands\-on experience with cloud\-based machine learning services on AWS or similar platforms for scalable AI solutions. * Expertise in statistical modeling techniques and statistical analysis tools like SAS or R for research\-driven insights. * Familiarity with database design principles and SQL databases for efficient data storage and retrieval. * Knowledge of natural language processing (NLP) techniques for language understanding applications. * Experience in model training, evaluation, deployment, and ongoing monitoring within production environments. * Ability to work with unstructured data sources such as linked data or generative AI models for innovative applications. * Skills in data analytics, data mining using Talend or comparable tools to support comprehensive analysis efforts. Join us to be at the forefront of artificial intelligence innovation! Your expertise will help shape intelligent systems that empower businesses through scalable solutions driven by advanced analytics and machine learning techniques—making a real impact every day! Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Relocation assistance Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94107

jobs.title: Beverage Plant Equipment Maintenance Technician
jobs.description: **Keep the lines running—power a brand millions trust** ------------------------------------------------------- At Union Beverage Packers, LLC, our maintenance team is the engine behind safe, consistent production. If you’re driven to eliminate downtime, elevate bottle quality, and build a culture of safety and **GMP** excellence, this role is your next step. ### **Why this role matters** Every minute our blow molders, fillers, conveyors, and palletizers operate at peak performance, we deliver for customers and teammates. You’ll collaborate with Production, Quality Control, Sanitation, contractors, and OEMs to keep equipment reliable, changeovers crisp, and start\-ups smooth. ### **Schedule and employment** * **Pay:** $25\.00–$45\.00 per hour, based on experience * **Schedule:** All shifts are open; our largest need is on **3rd shift** * **Hours:** Minimum 48 hours per week * **Job Type:** Full\-time * **Overtime:** Required as needed * **Work Location:** In person We’re staffing across shifts and actively prioritizing strong 3rd shift candidates. ### **Your core responsibilities** * Own scheduled/unscheduled maintenance for production equipment and plant machinery. * Diagnose and repair issues across mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and refrigeration. * Execute preventive and corrective maintenance to extend asset life. * Reduce downtime through fast, accurate troubleshooting and repair. * Support installations, modifications, commissioning, and changeovers. * Read and apply mechanical drawings, schematics, manuals, and technical references. * Conduct daily inspections; promptly communicate major findings to Maintenance leadership. * Provide hands\-on support for blow molders, fillers, conveyors, palletizers, and packaging systems. * Open/close work orders and maintain precise records of work performed. * Respond effectively during breakdowns and high\-pressure scenarios. * Model safety, **GMP**, food safety, quality, sanitation, and company policies. * Keep the work environment clean, organized, and safe. ### **Specialized Sidel impact (if you have it)** * Operate, monitor, adjust, and troubleshoot **Sidel blow molding equipment**. * Lead changeovers, start\-ups, fine\-tuning, and major mechanical interventions. * Maintain platforms like **SBO, Matrix, Universal, Series 2**, or similar lines. * Resolve mechanical/pneumatic/hydraulic and basic electrical issues on Sidel machines. * Partner with QC to verify bottle conformance to standards. * Advance bottle quality initiatives, process improvements, and downtime reduction. * Clean, sanitize, and maintain blow molding and adjacent production equipment. ### **What you bring** * High school diploma or equivalent. * Industrial maintenance or related mechanical/manufacturing equipment background. * Sharp troubleshooting skills and a bias for action. * Independence and urgency when equipment issues arise. * Ability to commit to at least 48 hours per week and work overtime/weekends/holidays as needed. * Safe work habits around moving production machinery. * Physical capability to stand, walk, bend, kneel, climb, push, and pull. * Lift at least 50 pounds. * Comfort with warm, loud, wet, fast‑paced environments. * Willingness to wear all required PPE. ### **Experience that sets you apart** * Direct work on **Sidel blow molding equipment**. * Time in beverage, bottled water, soft drink, food manufacturing, plastics, PET packaging, or bottling. * Hands‑on with fillers, conveyors, palletizers, blow molders, and packaging machinery. * Skills in electrical, welding, plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, or equipment installation. * Familiarity with PLCs and automated production systems. * Track record of major rebuilds or equipment overhauls. * Experience as a Sidel Field Service Engineer or Service Technician. * Forklift/equipment certifications. * Basic computer literacy for work orders and maintenance documentation. ### **Physical and safety expectations** * Lift up to 50 pounds regularly; use assistance/equipment for heavier items. * Stand and walk for long durations. * Bend, reach, kneel, climb, push, and pull as part of daily work. * Operate near moving equipment; work in wet, noisy, and hot areas. * Follow all safety procedures and PPE requirements. ### **Compensation and benefits** * Competitive pay from **$25\.00 to $40\.00 per hour** * Overtime opportunities * Medical insurance * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Paid holidays * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Training and growth opportunities Benefits may be subject to eligibility requirements. ### **Ready to apply? Please answer:** Which shift are you available to work? Are you able to work at least 48 hours per week and overtime when required? How many years of industrial maintenance experience do you have? What production or manufacturing equipment have you repaired? Do you have beverage, bottling, food manufacturing, plastics, or packaging experience? Have you worked on Sidel blow molding equipment? Which Sidel models have you worked on? Can you troubleshoot mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and basic electrical problems? What major machine repairs or equipment overhauls have you completed? Are you comfortable working in a fast\-paced beverage manufacturing environment? **Equal Opportunity Employer** Union Beverage Packers, LLC is an **Equal Opportunity Employer**. We are committed to providing a safe, respectful, and professional workplace for all employees. ### **Skills snapshot** * Creating Preventive Maintenance Plans * Mechanical Troubleshooting Skills * Electrical Troubleshooting * Electrical Repair * Pneumatics Troubleshooting * Maintenance and Repair Skills * CNC Machine Setup \& Changeover * Industrial Electrical Systems * Mechanical Systems \& Component Repair * DOT \& Equipment Inspection Compliance * Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) * Equipment Repair \& Maintenance * Automotive Manufacturing Systems * Automotive Repair \& Service Systems * Machine Safety Inspections

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description: **Chief Engineer** No one in the hotel understands a physical plant like you. You get to know each and every piece of equipment and corner of a building when you are the person in charge of it – all with a strong guest centric focus and understanding that a happy guest \= a strong bottom line. You are a department head with a team whose sole job is to keep the hotel systems running to optimal performance, serviced by your team of caring and well\-trained staff. In the role of **Chief Engineer**, you will * **Oversee all Aspects of Engineering** – as the Chief you manage the engineering department including hiring, training, scheduling, coaching, etc. of your staff. Your team must be able to professionally maintain the physical operation of the hotel including building structure, fixtures, refrigeration, heating, ventilation, air conditioning, plumbing, water treatment, electrical systems and grounds. It is your job to ensure a safe, secure, and comfortable guest environment from a physical plant perspective, as well as a positive guest and employee experience. * **Walk the Talk** – as the Chief you need to be walking around your hotel every day – getting out and inspecting the areas you are responsible for and training or retraining your team when things don’t meet expectations. You are responsible for protecting the asset for investors and owners. * **Be a Leader** \- create an environment that’s engaging and one where talented people want to join, learn, do their best, and advance. Lead a diverse, motivated team which is empowered and coached to deliver the ultimate guest experience. * **Be an Expense Guru** – set the standards, policies and procedures for your department and then monitor operational and financial performance. Actively participate in the budget process for both your department and any capital needs you may be asked to give input on (including managing any renovation bidding process and contractor oversight if required). Be proactive vs. reactive to ensure your department is accurately planning/forecasting for maintenance needs as well as staffing and supply levels so as to minimize expenses while delivering an exceptional guest experience. * **Be the Manager on Duty** – if requested. **Job Requirements** This role requires at least five years of progressive experience in a related field with previous supervisory experience required and customer service and hotel experience preferred. At least five years of practical experience in one or more of the technical trades (HVAC, refrigeration, plumbing, electrical) is also strongly preferred, as is any license the property may require. This position must have previous experience with budgeting as well as a good working knowledge of the various Microsoft software programs utilized at the hotel. The ability to work with and train the team on the various tools utilized in the department is also key. To be successful in this role, you must be able to read, write, and verbally communicate effectively and professionally in English with associates, guests, hotel management and – if required – ownership. Physical requirements include the ability to perform heavy work \- exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or 50 pounds of force frequently and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to lift, carry, push, pull, or otherwise move objects. The role also requires the ability to stand for long periods of time and walk long distances as well as the ability to bend, stretch, twist or reach with your body and arms and ability to work under variable temperatures and noise levels. You must have near vision \- the ability to see details at close range and must be able to climb stairs and descend stairs in a timely fashion without fatigue as well as the ability to move quickly and agilely if a situation requiring quick assistance arises. Long work hours are sometimes required. Work will be under variable temperature conditions and noise levels and will be both outdoors and indoors (including potentially on roofs). Work will also be around chemicals, fumes and/or odor hazards as well as around dust and/or mite hazards. Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description:** We're looking for a Data Engineer to design and maintain the data architecture that powers our business systems and analytics — and possess a working knowledge of AI\-powered applications as they become part of that landscape. You'll own how data is modeled, moved, and governed across the organization, and make sure that foundation is solid enough for both traditional reporting and modern AI\-driven tools to build on. This role sits at the center of a lot of cross\-functional work: you'll partner with application teams, business stakeholders, and vendors to make sure data is structured consistently, documented clearly, and trustworthy wherever it's used. **Responsibilities** Data architecture \& schema design * Design canonical, well\-documented data models for core business entities (customers, projects, products, contracts, finance, etc.) that multiple systems and teams can rely on as a single source of truth. * Evaluate and evolve schemas as the business and its systems grow — balancing new requirements against long\-term maintainability. * Establish and enforce data modeling standards, naming conventions, and documentation practices. Pipelines \& integration * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that move data reliably from source systems (ERP, CRM, operational databases, vendor feeds, files) into a cloud data warehouse. * Monitor data quality and pipeline health; troubleshoot and resolve data issues at the source rather than downstream. * Integrate new data sources — including third\-party platforms and vendor APIs — into the existing architecture without duplicating effort or creating conflicting versions of the same data. Data governance * Define and maintain data classification standards (e.g., what counts as sensitive financial, contractual, or customer data) and ensure those standards are applied consistently across systems. * Support access control and audit requirements by ensuring data lineage and usage are traceable. * Maintain a data dictionary and related documentation so other teams can find and trust the data they need. AI\-aware data engineering * Design data structures and access patterns with an understanding of how they'll be consumed — including by AI/LLM\-powered applications that rely on well\-scoped, accurate context rather than raw database access. * Apply minimum\-necessary\-data principles when structuring data that will be surfaced through AI features, in partnership with application and security teams. * Stay current enough on how retrieval\-augmented generation and LLM context assembly work to make informed schema and access decisions — this is a working\-knowledge requirement, not a machine learning role. Collaboration * Work with engineering, product, and business teams to translate reporting and application needs into sound data models. * Act as a technical resource and point of contact for data\-related questions across multiple concurrent projects. **Technical Skills** **Required** * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering or data architecture, including hands\-on schema/data model design in a production environment. * Strong SQL skills and experience with a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake and MSFT SQL Server preferred) * Experience SQL query language * Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines. * Solid understanding of data governance fundamentals: classification, access control, and documentation practices. * Working knowledge of how modern AI/LLM applications consume data — context windows, retrieval\-augmented generation, and the basics of why minimizing and scoping data matters for these systems. * Strong communication skills; comfortable being the person other teams come to for data questions. Preferred * Experience in a distribution, industrial supply, or ERP\-adjacent environment. * Familiarity with integrating third\-party SaaS platforms via API. * Experience with CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions) and cloud application environments (e.g., AWS). * Experience consolidating multiple existing data models into a shared standard. Nice to have * Exposure to BI/reporting tools (e.g., Power BI) and how they consume the underlying data model. * Working knowledge of Python **Company Statement:** PSS Industrial provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristics protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

jobs.title: Founding Agent Harness Engineer
jobs.description: **Founding Agent Systems Engineer** =================================== Location: Onsite in Palo Alto Compensation: Competitive Salary \+ Equity **About Peano AI** **Peano AI** is building the infrastructure and application stack for the next generation of agentic AI systems. We believe future AI applications will involve many agents working together: using tools, sharing context, evaluating their own behavior, modifying systems, and improving over time. On top of our Agent Cloud infrastructure, we are building an agentic system: an application layer that can continuously optimize models, codebases, workflows, and software systems. In the near term, this means building agent systems that help codebases evolve with minimal human supervision: cleaner abstractions, stronger tests, lower technical debt, faster iteration, and better engineering velocity. Over time, we believe the same approach can extend to cloud optimization, database optimization, enterprise workflows, and more general applications. **About This Role** We are looking for a Founding Agent Systems Engineer to build the agent harnesses, evaluation systems, workflows, and feedback loops behind our product. This role is ideal for someone who is strong in Python and systems engineering, understands LLM agents and evaluation, and enjoys turning research ideas into working products. You will work on the systems that allow agents to collaborate, inspect code, make changes, run tests, measure progress, and improve over time. This is a deeply technical and product\-oriented role at the intersection of LLM agents, evaluation, developer tools, workflow automation, and applied AI systems. **What You'll Do** * Build agent harnesses for multi\-agent workflows and ralph loops. * Design evaluation environments to measure agent performance, reliability, cost, latency, and quality. * Build testing systems that connect agent behavior, code changes, and evaluation results. * Create workflows where agents can inspect code, make changes, run tests, and determine whether performance improved. * Develop shared\-memory, coordination, and task\-management systems for teams of agents. * Build infrastructure for tracking task success, regressions, cost, latency, quality, and long\-term progress. * Work on applied coding\-agent workflows, including refactoring, testing, debugging, code review, and technical\-debt reduction. * Support customer demos and applied workflows that turn agent research into usable product experiences. * Collaborate closely with ML systems engineers to make agent workloads run efficiently on Agent Cloud. * Help turn research prototypes into reliable, measurable, production\-quality systems. **Qualifications** * Strong Python engineering skills. * Experience building LLM agents, evaluation harnesses, developer tools, applied AI systems, or automation workflows. * Strong systems instincts and the ability to build reliable, debuggable tooling. * Experience with testing, benchmarking, CI, code analysis, or automated software workflows. * Ability to reason about agent behavior, failure modes, evaluation quality, and product usefulness. * Comfort working across agent logic, backend systems, infrastructure, and user\-facing product requirements. * Strong product intuition and the ability to build demos that can evolve into real products. * High ownership and the ability to operate effectively in an early\-stage startup environment. **Nice to Have** * Coding agents, eval harnesses, SWE\-bench\-style environments, or tool\-use systems. * Multi\-agent or long\-running agent workflows. * LLM observability, tracing, evals, or RL workflows. * CI/CD, automated testing, static analysis, or developer tooling. **Cultural Fit** * Hands\-on technical excellence and strong engineering judgment. * End\-to\-end ownership, from design to implementation to production outcomes. * Bias for action: ship quickly, learn from failures, and iterate. * High intensity during critical milestones, with a focus on real customer impact. * Ability to do deep, focused work and sustain execution. * Clear communication with teammates, customers, and stakeholders. * Comfort with ambiguity, rapid change, and wearing multiple hats. * Low ego, high integrity, high accountability, and strong collaboration. * Continuous learning and a belief that judgment, intelligence, and capability compound over time. **If you are excited to build the agent systems behind the next generation of AI applications, create fully\-automated software workflows, and turn ambitious research ideas into real\-world impact, Peano AI is the place for you.**

jobs.title: Junior Database Developer
jobs.description: **About Peregrine** Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA. Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership. We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people. As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become. **People first. Ownership always.** We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation come before competence. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else. At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk. At Peregrine Advisors, you will build and maintain the queries, stored procedures, and views that make a federal agency's enterprise data platform useful. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are. This is a full\-time W\-2 position with a salary of $80,000 to $95,000 per year. It is a hybrid work arrangement based in the Washington, DC metropolitan area, and the commuting cadence varies by assignment. The initial engagement is expected to be one to two days a week on site in DC. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination. **Your first assignment** In your first assignment, a senior developer will guide you as you take on your assigned components. Depending on the assignment, you may: * Build and maintain Structured Query Language (SQL) queries, stored procedures, and views in Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible). * Work with data from Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\). * Contribute to logical data models and database\-design decisions within the established platform architecture, with reviews that explain what to change and why. * Build reliable data loads from S3, tune queries with guidance, and work within governed access. Over time, you will grow toward responsibility for physical design. The work is real and hard, and it matters. This first assignment is a starting point, not the shape of your career here. **Requirements** * 1\+ years of database development, software development, or comparable practical experience * Bachelor's degree * Working knowledge of SQL, stored procedures, and views on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible) * Familiarity with Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3\) * Query tuning with guidance from a senior developer * Exposure to extract, transform, and load (ETL) and extract, load, and transform (ELT) patterns and data integration across Amazon Web Services (AWS) data services * Awareness of data security controls, including encryption, access management, and auditing * Basic exposure to loading data from S3 into the platform stores and to Open Database Connectivity (ODBC) and Java Database Connectivity (JDBC) * Introductory familiarity with logical data modeling and the ability to contribute to database\-design decisions within an established platform architecture * Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel **Preferred** * An entry\-level AWS certification, such as Cloud Practitioner, or the interest in earning one * Exposure to query blocking, locking, and deadlocks * Interest in cloud\-native application support in AWS using continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) and development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) practices * Exposure to physical design, including Aurora and DynamoDB schema and index design, or the motivation to grow into it * Federal information technology or high\-volume transaction experience * Interest in artificial intelligence (AI)\-assisted developer tooling **Who you are** You care about getting data right and want a career in database development. You ask for help when you need it and put feedback to use quickly. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task. **What you bring** * A foundation in SQL and relational databases, with working knowledge of stored procedures and views on Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL\-compatible) and a desire to deepen it across DynamoDB and S3\. * Practical habits in query tuning, data loading, and connectivity, applied with guidance and improved on feedback. * Clear communication about what you have finished, what is blocking you, and where you need support. * Careful execution in work where accuracy and auditability are essential. **When we talk** Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned. **Benefits** Medical, dental, and vision with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer\-paid life, accidental death, and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance; a 401(k) matched 100% up to 4% of salary, vesting immediately; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education. **What we offer** You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments with onboarding, sponsored training, and professional development. **What we commit to** As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better. We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply. Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer. *Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.*

jobs.title: SRPS NETWORK SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATOR II
jobs.description: **Introduction** ---------------- The Maryland State Retirement Agency is the administrator of the Maryland State Retirement and Pension System (“System”). The System is a defined benefit retirement system covering State and local government employees of Maryland. It’s composed of twelve (12\) separate retirement and pension systems with over 50 different rule sets. The System has over 433,000 participants (customers), including 210,000 members who are actively employed and participating in the System, 179,000 payees who receive a monthly payment from the System, and 44,000 vested members who are no longer actively employed but have earned a benefit that will become payable at a future date. Located in Baltimore’s Central Business District, SRPS offers a purpose\-driven workplace with modern amenities, including panoramic city and harbor views, renovated common areas, upgraded elevators, and an on\-site café. Employees enjoy comprehensive state benefits including medical, dental, prescription coverage, generous paid leave, participation in the state pension system, and supplemental retirement savings options (401(k), 457(b), and more). Additional perks include an on\-site fitness center with showers and lockers, 24/7 building security, and easy access to restaurants, shops, public transit, and major highways. If you're seeking a career with impact, stability, and a supportive environment, explore opportunities with MSRPS. This position is designated as telework‑eligible (hybrid) under the State of Maryland’s Telework Policy, after successfully completing the defined required training period. **GRADE** --------- STD0019 **LOCATION OF POSITION** ------------------------ 120 East Baltimore Street Baltimore, Maryland 21202 **Main Purpose of Job** ----------------------- A State Retirement and Pension System (SRPS) Network Systems Administrator II is the full performance level of work responsible for installing, configuring, and maintaining enterprise hardware and software systems, in close support of business programs and administration and also day\-to\-day operation of Agency networks (e.g. LAN, WAN, wireless and VoIP) within the SRA Information Systems division. **POSITION DUTIES** ------------------- The Network Systems Administrator II’s responsibilities include, but are not limited to: **Network Infrastructure Management** * Participating in the design and support of the networks that keep the agency’s systems operational \- local and wide\-area networks. * Working with technology such as switches, routers, wireless access points, firewalls, load balancers, and other critical network infrastructure to ensure the networks are secure and reliable. * Keeping network documentation clear, up to date, and easy for the team to follow. **Server \& Systems Administration** * Deploying, configuring and managing enterprise servers and applications, including virtualized and containerized environments that power the agency’s line of business applications. * Supporting the end user computing environment, ensuring desktops and laptops are consistently maintained, secure, and ready for daily operations. * Monitoring systems health, installing updates, troubleshooting issues, and rolling out improvements that ensure system stability and performance. * Assisting with advanced workstation setups and helping to resolve complex technical challenges for end users. **Storage, Cloud, \& Backup Platform Maintenance** * Maintaining the agency’s storage, cloud services, and backup systems to protect data and ensure the agency is prepared for any recovery scenario. * Supporting key communication technologies like VoIP, call center systems, messaging platforms, and A/V setups across the agency. **Technology Integration \& Project Delivery** * Researching, evaluating and introducing new technologies to improve operational efficiency and innovation. * Leading or contributing to IT projects, working closely with cross functional teams to deliver successful outcomes. * Clearly communicating technical updates and project changes in a way that works for both technical and non\-technical audiences. **Policy, Security, \& Compliance Support** * Helping write, refine, and maintain IT policies, standards, and procedures that support a secure and well managed environment. * Strengthening agency’s security posture by implementing best practice controls and supporting compliance initiatives. * Playing a key role in disaster recovery planning, testing, and documentation to ensure business continuity. * Assisting in the development of user training materials. **Other Technical and Operational Support Duties** * Creating and maintaining strong internal security controls and identity management practices. * Tracking and documenting system configurations, equipment, and software assets across the enterprise. * Applying project management skills to plan and deliver technology solutions on schedule, coordinating with stakeholders and end users. * Assis e required to possess a motor vehicle operator’s license valid in the State of Maryland. **SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS** ------------------------ Employees in this classification may be subject to call\-in 24 hours a day and be required to work evenings, weekends, and holidays when systems are down or to work on systems that need to be repaired or replaced during non\-business hours and, therefore, may be required to provide the employing agency with a telephone number where the employee can be reached. Employees may be furnished with a pager or cell phone. Applicants for this classification may handle sensitive data. This will require a full scope background investigation prior to appointment. A criminal conviction may be grounds for rejection of the applicant. Employees may occasionally be required to travel to the main office during off hours, or field locations, and must have access to an automobile in the event a state vehicle cannot be provided. Standard mileage allowance will be paid for use of a privately owned vehicle. The work may require moving computers, printers and other IT related equipment weighing up to 80 pounds. **SELECTION PROCESS** --------------------- Please make sure that you provide sufficient information on your application to show that you meet the minimum for this recruitment. All information concerning your qualifications must be submitted by the closing date. We will not consider information submitted after this date. Successful candidates will be ranked as Best Qualified, Better Qualified, or Qualified and placed on the employment (eligible) list for at least one year. This list will be used by the hiring agency to select employees. For education obtained outside the U.S., a copy of the equivalent American education as determined by a foreign credential evaluation service must be provided prior to hire. Due to the confidential nature of the work, selected candidates must undergo and pass a background check. **EXAMINATION PROCESS** ----------------------- The examination will consist of a rating of your education, training, and experience as presented on your application and as they relate to the requirements of the position. You may be asked to complete a supplemental questionnaire. The supplemental questionnaire may be used as part of the rating process. Therefore, it is important that you provide complete and accurate information on your application. **BENEFITS** ------------ **STATE OF MARYLAND BENEFITS** As an employee of the State of Maryland, you will have access to outstanding benefits, including: health insurance, dental, and vision plans offered at a low cost. * Personal Leave \- new State employees are awarded six (6\) personnel days annually (prorated based on start date). * Annual Leave \- ten (10\) days of accumulated annual leave per year. * Sick Leave \- fifteen (15\) days of accumulated sick leave per year. * Holidays \- State employees also celebrate at least thirteen (13\) holidays per year. * Pension \- State employees earn credit towards a retirement pension. * Positions may be eligible for telework. **FURTHER INSTRUCTIONS** ------------------------ The online application process is STRONGLY preferred. If you are unable to apply online, you may mail a paper application and supplemental questionnaire to: Maryland State Retirement and Pension Systems Human Resources Section 120 E. Baltimore Street Baltimore, MD 21202 ATTN: Ashley Lohr Must be postmarked by the closing date. Email: alohr@sra.state.md.us **PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT UNSOLICITED DOCUMENTATION** The resulting certified eligible list for this recruitment may be used for similar positions in this or other State agencies. jobs.title: Senior Construction Estimator and Business Development Lead
jobs.description: **Senior Construction Estimator and Business Development Lead** **About DRI** DRI, Inc. is a construction general contractor built exclusively around federal work and is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB). Since 2017 we have primarily delivered construction for the Department of Veterans Affairs, the National Cemetery Administration, and the National Park Service. Our West Coast team is based in Medford, Oregon, and runs work across the region. We hold deep past performance across VISN 20, including Southern Oregon and Northern California, and we currently have active projects in Idaho and Washington. While our East Coast office and HQ is in Alabama, our West Coast team operates separately and under our company President. We carry bonding capacity well above what our size would suggest, and we self\-perform as a prime. No pass\-through, no broker model. When DRI wins, DRI builds. **LOCATION** Anywhere on the West Coast. Full time, remote capable, travel required. **The Job** We are hiring one person to own the front end of our West Coast business: find the work, price the work, win the work. This is a hunting seat. Today that function sits with our President, and it has taken the West Coast from a standing start to a portfolio of VA and NPS awards. We need someone to take it and run harder. The target is $10M to $20M in awarded contract value per year, in the $2M to $10M project range where our bonding and our SDVOSB status give us a real edge. You will not be handed a pipeline. You will build one, and you will build the vehicles that carry it. Single\-award task orders got DRI here. Getting to the next level means positioning on MATOCs, MACCs, and agency IDIQs where we compete inside a smaller pool for years at a time, and opening doors at federal agencies we do not serve today. **What You Will Do** **ESTIMATING** * Own conceptual through hard\-bid estimates on federal construction projects, $2M to $10M typical * Perform quantity takeoffs, develop cost models, and build competitive pricing that protects margin * Solicit, evaluate, and level subcontractor and supplier quotes * Walk the sites. Attend pre\-bid conferences and site visits in person * Lead bid strategy and participate in bid and no\-bid decisions with the leadership team **BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT AND CAPTURE** * Monitor SAM.gov, agency forecasts, and acquisition plans to identify targets before they hit the street * Identify, position for, and capture multiple\-award vehicles: MATOCs, MACCs, SATOCs, and agency IDIQs across VA, NPS, NCA, USACE, NAVFAC, GSA, and BLM * Build the capture plan for each vehicle: past performance mapping, gap analysis, teaming to fill what we cannot cover alone, and a sequenced timeline against the solicitation forecast * Manage on\-ramp opportunities and vehicle recompetes so we are never caught flat\-footed on a five\-year cycle * Expand DRI into new federal agencies and new geographies, taking us from a VA and NPS shop to a diversified federal prime * Lead the proposal function. Direct our proposal writer and outside proposal support, own compliance and win themes, and build out the team as volume grows * Build and hold relationships with contracting officers, CORs, facility engineers, and small business specialists * Represent DRI at SAME posts, industry days, matchmaking events, agency outreach, and regional conferences * Recruit and qualify subcontractors in every market we pursue, building the bench ahead of the work rather than after award * Identify and structure teaming agreements, mentor\-protege relationships, and joint ventures that extend our reach **What You Need** **REQUIRED** * Federal construction experience with a prime contractor. This is not negotiable. You have priced and pursued work under FAR Part 15 and Part 36, you understand SF 1442, and you know how a set\-aside procurement actually moves * A track record of awarded federal construction contracts you can point to by name and dollar value * Direct experience pursuing or performing under multiple\-award vehicles. You have written to an IDIQ solicitation, understand how seed projects and on\-ramps work, and know what it takes to stay competitive inside a pool once you are on it * Estimating capability across multiple divisions, from takeoff through final bid form * Working proficiency with AI tools. Not curiosity, proficiency. You already use them to accelerate solicitation review, past performance matching, market research, pricing analysis, and proposal drafting. We move fast because we use these tools hard, and a candidate who does not will not keep up with the pursuit volume this seat carries * Fluency with SAM.gov, agency forecasting tools, and the federal small business landscape * Willingness to travel. Site visits, pre\-bids, and conferences are the job, not an add\-on. Expect 30 to 40 percent travel * Based on the West Coast, positioned to reach VA, NPS, NCA, and DoD installations across the region **PREFERRED** * Existing relationships inside VA VISN 20, NCA, NPS, or USACE and NAVFAC in the western districts * Experience taking a small business prime onto its first multiple\-award vehicle * Working knowledge of mentor\-protege and JV structures as a route onto vehicles a company cannot qualify for alone * Experience at a small business prime where you carried the pursuit end to end without a proposal department behind you * You can describe a specific workflow you built with AI that measurably cut your pursuit or estimating cycle time * Familiarity with Bluebeam, On\-Screen Takeoff, or comparable estimating software * Prior work under SDVOSB, 8(a), or HUBZone set\-asides * Veteran *We are not requiring OSHA 30 or CQM\-C for this role. We want a closer, not a credential stack.* **Why This Seat** You report to the West Coast Program Manager and you own the business development function outright. Our proposal writer reports to you, along with any proposal staff we bring in behind her. You are building a team, not filling a slot. Decisions get made in a conversation, not a committee. You will have real authority over pursuit strategy, your own travel and conference spend, the markets we move into next, and the vehicle strategy that determines what DRI looks like in five years. **If you are currently sitting at a large prime watching your pipeline get handed to you, and you think you could build a better one yourself, this is that job.** **To Apply** Send a resume and a short note naming three federal contracts you helped win, the agency, and the award value. No cover letter template. Tell us what you hunted and what you killed. *DRI, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Veterans strongly encouraged to apply.* Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Fuel reimbursement * Health insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **About Mojave Energy Systems, Inc.** Mojave is changing the nature of air conditioning. It is time for a change, and Mojave’s liquid desiccant air conditioning systems are doing just that. If you want to change the world, starting with the world of air conditioning, then you may belong at Mojave. We are looking for purpose\-driven team members who enjoy problem solving, teamwork, and personal growth to join our venture\-backed company. **ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY** Mojave Energy Systems is seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical Design Engineer to take a significant role in designing and engineering our liquid desiccant air conditioner. Reporting to the Mechanical Design Engineering Manager,you will be responsible for mechanical design and testing of sub\-systems and components for a novel HVAC product. The successful candidate should be comfortable overcoming design challenges under deadlines, working across teams, and working both independently and as managed remotely. This is a rare opportunity to be a part of creating and launching cutting edge technology for a venture\-backed climate\-tech company at a critical inflection point: we've proven the technology works, we're ramping production, and we need an engineer who can balance innovation with practical manufacturability and field robustness. **This is an on\-site role in the Anderson/Piedmont/Greenville area of SC or onsite in Sunnyvale, CA** **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own systems and component projects from concept through manufacturing. * Produce production\-quality solid models and engineering drawings in a collaborative CAD environment (OnShape). * Serve as the liaison between the Mechanical Design team and the production floor. * Manage vendors to quote, build, and evaluate prototype and production parts. * Design and execute subsystem tests to explore the design space and validate solutions. * Basic fabrication, assembly, machining, testing, debugging, and parts chasing. * Evaluating and improving designs for DFM/DFA. * Participate in Failure Modes and Effects Analysis. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, or relevant field. * 3\+ years’ experience in mechanical design and design for manufacturing. * Strong CAD skills (SolidWorks or Onshape preferred). * Strong critical thinking skills: ability to deep dive into cause\-effect and complex diagnostics. * Demonstrable communications skills across a range of skill levels. * Demonstrated history of hands\-on experience in design/build. * Knowledgeable in common manufacturing processes, including sheet metal, metal forming, injection molding, machining, etc. * Structured problem\-solving skills, leveraging inputs such as functional documentation (P\&ID diagrams, mechanical drawings) and performance testing data. Mojave is a mission\-driven company focused on advancing air conditioning technology. We manufacture our products in the United States at our Anderson, South Carolina facility and our engineering lab is based in Sunnyvale, California. We are committed to a workplace grounded in integrity, excellence, collaboration, and meaningful work. jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Company** Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact. **The Department: Platform** Our Platform organization’s purpose is to enable Gemini to scale effectively and empower our engineering teams to focus on building innovative financial products and experiences for individuals around the world. Platform builds a scalable and secure foundation that enables Engineering to develop, deploy, validate, and operate services in production; improve reliability; reduce repetitive operational work; and improve system efficiency through architectural improvements. The Platform team builds products for engineers. We work directly with product, application engineering, data, and security teams to understand their needs, establish safe defaults, and provide standard workflows for building and operating services. We treat internal platforms as production software with users, service\-level objectives, roadmaps, documentation, and feedback loops. **The Role: Staff Platform Engineer** You will provide technical leadership for the software and infrastructure that form Gemini’s internal engineering platform. This is a software engineering role grounded in deep production and infrastructure experience. You will build self\-service systems, developer tools, and automation that improve the way teams create, deploy, scale, observe, and operate services. You will shape platform strategy across cloud, networking, compute, storage, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and the systems required to run highly available services in production. You will partner with engineering, security, data, and product leaders to turn broad operational needs into reliable platform products, establish clear technical direction, and drive adoption across teams. You will make infrastructure programmable, secure, observable, and resilient; use SLOs and error budgets to guide tradeoffs; and continuously replace manual operational work with well\-designed software. The role spans software, systems, and infrastructure engineering, with an emphasis on solving cross\-functional problems and delivering measurable improvements to developer productivity and production reliability. What success looks like in this role: Engineers can safely self\-serve common workflows through documented, well\-supported platform products. Platform capabilities are adopted because they reduce complexity and improve outcomes. Reliability, deployment safety, developer experience, and infrastructure efficiency improve measurably over time. Operational load grows more slowly than the number and scale of services supported by the team. Platform engineers remain close to production while spending the majority of their time on durable software and systems improvements. **Responsibilities:** * Set technical direction for platform capabilities and contribute to a long\-term plan for cloud, networking, infrastructure, delivery, and reliability engineering. * Lead architecture recommendations and technical engagements across the software development lifecycle, from early design through production operation. * Design, build, and maintain platform services, APIs, CLIs, controllers, workflows, and automation in languages such as Go, TypeScript, Python, or similar; own them through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation. * Build self\-service capabilities that let engineers provision environments, deploy services, manage infrastructure, and respond to operational conditions safely without relying on manual platform intervention. * Experience with build tooling such as Bazel or Buck2\. * Create and evolve standard workflows for service development and delivery, including templates, libraries, deployment workflows, policy\-as\-code, and reusable platform building blocks. * Design and improve the cloud, compute, storage, identity, and infrastructure building blocks used by engineering teams. * Design and operate core network infrastructure across public clouds and regions, including routing, connectivity, traffic management, and security controls. * Operate and improve the compute, container, networking, and cloud infrastructure that supports critical services and new workloads, including distributed and AI\-enabled systems where appropriate. * Improve the systems and work per tools. * Demonstrated experience operating infrastructure and distributed systems in production, including diagnosing failures, managing capacity, improving performance, and designing for high availability and recovery. * Experience designing, operating, or improving production systems across cloud infrastructure, networking, compute, storage, deployment platforms, or related infrastructure domains. * Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and infrastructure as code, such as Terraform or an equivalent system. * Experience with containers and orchestration, such as Kubernetes, EKS, GKE, AKS, Docker, or Nomad, including workload deployment, networking, security, and operational troubleshooting. * Experience owning and managing cloud network security controls, including network firewalls, DNS filtering, and network segmentation. * Experience designing or improving CI/CD and automated software delivery systems, including testing, deployment, progressive rollout, rollback, and change validation. * Practical experience with observability: metrics, logs, traces, alerting, dashboards, and production health models. Familiarity with OpenTelemetry or comparable tooling is valuable. * Working knowledge of SLOs, error budgets, incident response, blameless postmortems, and techniques for reducing operational toil. * Experience with high\-availability architectures, capacity planning, failure recovery, and the operational tradeoffs required to run critical systems at scale. * Experience building secure\-by\-default systems and collaborating with security teams on identity, access control, secrets, supply\-chain security, and policy enforcement. * Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and domains quickly, including the infrastructure and reliability characteristics of data\-intensive, event\-driven, or AI/ML workloads. * Track record of setting technical direction, leading architecture across multiple teams, and influencing decisions without relying on direct authority. * Experience mentoring engineers, developing technical leaders, and communicating complex technical tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Strong technical communication and leadership skills; able to turn cross\-functional problems into maintainable systems and delivered results. **It Pays to Work Here** The compensation \& benefits package for this role includes: * Competitive starting pay * A discretionary annual bonus * Long\-term incentive in the form of a new hire equity grant * Comprehensive health plans * 401K with company matching * Paid Parental Leave * Flexible time off **Salary Range**: The base salary range for this role is between $168,000 \- $240,000 in the State of New York. This range is not inclusive of our discretionary bonus or equity package. When determining a candidate’s compensation, we consider a number of factors including skillset, experience, job scope, and current market data. *In the United States, we offer a hybrid work approach at our hub offices, balancing the benefits of in\-person collaboration with the flexibility of remote work. Expectations may vary by location and role, so candidates are encouraged to connect with their recruiter to learn more about the specific policy for the role. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Ledger
jobs.description: Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **THE NORTH STAR** 99\.99% reliability on gateway and banking integrations, and a ledger where every cent is accounted for and every entry says who created it and when. Supporting KPIs: reconciliation exception queue depth at daily close, gateway and banking integration uptime at 99\.99%, P90 time from auction close to seller funds available, share of ACH returns and reversals handled with no manual correcting entry, and time to bring a new PSP or rail to production. **TH ROLE:** This is a builder's seat, not a manager's seat. You will write the ledger, the rails, and the reconciliation yourself. You will make the build\-versus\-buy call and defend it. You will tell the business no when correctness demands it, and you will be right often enough that they keep asking. The people who are great at this have owned a ledger somewhere it mattered, and they think in idempotency, race conditions, and reconciliation. **WHAT YOU'LL OWN:** * The ledger as system of record. Entries, lines, balances, holds, reversals, and the states between: pending, posted, available, canceled, declined, reversed. Immutability and audit trail as design constraints, not features. Point\-in\-time balances that show a customer where they stood on any past date. Done looks like an auditor pulling a trial balance without asking you for help. * Rails and money movement. ACH origination and returns, RTP and other instant rails, wires, cards, and stablecoin settlement. A credit\-push rail changes what you can auto\-charge and when funds are final, and you own those product consequences, not just the integration. Done looks like the fourth PSP costing a sprint, not a rewrite. * Reconciliation. When the ledger and the processor disagree, you own the answer. Automated matching, an exception queue a human can actually work, and breaks caught before a customer finds them. Every point of automation here is a point on the north star. * Payouts and lending infrastructure. Getting sellers and borrowers their money faster than anyone else in this market: instant payout options, batch payouts at auction close, and the settlement timing that makes them safe. Then the full loan lifecycle, disbursement through repayment, partial payment, delinquency, and collateral release. * Risk posture on high\-value flows. Holds, limits, and settlement windows set with data, and you will know what each one costs in conversion. Step\-up verification triggered by risk signals rather than blanket friction. * The trade\-off calls. Shipping speed against uncompromising correctness, build against buy. You set the planning cadence with Robbe, you work across Finance, Risk, Ops, and Support, and you are the one who explains upward why a number moved. **WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE IN 6 MONTHS:** * The reconciliation automation rate is materially higher than the day you started, and you can show the weekly series. * The exception queue at daily close is worked to zero by a human in under an hour, on a system you built for that. * A new rail or PSP has gone to production on the provider architecture you designed, and it did not require a ledger migration. * Pending, posted, and available are modeled cleanly enough that Support answers "where is my money" off the customer\-facing surface instead of escalating to engineering. * Corrections post as reversing entries. Nobody has edited history, and an auditor can say so. * At least one thing you shipped is running with AI in the loop, and the team depends on it. * Finance trusts the close. **HOW YOU'LL USE AI HERE** * Turn a payment provider or bank partner integration spec into a typed client and a test suite in an afternoon instead of a sprint, including the ACH return codes and reversal paths nobody wants to hand\-write. * Stand up a rail simulator that produces the failures a sandbox won't: a late return, a duplicate callback, a partial reversal, a webhook that arrives twice out of order, a settlement that lands after the window closed. Then run your ledger against it. * Build an agent that triages the reconciliation exception queue overnight, clusters the breaks, and hands you a ranked list with a proposed cause for each instead of a wall of unmatched rows. * Put an MCP server over the ledger so "where did this discrepancy come from" is a question you ask in plain language rather than another one\-off query against a table nobody else understands. * Generate adversarial test cases for the lending and settlement state machines: the repayment that lands mid\-default, the partial payment that arrives after a write\-off, the retur  real money on real rails. ACH origination and returns, RTP or FedNow, wires, or equivalent. You know what an R01 is, why NACHA return windows matter, and why a credit\-push rail changes the product flow and not just the API call. * You have handled large transactions, where the failure mode is a five\- or six\-figure problem and somebody notices immediately. * Database mastery. Expert SQL and relational design, and a transaction that holds under load at auction close and during scheduled auto\-pay batches. Python, Postgres, and AWS are our stack. * You're API\-native. Webhooks, idempotency, eventual consistency, and reconciliation are your default vocabulary, not terms you looked up. * You've built real things with AI, not just used it. Agents, skills, MCP servers, connectors, internal tooling people depend on. * Product\-owner thinking. You don't just build a pay button. You understand the flow of funds and how to tell a worried customer what happened to their money. * Restraint. The most common way this seat fails is overengineering. You know when a queue and a lambda are the answer and when they are three new partial\-failure modes. **We read the work, not the years. Most people who clear this bar have five to ten years behind them, and we have no interest in screening out the person who got there faster.** Strong plus: enough React and TypeScript to ship the customer\-facing surface that reads off your ledger. This is not a fullstack seat, but the person who can take a ledger change all the way to the UI will go further here. Backgrounds that fit: payments or ledger infrastructure at a pre\-IPO fintech, core banking or money movement at a marketplace, a founding or early engineer who built the money layer, or an infrastructure engineer who took ownership of financial correctness because nobody else would. Bonus: distributed systems, credit or risk modeling, direct experience with Stripe, Plaid, Airwallex, PayPal, Modern Treasury, or Increase, evaluating or implementing a third\-party ledger service (Modern Treasury, Fragment, Formance, TigerBeetle or similar), stablecoin or on\-chain settlement, KYC/KYB, bank partnership, or SOX and audit\-readiness exposure. You collect, or you have a view on where this market is going. US\-based, remote. **HOW WE'LL INTERVIEW YOU:** *We'll be specific so you can prepare. Before any of it: download the app, put a card up, make a bid, and try selling. Every round assumes you've used the product, and we expect your point of view to sharpen as you go. For this role, look specifically at the cash advance, deposit, and payout surfaces.* * Recruiter screen, 25 minutes, Google Meet. The metric you own today and how you're performing against it, why Alt specifically, and how you're actually using AI. We align on comp here and answer your questions. * Hiring manager, Robbe Simon, 45 minutes, Google Meet. * Technical screen, 60 minutes. * Architecture and system design, 60 minutes. * Culture interview, 30 minutes. How you work with the people who depend on your systems: operations, finance, support, and the customer on the other end of a held transfer. * Leore, our founder and CEO, 30 minutes. Everyone who joins Alt meets Leore. Come with a point of view on where you'd take Alt's ledger and money movement first. * Reference check(s), 15 minutes, with a former manager. **Compensation: $200,000 \- $500,000 per year, plus equity for all full\-time employees.** **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $300K \- $500K
