jobs.title: Civil Roadway/Highway Design Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.** At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. **Job Description** AECOM is seeking a talented and motivated **Civil Roadway/Highway Engineer** to join our Transportation team in Tampa, Florida. In this role, the successful candidate will contribute to the planning, design, and delivery of roadway and transportation infrastructure projects for clients including FDOT, local governments, toll authorities, and other public agencies. The Civil Engineer II will support project managers and senior engineers in developing roadway, pavement, drainage, maintenance of traffic (MOT), signing and pavement marking, and ADA\-compliance improvements. The position offers opportunities to work on complex transportation projects while further developing technical expertise and progressing toward Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. **Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:** * Prepare roadway design plans, profiles, typical sections, and cross sections using OpenRoads Designer and MicroStation. * Perform engineering calculations and technical analyses for transportation projects. * Develop pavement evaluation reports and rehabilitation recommendations. * Assist in the preparation of roadway design reports, engineering studies, and technical documentation. * Design signing and pavement marking plans in accordance with MUTCD and agency standards. * Prepare ADA compliant pedestrian facility improvements, including curb ramps, sidewalks, and crosswalks. * Support maintenance of traffic (MOT) and traffic control plan development. * Perform quantity calculations and assist with cost estimating. * Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams including drainage, structures, traffic engineering, survey, environmental, and utility disciplines. * Participate in field reviews, site visits, and construction support activities. * Support quality control reviews and implementation of company design standards. * Communicate effectively with project managers, clients, and project stakeholders. **Technical Skills** * Roadway design * Pavement engineering * Transportation corridor modeling * Horizontal and vertical alignment development * Maintenance of traffic design * ADA compliance * Signing and pavement marking * Quantity calculations * Cost estimating * Engineering report preparation * Multidisciplinary project coordination **Career Growth Opportunities** The Civil Engineer II position provides opportunities to: * Lead design tasks on increasingly complex transportation projects. * Expand technical expertise in roadway and transportation engineering. * Prepare for and obtain Professional Engineer licensure. * Develop project management and client\-facing experience. * Advance into senior engineering and project leadership roles. **Qualifications** **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering plus 2 years of transportation engineering experience or demonstrated equivalency of education and/or experience. * Engineer Intern (EI/EIT) certification. * Demonstrated experience with roadway design and plan production. * Demonstrated proficiency with Bentley OpenRoads Designer and MicroStation. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with DOT, municipal, county, or toll\-road transportation projects. * Experience preparing: + Roadway design plans + Pavement design and rehabilitation recommendations + Maintenance of Traffic (MOT) plans + Signing and pavement marking plans + ADA compliance improvements * Familiarity with AASHTO and MUTCD design standards. * Experience with ProjectWise and transportation design workflows. * Working knowledge of AutoCAD, SignCAD, Synchro, or related transportation software. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively in a team\-oriented environment. **Additional Information** * Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position. * Hybrid work location model * Collaborative A/E office environment * Relocation is not available for this position At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.*** **About AECOM** AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD\&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well\-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan. AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public\- and private\-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16\.1 billion in fiscal year 2025\. Learn more at aecom.com. **What makes AECOM a great place to work** You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects \- both in your local community and on a global scale \- that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting\-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award\-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community—where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we believe in your potential and are here to help you achieve it. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Digital Workplace Endpoint
jobs.description: Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US\-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries. AES has been **ranked \#1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.** We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices. Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven\-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty\-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry. If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy. The **Senior Analyst, Digital Workplace Endpoint** is a key member of the AES US Renewables Digital team, helping deliver secure, reliable, and modern endpoint experiences across the organization. This role supports endpoint management, device configuration, application deployment, endpoint security, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives aligned with AES Global Digital Workplace Experience standards. This position offers an excellent opportunity for a technology professional looking to expand their expertise in endpoint engineering, modern device management, automation, cybersecurity, and enterprise\-scale digital workplace technologies. You will work alongside experienced engineers and cross\-functional teams while gaining exposure to modern Microsoft ecosystem technologies and industry best practices. **Your Impact** As a member of the Digital Workplace Experience team, you will help employees work securely and effectively from anywhere, on any device. You will collaborate with technical teams, cybersecurity partners, vendors, and business stakeholders to improve endpoint performance, reduce operational risk, and enhance the employee experience. **What Will Help You Succeed** We recognize that successful candidates bring a variety of experiences and strengths. You may be a great fit if you have: * A growth mindset and enthusiasm for learning new technologies and developing technical expertise. * Customer\-focused problem\-solving skills and a desire to improve the employee technology experience. * A security\-conscious approach and an understanding of the importance of compliance, patching, and vulnerability management. * Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * A continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation, efficiency, and innovation. **Key Responsibilities** As a Senior Analyst, Digital Workplace Endpoint, you will: * Configure, deploy, administer, and support endpoint technologies, including operating systems, desktop applications, endpoint security tools, device management platforms, and related solutions. * Support Microsoft endpoint management platforms, including Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Autopilot, application packaging, compliance management, and policy deployment. * Create and maintain software deployment packages and automate repeatable tasks using tools such as PowerShell. * Support endpoint security initiatives, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, encryption, compliance monitoring, and collaboration with Cyber Security teams. * Troubleshoot endpoint, application deployment, device management, virtual environment, and user experience issues. * Provide advanced support for business users, including executive stakeholders, and participate in on\-call support rotations as needed. * Support collaboration technologies and meeting room solutions, including Microsoft Teams Rooms, Logitech technologies, and related platforms. * Evaluate hardware and software requests and recommend solutions aligned with business needs, security requirements, and technology standards. * Develop and maintain documentation, standard operating procedures, work instructions, and knowledge base articles. * Identify and implement opportunities to improve endpoint performance, operational efficiency, automation, and user experience. * Contribute to technology projects and initiatives that support the ongoing modernization of the Digital Workplace environment. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, technical training, certifications, and experience. * Approximately 3\+ years of experience in endpoint engineering, enterprise systems administration, digital workplace technology, desktop engineering, or a related technical role. * Experience working with endpoint management technologies, deployment processes, application packaging, automation, scripting, or enterprise endpoint standards. * Working knowledge of: + Microsoft Intune + MECM/SCCM + Windows 11 + Microsoft 365 + Active Directory / Microsoft Entra ID + Group Policy + TCP/IP networking and endpoint connectivity troubleshooting * Experience supporting endpoint deployment, software distribution, patch management, compliance programs, and endpoint lifecycle management. * Familiarity with PowerShell scripting and a willingness to continue developing automation capabilities. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting macOS devices, mobile device management, endpoint virtualization platforms, printing solutions, or executive support environments. * Industry certifications such as: + **Microsoft Certified**: Endpoint Administrator Associate + **Microsoft Certified**: Modern Desktop Administrator Associate + ITIL Foundation + CompTIA A\+, Network\+, or Security\+ + Apple Certified Support Professional + Other relevant technology certifications AES is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is committed to building strength and delivering long\-term sustainability through diversity and inclusion. Respecting all backgrounds, differences and perspectives enables us to improve the lives of our people, customers, suppliers, contractors, and the communities in which we live and work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and/or expression, race, national origin, ethnicity, age, religion, marital status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. E\-Verify Notice: AES will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employee's I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing!** ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.* Trio WFS builds Digital Workers, autonomous AI systems that execute real operational workflows in healthcare workforce management, already running in production and delivering measurable results for our clients. The Lead AI Engineer is the senior technical authority for this work, responsible for driving the architecture, technical direction, and engineering standards that support Trio's AI\-powered products, Digital Workers, and intelligent automation capabilities. This role leads the design and evolution of complex AI systems spanning agentic workflows, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architectures, orchestration frameworks, evaluation platforms, observability capabilities, and product AI infrastructure. The Lead AI Engineer operates as the technical leader for the AI Engineering team, influencing architecture decisions across Trio's products while partnering closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Platform, and executive stakeholders. This role is being developed with a clear path toward team leadership. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise with a genuine desire to grow into people management, and will be coached and mentored to eventually lead the AI Engineering team. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role on a small, high\-leverage team of one Senior AI Engineer and one AI Engineer, with direct exposure to Engineering, Product, and executive leadership. **What You'll Work On** * The Digital Worker framework, a pattern where policies (the questions a client needs answered) combine with features (the data available to answer them) to produce grounded, auditable decisions. Extending this framework to new workflows is the core of the job. * Evaluation infrastructure, the harness that lets us quantitatively measure whether a change to a prompt, retrieval strategy, or model actually improved anything. This gates what ships. * Platform orchestration, an event\-driven orchestrator with autoscaling, input\-level quarantine, and per\-worker circuit breaking. * Centralized inference, an LLM gateway that routes, logs, and controls cost and latency across every AI\-powered capability in the product. * Retrieval and knowledge systems, ingestion, embedding, indexing, and grounding strategies that keep answers accurate and traceable. **Principal Responsibilities** *Architecture \& Technical Direction* * Own the architecture of the Digital Worker platform and the AI capabilities embedded in Trio's products * Establish design principles, engineering patterns, and architectural standards for AI systems * Lead technical design reviews and make the tradeoff calls on quality, latency, cost, and operational complexity * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine what is worth adopting *AI Systems Engineering* * Design and build production systems using LLMs, retrieval architectures, agentic workflows, and tool use * Build reusable frameworks for agent orchestration, tool integration, workflow execution, and memory * Solve the hardest technical problems on the team, hands\-on *Evaluation \& Quality* * Own the standards for how we measure AI quality: accuracy, groundedness, safety, latency, and business impact * Build and extend evaluation frameworks that catch regressions and hallucinations before clients do * Drive measurable improvement in system quality through experimentation and production learning *Observability \& Operational Excellence* * Define monitoring, tracing, and logging standards for AI systems in production * Establish reliability and performance objectives; serve as senior escalation for critical AI production issues * Improve production readiness and AI lifecycle management as the platform scales *Technical Leadership \& Partnership* * Mentor the AI Engineering team and grow their architectural judgment and engineering depth * Lead code and design reviews; set and enforce engineering standards * Partner with Product, Platform, Data, Security, and executive stakeholders * Translate business objectives into technical strategy, and technical tradeoffs into business terms **Growth Path** We are hiring a technical leader first. As the AI Engineering team grows, this role is expected to take on formal leadership of it. We will discuss what that path looks like openly during the interview process, including timeline expectations and what the transition into people management actually involves. **Education** Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Preferred: Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or a related technical discipline. **Required Experience** * 7\+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or a closely rel echnical and architectural decisions * Excellent written and verbal communication with both technical and executive audiences **Preferred Experience** * Prior experience leading or managing a team * Azure cloud, Azure OpenAI, and event\-driven infrastructure * Vector databases, semantic search, embeddings, and enterprise knowledge systems * Building agent orchestration platforms or autonomous workflow systems at scale * AI governance, security, compliance, or responsible AI practices * .NET/C\#, React/TypeScript, SQL Server, CosmosDB, Auth0, Azure DevOps, Datadog * SaaS, workforce technology, healthcare, or high\-growth technology organizations **Success Metrics** First 90 days: fluent in the Digital Worker platform and evaluation harness, owning at least one significant architectural decision, established as a technical resource for the team. First 12 months: * Measurable improvement in AI quality, groundedness, latency, and cost efficiency across production Digital Workers * Evaluation and observability coverage extended to every production AI capability * Reduction in AI\-related production incidents and regressions * Reusable frameworks and standards adopted across AI engineering work * Demonstrable technical growth in AI Engineering team members * New Digital Worker capabilities delivered faster, with less bespoke engineering per workflow **Location** This role is fully remote. Candidates within a reasonable commuting distance of our Frisco, TX or Edmond, OK offices are welcome to work from either location, and we'd love to build out our presence in both over time, but it is not a requirement. **Compensation** The expected base salary range for this position is $150,000 to $180,000 annually. The final compensation offered will be determined based on a number of factors, including but not limited to skills, qualifications, experience, and location. **Equal Employment Opportunity Statement** All AHSG companies, including AHS Staffing and Trio Workforce Solutions, are Equal Employment Opportunity employers. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. **Reasonable Accommodation Statement (ADA)** AHSG will not refuse to hire or otherwise discriminate against a job applicant with a disability who is capable of performing the essential functions of the job with or without reasonable accommodation. If you need an accommodation to apply for a position or to perform the essential functions of the role, please let us know. **Essential Functions / Job Requirements** Qualified candidates must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Requirements may vary depending on the role. A detailed job description, including the essential functions and any physical requirements, will be provided upon request. **Example of Role\-Specific Requirements (when applicable)** For this position, the essential functions may include: * Remaining in a stationary position for approximately 50% of the workday * Learning and applying new tasks and procedures * Maintaining attention and completing work independently * Making timely workflow\-related decisions * Meeting productivity and/or time\-based performance expectations ### ***Qualified candidates must possess the physical and mental abilities necessary to perform the job's essential functions, with or without reasonable accommodation. Specific requirements may vary depending on the nature of the position. Applicants should be prepared to discuss their ability to meet these requirements during the interview process. A detailed job description outlining the physical and mental demands of the role will be provided upon request.*** ### ***All AHSG companies, AHS Staffing, AHSA, and Trio Workforce Solutions are equal employment opportunity employers*****.**

experience in sales engineering or similar roles. * Minimum 2 years of teaching or implementing new software. * Customer\-centric mindset with a strong ability to bridge the gap between complex engineering requirements and practical business applications. * Advanced technical aptitude with the ability to conduct deep\-dive product demonstrations and lead technical discovery sessions that address specific client pain points. * Solution\-oriented approach focused on building credibility with technical evaluators while supporting the broader sales cycle to achieve regional revenue targets. * Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of delivering persuasive technical content to both engineering teams and non\-technical decision\-makers. * Collaborative attitude troubleshooting technical barriers and customizing workflows to meet diverse project needs. * High degree of self\-motivation and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent evaluations in a fast\-paced environment. * Full professional fluency in English. **WHAT WE OFFER:** * Comprehensive onboarding and ongoing professional development to support your success and growth at ALLPLAN. * Flexible work arrangements, including options for remote work * The opportunity to play a key role in the growth journey of a global software company leading innovation in the AEC industry. * Collaboration with high\-performing colleagues across Customer Success, Professional Services, and Sales teams worldwide. * Autonomy to manage your account portfolio and execute strategic account plans with strong support from leadership. * A collaborative, fast\-paced environment that values customer success, innovation, and continuous learning. * Competitive compensation with performance\-based incentives and a comprehensive benefits package. * Excellent opportunities for professional development and career growth within a global organization \#Allplan \#LI\-FT1 **Compensation** ---------------- The base pay range for this role is $85,000 – $85,000 per year.

From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future. Whether you’re designing next\-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career. Responsibilities: **THE ROLE:** Join a team building the next generation of AI\-powered development platforms and agent\-based systems. As a Senior Product Development Engineer, you will lead the evolution of our core agent orchestration platform, helping scale secure, reliable, and observable AI workflows used across multiple users and environments. Working across backend services, frontend experiences, infrastructure, and developer tooling, you will drive architecture decisions, deliver production\-ready solutions, and help shape the foundation for future AI capabilities at AMD. **THE PERSON:** You are a hands\-on engineer who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys turning complex technical challenges into scalable, maintainable solutions. You combine strong software engineering fundamentals with a customer\-focused mindset, collaborate effectively across disciplines, and bring a passion for building high\-quality systems that deliver measurable impact. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:*** Architect and enhance agent orchestration and runtime platforms with provider\-agnostic integrations across AI ecosystems. * Build reliable, scalable workflow execution capabilities, including concurrency, checkpointing, recovery, and lifecycle management. * Develop secure multi\-user environments that protect data, artifacts, and workspace isolation. * Improve platform observability through structured logging, metrics, performance monitoring, and cost tracking. * Evolve backend services and user\-facing experiences, including APIs, file management, artifact delivery, and error handling. * Lead engineering excellence through CI/CD automation, testing, documentation, release management, and technical design leadership. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:*** Experience building AI/LLM applications, agent frameworks, workflow orchestration systems, or model\-provider abstractions. * Strong background developing backend platforms using FastAPI, REST APIs, streaming technologies, and secure authentication models. * Proficiency working across modern web technologies, including TypeScript, frontend frameworks, and API/UI integrations. * Experience designing scalable, observable, and resilient distributed systems in production environments. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Actions, automated testing, code quality tooling, and release processes. * Familiarity with AI observability, telemetry, developer platforms, multi\-repository workflows, or Git submodule management. **ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:*** Bachelor's jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Virtual Technology Management
jobs.description: **Job Summary** At Abacus Group, we believe the future of technology services in regulated industries will be defined by the ability to securely operationalize modern infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, automation, and AI, not simply deploy tools. The Virtual Technology Manager (VTM) serves as the strategic execution and operational orchestration partner for clients operating in highly regulated environments across Abacus's Financial Services business unit (hedge funds, private equity firms, RIAs, asset managers, family offices) and Healthcare business unit (hospital and health systems, physician groups, payers, and other regulated healthcare organizations). This role sits at the intersection of technology strategy, operational execution, cybersecurity, infrastructure modernization, cloud services, AI enablement, and service lifecycle management. The VTM works closely with client stakeholders and internal Abacus teams to transform strategic priorities into operational reality by coordinating execution, driving technology adoption, improving operational maturity, and reducing risk across complex client environments. Operating as a trusted technology advisor, the VTM helps align technology decisions to business outcomes while orchestrating delivery across engineering, security, professional services, operations, AI, and client experience teams. Beyond their assigned client engagements, VTMs also execute against Abacus's catalog of standardized VTM service offerings and technical deliverables, delivering engineering outcomes across the broader client base. VTM engagements follow a portfolio\-based or a dedicated assignment model. Portfolio\-based VTMs support a range of clients and hours based on business need, while dedicated VTMs are assigned primarily or exclusively to a single client. In either model, the VTM remains an Abacus employee, accountable to Abacus's standards, operating model, and management structure. The core responsibilities and expectations of the VTM remain consistent across both engagement models, with dedicated assignments providing greater client\-specific capacity, continuity, and embedded engagement. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth, operational leadership, executive communication skills, and the ability to coordinate complex initiatives across multiple stakeholders and technologies. This role is ideal for someone looking to move beyond traditional infrastructure management and play a meaningful role in the modernization of technology operations within regulated industries. This role is hybrid located in Orlando Florida **Key Responsibilities** * Serve as the primary operational technology partner for assigned clients, developing a deep understanding of each client's environment, operations, priorities, and technology needs, and aligning infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies to business objectives. * Act as the primary technical liaison between client stakeholders and Abacus delivery teams, ensuring technical needs are clearly understood, appropriately prioritized, and driven through resolution. * Perform targeted hands\-on technical work within the VTM scope while coordinating larger, specialized, or project\-based engineering efforts through the appropriate Abacus delivery teams. * Help clients operationalize technology initiatives within regulated environments by supporting infrastructure planning, governance alignment, security, operational readiness, modernization, and adoption. * Provide technical guidance and coordinate complex support matters and escalations across Support, Engineering, Security, Infrastructure, AI, Professional Services, Operations, and vendors. * Guide clients through modernization initiatives involving cloud platforms, cybersecurity, identity and access management, infrastructure lifecycle management, automation, collaboration platforms, and operational tooling. * Support clients in evaluating, preparing for, and operationalizing AI\-enabled solutions, coordinating specialized AI design and implementation resources where required. * Identify opportunities to improve operational maturity, resiliency, scalability, governance, automation, and long\-term technology effectiveness. * Maintain oversight of service activity, recurring concerns, escalations, and technical debt, ensuring ownership, communication, and follow\-through, and driving continuous improvement. * Maintain regular engagement with client technical and operational stakeholders through scheduled meetings, ongoing communication, service reviews, and technology planning. * Execute against Abacus's catalog of standardized VTM service offerings and technical deliverables, delivering engineering outcomes across the broader client base beyond one's own assigned engagements. * For dedicated assignments, operate as an extension of the client's technology organization while remaining accountable to Abacus's standards and management structure. **Ideal Candidate Profile** * Strong experience supporting financial services organizations within a managed services, consulting, or enterprise technology environment * Ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and executive stakeholders * Strong understanding of infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, and operational service delivery * Experience coordinating complex technical initiatives across multiple teams and vendors * Familiarity with regulated environments and compliance\-driven operational models * Strong organizational, communication, and client relationship skills * Ability to operate independently while driving accountability across matrixed teams * Interest in AI, automation, and emerging operational technologies **Preferred Experience** * Experience supporting financial services organizations, including hedge funds, private equity firms, RIAs, asset managers, and family offices * Strong understanding of modern Microsoft\-centric infrastructure and cloud ecosystems, including Microsoft 365, Azure, identity, collaboration, and endpoint management platforms * Experience supporting hybrid cloud and enterprise infrastructure environments across servers, networking, identity, security, and operational platforms * Strong knowledge of core Microsoft technologies, including Active Directory, Windows Server, Exchange Online, and Entra ID * Familiarity with cybersecurity, identity and access management, operational modernization, infrastructure lifecycle management, and governance\-driven technology environments * Exposure to AI enablement, governance, automation, or operational modernization initiatives preferred * Previous experience within MSP, MSSP, consulting, Healthcare, or strategic client advisory environments preferred * Experience supporting highly regulated or security\-sensitive environments strongly preferred **Why Join Abacus** Technology services are undergoing a major shift as AI, cloud transformation, cybersecurity, automation, and other emerging technologies continue to reshape regulated industries. Organizations are under increasing pressure to modernize their environments, improve operational maturity, reduce risk, and support evolving business demands in a secure and scalable way. At Abacus Group, we serve as a strategic technology partner for financial services and healthcare organizations, helping clients modernize, secure, operate, and continuously improve complex technology environments. This role offers the opportunity to work directly with sophisticated financial services clients while helping drive infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity maturity, operational effectiveness, and the adoption of emerging technologies like AI across highly regulated environments. If you want to help regulated organizations operationalize the future of technology, we should talk. **The Benefits of Working for Abacus:** * Competitive compensation * Exposure to diverse array of technologies * Part of a supportive, friendly team of experienced technicians that aim to deliver exceptional service * Robust benefits package: medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401k, and PTO * Opportunities to further technical education through online courses and Employee Certification Program This position requires current U.S. work authorization. The company is unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

jobs.title: Engineer, Technology II
jobs.description: **Company Description** **About AbbVie** AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. **Job Description** Technical expert responsible for independently identifying, engineering, and optimizing data, reporting, and integration solutions that address critical business needs within Clinical Supply Management (CSM). Serves as the reporting and systems\-data subject matter expert for the Clinical Supply Systems (CSS) group — designing and delivering operational reports, metrics, and dashboards from GxP clinical supply systems, engineering and supporting system\-to\-system integrations with external vendor platforms, and continuously improving the processes and master data that those systems depend on. Additionally serves as Business System Owner for assigned CSM systems, accountable for their ongoing health, change management, business continuity and end\-user support. Continuously seeks to improve existing methods and processes. Demonstrates proficiency across a broad range of information technology engineering techniques, including SQL development, data integration, reporting and data visualization, API\-based system integration, and database and data\-warehouse concepts. **Responsibilities:** * **Reporting, metrics and analytics development.** Independently design, develop, test and deploy operational and management reports, dashboards and KPI views against clinical supply systems using Jaspersoft and SQL against Oracle and PostgreSQL data sources. Gather requirements directly from business stakeholders, translate them into report specifications, build parameterized and filterable reports with dynamic titling and drill\-down, publish to the reporting server, and own them through user acceptance and ongoing maintenance. Recent representative work includes shipping and transfer metrics summary reporting for the packaging and distribution sites and an integrated kit\-utilization report supporting quarterly waste, cost and volume assessment of expired comparator kits. * **Business System Ownership.** Act as Business System Owner for assigned Clinical Supply Management systems, in line with the Clinical Supply Systems Owner role definition. Accountable for the day\-to\-day health, configuration and supportability of the owned system(s), including: change management and change control; business continuity and disaster recovery planning and testing; interface and integration error handling and monitoring; definition and documentation of business roles and system access; coordination of upgrades, patches and vendor releases with business and IT partners; periodic review and system lifecycle documentation; and end\-user communication for outages, releases and process changes. Serves as the primary point of contact between the business user community, global IT and the external system vendor for the owned system(s), and represents the system in cross\-functional governance forums. * **System integration engineering and support.** Engineer, test and support integrations between CSM systems and external vendor platforms — including the TRACK / CSS Inventory to Sensitech SensiWatch temperature\-monitoring integration and associated Veeva Vault end\-to\-end flows. Design and implement API logging and monitoring mechanisms to make integration behavior observable; coordinate the required database, network ACL and firewall configuration across Development and Production; and drive end\-to\-end testing with internal IT and external vendor engineering teams. * **Integration issue triage and root cause analysis.** Serve as first\-line technical investigator for interface and integration failures. Correlate application logs, API responses and database activity to establish root cause, distinguish vendor\-side from AbbVie\-side faults, and communicate findings directly to external vendor technical contacts and internal stakeholders. Resolve issues of low to moderate complexity independently and escalate appropriately, engaging global IT support and external system providers when required. * **Master data management.** Own the input, administration and quality of master data in CSM systems, including item master classifications, data mappings and the representation of external partners and depots. Assess the downstream impact of master data changes on dependent system functionality, reporting and integrations before implementation. * **Process optimization and automation.** Identify and deliver automation and optimization opportunities that increase efficiency within CSM. Prep , GxP compliance, data security and the software development lifecycle. **Qualifications** **Required:** * Bachelor's degree in a relevant field and at least 5 years of relevant experience, **or** Master's degree in a relevant field and at least 4 years of relevant experience. * Strong, demonstrable SQL development skills, including query authoring, tuning and troubleshooting against relational databases (Oracle and/or PostgreSQL). * Hands\-on experience developing and deploying reports in Jaspersoft / JasperReports, including parameterization, scheduling and distribution. * Working understanding of relational database design, data models and data\-warehouse concepts, and the ability to navigate an unfamiliar schema to locate and validate data. * Experience supporting or engineering system\-to\-system integrations, including API/interface concepts, log analysis and structured root cause investigation. * Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to elicit requirements and translate them into technical deliverables; strong customer orientation and prioritization skills. * Effective written and verbal communication skills, including communicating technical findings to non\-technical stakeholders and to external vendor technical teams. * Goal\-oriented, independent working style with exceptional follow\-up skills, and the ability to think and act across multiple functions. * Demonstrated ownership of a business system or application, including accountability for change management, access and role definition, vendor release coordination and end\-user communication. * Familiarity with clinical supply management systems (IRTs, Signant’s PMD, Loftware’s P360, Master Control’s Mx) and with vendor platforms such as Sensitech SensiWatch. **Preferred:** * Experience with scripting or automation (e.g. Python) for data processing and operational tooling. * Experience preparing training materials, SOPs or work instructions and delivering system training. * Prior experience in clinical drug development, clinical supply chain, in a GMP regulated environment. * Experience with computer system validation, UAT, change control, periodic review, disaster recovery testing and GxP documentation practices. **Additional Information** Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: * The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. * We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. * This job is eligible to participate in our short\-term incentive programs. Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law. jobs.title: Junior Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000\+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations. Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands\-on experience, certifications, industry training and more. Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward! **About the APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program:** APX (Advanced Partnership Accelerator) is a Center of Excellence under AFS' Data \& AI capability. The APX Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) Program represents a strategic initiative to position Accenture Federal Services at the forefront of artificial intelligence innovation in government. This program embeds elite technical talent directly with federal clients to accelerate the adoption and implementation of frontier AI capabilities from leading laboratories including, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and other cutting\-edge AI partners. As an FDE, you will serve as the critical bridge between breakthrough AI technology and mission\-critical federal requirements. You'll work hands\-on with the most advanced AI models available, translating their transformative potential into tangible value for defense, intelligence, civilian, and public health missions. This is not a traditional consulting role; FDEs are technical practitioners, innovators, and trusted advisors who operate at the cutting edge of what's possible with AI in highly regulated, high\-security federal environments. **What You Will Do:** The APX FDE program exists because federal missions cannot wait for slow, siloed development cycles. They need embedded engineers who move with urgency, autonomy, and precision while being able to reach back to broader support across AFS. As a Junior FDE, you will work at the intersection of engineering, product thinking and client delivery, helping technical teams move from ambiguous client problems, to working proof\-of\-concept, to production\-grade deployment in a matter of weeks. In this role you will: * Embed within client environments as part of a forward deployed engineering (FDE) team to build rapid prototypes using AI tools, coding assistants, and modern frameworks * Use AI tools (LLMs, coding assistants, agentic frameworks) as part of daily development work * Support integration of solutions into complex client environments, including legacy systems and regulated data contexts * Work across the tech stack (frontend, backend, APIs, simple data pipelines) and help develop applications and workflows that use structured and unstructured enterprise data * Assist in evaluating model outputs, testing workflows, and applying responsible AI guardrails * Implement AI solutions such as RAG workflows, semantic search, prompt engineering patterns, and simple agent behaviors * Work with senior FDEs to clarify problem statements and translate them into technical plans * Participate in rapid experimentation cycles and incorporate user feedback into updates, documenting solution decisions and contributing to internal learning assets * Leverage technical expertise to help clients navigate the rapidly evolving technological landscape, serving as a trusted advisor on emerging AI capabilities, increasing user adoption and scaling mission impact * Share observations, user friction points, reusable assets and field intelligence back to APX teams to improve delivery approaches **Wh****at You Bring****:** * **Mission\-first Mindset \& Relentless Problem Solving:** You move fast because the mission can't wait. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us**Activated Insights, a Software\-as\-a\- Service (“SaaS”) leader in long\-term and post\-acute care, is seeking a driven and knowledgeable Senior Full Stack Software Engineer. Founded in 2008, Activated Insights is a software company serving North America’s fastest\-growing labor market—long\-term and post\-acute senior care. As the market leader, our technology, surveys, and training solutions are used by everything from mom\-and\-pop small businesses to billion\-dollar care organizations. Ultimately, our services impact the lives of hundreds of thousands of seniors every year. Today, with over 250 team members, over 7,000 customers that extend into over 23,000 sites of care, our products focus on employee engagement, ongoing education, resident and patient satisfaction surveys, and reputation management tools. **What Sets Activated Insights Apart:*** We are at the heart of the healthcare industry's most dynamic sector, with an ever\-growing demand for post\-acute care and long\- term care to address the fastest growing segment of the US population. * Our bond with healthcare providers draws compassionate, service\-driven team members, fostering a spirited, collaborative culture aligned on our mission to deliver exceptional experiences for our employees, our customers and the people in their care. * A high performing executive leadership team with success in both public and PE companies, primarily in high\-growth companies focused on the long term and post\-acute care market. * Backed by a private investment firm with 40\+ years of experience forging lasting partnerships across the healthcare industry. **Why Is This Role So Special?**The Senior Software Engineer will focus on improving employee and customer engagement in the senior care industry. This role combines technical leadership with hands\-on development responsibilities: you will own the end\-to\-end software lifecycle—from requirements gathering and system design through planning, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance — working in a mix of modern and legacy systems leading modernization efforts. **What You’ll Do:** * Maintain / modernize mission\-critical linux\-based applications straddling on\-prem and AWS environments * Own ongoing support as well as the design/roadmap for phased modernization (including research, requirements gathering, architecture, design, and rollout) * Research and learn specialized legacy systems including Apache Nifi * Operate in multiple application stacks including Python/Django/PostgreSQL and PHP/mySQL * Manage cloud\-hybrid environments covering on\-prem virtual servers and AWS kubernetes * Design and implement series of cross\-app integrations with protocols including REST, SOAP, SFTP, HL7 and FHIR * Routinely work with a core platform team of engineers, contributing technical leadership, code reviews, and support in day\-to\-day development work * Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, customers, and external partners to understand business needs and translate them into effective technical solutions * Drive engineering objectives and KPIs across product delivery, team performance, software quality, and system security * Promote a culture of clean, maintainable code and continuous improvement through refactoring, technical debt management, and adoption of engineering best practices * Champion modern DevOps and CI/CD practices, including feature toggles, automated testing, observability (logging and monitoring), and frequent deployments * Investigate and resolve technical issues, including authentication failures, data mapping errors, and data ingestion anomalies * Use AI\-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery while maintaining code quality * Contribute to a collaborative, respectful team environment that values learning, transparency, knowledge sharing, and accountability **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of full\-stack software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on Python development (Django or a comparable framework) * **PHP/Laravel experience is a strong plus**—portions of our platform run on Laravel * **Proven track record with l**arge\-scale modernization – Experience with planning multi\-phase modernization of mission critical legacy systems is a must * Experience with a modern front\-end framework such as React or Vue * Experience with relational databases (MySQL/Postgres) and scalable cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS * Hands\-on experience designing and troubleshooting REST and SOAP API integrations, including flat\-file and SFTP\-based exchanges * Experience with data integration and ETL tools (e.g., Apache NiFi, Snowflake, AWS S3\) is a plus * Knowledge of secure authentication and authorization standards, including OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and SAML * Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, code reviews, and modern DevOps practices * Demonstrated ability to set technical direction, and drive performance against team KPIs (delivery velocity, code quality, security, and uptime) * Excellent collaboration and communication skills; self\-motivated and effective working independently in a remote\-first environment * Bonus: experience with healthcare data formats (HL7, FHIR, X12\), EMR systems and APIs, or additional languages such as C\#/.NET or Java **Location:** * Remote **Physical Requirements:** * Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. * Multiple video meetings each day where web camera use is required. **Schedule:** * Full time, 40 hours each week * Monday through Friday, core business hours of 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM locally with occasional flexibility for collaboration across time zones or to meet critical deadlines.

jobs.title: AI Innovation Associate
jobs.description: **Aculocity AI Student Innovation Lab** **AI Innovation Associate** **Aculocity AI Innovation Lab** Build what comes next in enterprise AI. **Remote. Paid.** **\~20** **hrs./Week.** **T****urn** **AI knowledge into real enterprise impact.** **This is not a traditional internship.** It is a program that gives you hands\-on experience designing the next generation of AI\-enabled enterprises while working on real business problems, real systems and real outcomes.**THE FUTURE STARTS HERE** ========================== Artificial Intelligence is reshaping industries, companies and careers at extraordinary speed. The question is no longer whether AI will transform the world. The question is who will build that future. At Aculocity, we believe the next generation of AI leaders should not wait until the next graduation to make an impact. Through the Aculocity AI Innovation Lab, a select group of students will work alongside AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Software Engineers, Architects and Business Leaders to solve real\-world challenges across manufacturing, commercial vehicles, engineering, supply chain, finance and digital operations. As an Aculocity AI Innovation Associate, you will gain access to enterprise\-scale AI initiatives, modern platforms, experienced mentors and opportunities that most students do not encounter until years into their careers. **ABOUT ACULOCITY** =================== Aculocity is the AI, Data, Technology and Digital Transformation organization within the GVW Group, a global group of companies operating across commercial vehicles, manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, retail, financial services and industrial technologies. Our mission is to help transform these businesses through artificial intelligence, modern data platforms, automation and digital innovation. Every day, we solve complex enterprise challenges that improve how vehicles are designed, built, sold, serviced and supported, while enabling smarter operations and better decision\-making across the Group. **Why** **this matters** You will not be working on theoretical exercises. You will be contributing to initiatives connected to real business needs, real enterprise data environments and measurable operational impact.**OUR INNOVATION PROGRAM** ========================== This associate program is designed for students who want more than a standard internship. We are looking for future builders, innovators and leaders who are ready to challenge themselves in a serious enterprise environment. Only a small cohort of students will be selected to join the Innovation Lab. Successful associates will demonstrate technical ability, intellectual curiosity, strong communication skills and a passion for applying AI to create business value. **YOU SHOULD APPLY IF YOU WANT TO** * Work on AI that reaches beyond the classroom. * Learn directly from experienced industry practitioners. * Build a portfolio of meaningful, enterprise\-scale AI work. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams solving complex problems. * Be part of a selective cohort focused on the future of applied AI. **WHAT YOU MIGHT HELP BUILD** ============================= Depending on project needs, your interests and your skills, you may contribute to initiatives such as: * Building AI\-powered applications using Large Language Models (LLMs). * Developing intelligent AI agents and enterprise copilots. * Applying machine learning to solve operational and business challenges. * Designing proof\-of\-concepts using emerging AI technologies. * Exploring Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) and enterprise knowledge management. * Working with real\-world enterprise datasets to uncover insights and improve decision\-making. * Developing predictive, optimization and analytics solutions. * Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver innovative AI solutions. * Researching and evaluating emerging AI tools, frameworks and techniques. **WHY THIS EXPERIENCE IS DIFFERENT** ==================================== *Most student programs ask you to observe.* **This** **associate program** **asks you to contribute.** *Most internships expose you to one team.* **This experience exposes you to** **real business problems****.** *Most academic projects stop at a prototype.* **Here,** **you will solve real business problems****.** *Most early\-career AI* *experience is* *narrow.* **This** **associate program** **helps you understand how AI, data, software, business process and change management come together in the real world.** **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR** =========================== We are looking for exceptional students who are curious, innovative and passionate about applying technology to solve meaningful real\-world problems. * Currently enrolled in, or recently completed, an undergraduate or graduate program in Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics or a related quantitative disci hms or statistics. * Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills. * The ability to communicate effectively and collaborate within multidisciplinary teams. * Curiosity, creativity and a desire to explore AI technologies. * A genuine interest in applying AI to create measurable business value. * Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. **BENEFICIAL EXPERIENCE** ========================= Experience with any of the following would be advantageous, but is not required: * Generative AI and Large Language Models * Prompt engineering * Machine learning frameworks * SQL and data analytics * Working with APIs, software integration, automation or enterprise platforms * Microsoft Fabric, Power BI or modern analytics platforms **What matters most** Exceptional students come from diverse academic backgrounds. We are more interested in your ability to learn, innovate, collaborate and solve problems than your experience with any single technology.**WHAT SUCCESSFUL** **ASSOCIATES** **TAKE AWAY** ================================================ * Hands\-on experience developing enterprise AI solutions. * Mentorship from experienced AI Engineers, Data Scientists and business leaders. * Exposure to enterprise\-scale AI, data and digital transformation initiatives. * Experience working with multidisciplinary teams on business\-critical projects. * Access to modern AI platforms, cloud technologies and enterprise data environments. * A stronger professional portfolio built around meaningful AI projects. * Professional networking opportunities across Aculocity and the GVW Group. * A deeper understanding of how AI is transforming enterprises. * Potential future employment opportunities following successful completion of the associate program. **PROGRAM DETAILS** =================== **Area** **Details** **Time commitment** Approximately 20 hours per week. Work Location: Remote. Applicants must reside and perform their work in Alabama, Georgia, Idaho, Indiana, North Carolina, Ohio, or Tennessee. **Schedule** Flexible scheduling to accommodate academic commitments **Initial engagement** 6 to 12 months, with the possibility of extension **Compensation** Hourly compensation **WHY JOIN THE INNOVATION LAB?** ================================ Artificial Intelligence is transforming every industry. While many organizations are exploring AI, few can offer students the chance to apply it across the breadth and complexity of a global industrial enterprise. As an AI Innovation Associate, you will work where AI meets manufacturing, engineering, commercial vehicles, automation, supply chains, finance, enterprise operations and real\-world decision\-making. You will collaborate with experienced professionals, tackle meaningful business challenges and help build practical AI solutions designed to deliver measurable impact. **Build what comes next** If you are passionate about solving complex problems, excited by emerging technologies and ready to help shape the future of enterprise AI, we invite you to apply to the Aculocity AI Student Innovation Lab. **The future will be shaped by those who create it.** Job Duties Disclaimer:*The duties and responsibilities outlined here are representative but not exhaustive of the tasks that the employee may**be required**to perform. Management reserves the right to modify, add, or remove duties and to assign other tasks as necessary to meet business needs.* Equal Employment Opportunity: *The Company**is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for* *employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law.* Reasonable Accommodations (ADA Compliance):*The Company* *complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Employees who require assistance or accommodation should contact Human Resources.*
