jobs.title: Senior Data Architect
jobs.description: Opportunity As a Senior Customer Experience Orchestration Data Architect at Adobe, you will lead the development of advanced, secure data solutions for our innovative digital marketing platforms. We craft data strategy, architecture, SQL and governance for customer solutions, including end\-to\-end profiles, segmentation, journeys, and campaigns! What You’ll Do Provide deep experience to build data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy. Engage closely with customers and Adobe team to facilitate data discovery by evaluating systems and business processes. Analyze customer sources, data movement, data granularity, relationships, data format, etc. Unify disparate data (e.g., sales, CRM, analytics data, etc.) to meet customers’ digital marketing use cases. Lead and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for multi\-solution delivery. Establish frameworks for data quality, define standards, master data management, data services, data governance, data modeling, tools, data security, privacy, and compliance with industry regulations (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.). We develop and champion data architecture guidelines via detailed documentation. These encompass architectural blueprints, ERDs, data flow diagrams, source\-to\-target mappings, data dictionaries, metadata catalogs, governance frameworks, guardrails, and security and compliance protocols. We engage with cross\-disciplinary groups and Adobe professionals to identify customer demands. We provide data layout and strategic blueprints, advocating for scalable, secure resolutions. Assume the role of a liaison to promptly tackle technical obstacles. We develop strategies for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations, while aligning with customers’ objectives. We deliver mentorship on data architecture to customers and consultants to align work with targets. We deliver Adobe platform data lake and real\-time customer profile to get ready for data ingestion and activation. Employ REST APIs, Postman, and basic scripting to automate and streamline the implementation and setup. Develop and construct data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing, online and offline data within AEP. Collaborate with data engineers to develop and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for data collection and extraction. We improve data query performance across platforms by tuning models and adhering to guidelines and ensure product guardrails are followed and deployed in solutions Requirements Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field or equivalent experience. 10\+ years of data architecture, modeling, SQL, and working with customers! Expert proficiency in crafting customer\-centric database models, datasets (e.g., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.) with relational, hierarchical (e.g., RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer modeling, Data Lakes, OLTP \& OLAP, etc.). Advanced skills in SQL development (e.g., functions, data transformations, arrays, joins details, stored procedures, data analysis). Deep experience in t ranslating business requirements into scalable data architecture by conducting structured analysis of data workflows and processes Demonstrate outstanding organizational skills and ability to balance customer projects concurrently with strong verbal, written communication skills and previous experience with customer\-facing engagements Special Consideration given for Hands\-on use or administration of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) Deep domain expertise in one or more industries (Retail, Telecom, Healthcare, Automotive, Cloud and Streaming platforms, etc.) Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python or Bash scripting) About Adobe Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity. Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours. Let’s Adobe together At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create. Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more. Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com . **AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:** Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. The use of AI or recording tools during live interviews is not permitted unless explicitly invited by the interviewer or approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process. At Adobe, we empower employees to innovate with AI — and we look for candidates eager to do the same. As part of the hiring experience, we provide clear guidance on where AI is encouraged during the process and where it’s restricted during live interviews. See how we think about AI in the hiring experience . **Expected Pay Range:** Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets, and we pay differently based on those defined markets. The U.S. pay range for this position is $146,800 \- $263,900 annually. Pay within this range varies by work location and may also depend on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for the job location during the hiring process. In California, the pay range for this position is $182,300 \- $263,900 In New York, the pay range for this position is $182,300 \- $263,900 In Washington, the pay range for this position is $171,600 \- $248,600 At Adobe, for sales roles starting salaries are expressed as total target compensation (TTC \= base \+ commission), and short\-term incentives are in the form of sales commission plans. Non\-sales roles starting salaries are expressed as base salary and short\-term incentives are in the form of the Annual Incentive Plan (AIP). In addition, certain roles may be eligible for long\-term incentives in the form of a new hire equity award. **State\-Specific Notices:** **California :** Fair Chance Ordinances Adobe will consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records for employment in accordance with state and local laws and “fair chance” ordinances. **Colorado:** Application Window Notice If this role is open to hiring in Colorado (as listed on the job posting), the application window will remain open until at least the date and time stated above in Pacific Time, in compliance with Colorado pay transparency regulations. If this role does not have Colorado listed as a hiring location, no specific application window applies, and the posting may close at any time based on hiring needs. **Massachusetts:** Massachusetts Legal Notice It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: **United States (Remote)** **About us** Advanced Solutions International is a global software company focused on helping not\-for\-profits and membership organizations grow revenue, reduce expenses, improve performance, engage and serve members and donors through innovative software solutions. Our portfolio of solutions includes the iMIS Engagement Management System, TopClass LMS, OpenWater application and review software, and the Clowder mobile app. **About our position** ASI is looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the payments and finance experience in iMIS: the systems that let our clients collect dues, donations, registrations, and other transactions reliably and securely. You will take over an active roadmap spanning gateway integrations, compliance, and reconciliation, alongside a broad remit across the wider ASI product suite, and you will partner closely with engineering, finance, compliance, and our payment processing partners. The ideal candidate combines strong product judgment, technical curiosity, customer empathy and the business and financial fluency to reason about payments economics. You should be comfortable working directly with AI tools, evaluating model behavior, and turning ideas into working prototypes quickly. . We want a product leader who investigates problems personally, forms strong points of view, prototypes solutions, works hands\-on with customers, and remains accountable for the product's actual outcomes. You will also be a public voice for iMIS, presenting conference sessions, webinars, user group meetings, and release demos to internal stakeholders, clients, partners, and prospects. **What you’ll be doing** * Owning the product strategy and roadmap for iMIS payment processing: card, ACH, digital wallets, alternative payment methods, gateway integrations, and reconciliation workflows. * Working alongside the VP of Strategic Partnerships and CPO to define the broader payments strategy for ASI’s core products in order to grow GPV across the platform. * Writing clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and evaluation scenarios. * Developing and utilizing AI tooling to synthesize customer interviews ,support tickets, usage data, gateway logs, sales feedback, and operational patterns. * Building UX prototypes using AI design/ development tools to communicate product vision and gather feedback before committing engineering resources. * Defining and monitoring payments health metrics: transaction success rates, chargeback and dispute rates, reconciliation accuracy, and processing costs. * Managing relationships with payment gateway and processor partners, including commercial and technical escalations. * Partnering with engineering and compliance to maintain PCI\-DSS scope and manage audits. * Working with Technical Support to reproduce, prioritize, and resolve client issues as needed. * Representing iMIS payments to clients, partners, and prospects at conferences, webinars, user group meetings, and release demos. * Involvement in product roadmap and specifications for other ASI products and features as needed. Performing other job\-related duties and responsibilities as assigned. * **What we want you to have** * A bachelor's degree in business, computer science, information science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of product management experience, preferably with B2B or enterprise SaaS products, and a demonstrated record of taking products or major features from discovery through launch to measurable adoption. * Experience shaping payments strategy at the platform level, including take rate, GPV growth, and pricing economics, and partnering with business development or partnerships teams to drive it. * Meaningful time spent owning a payments, fintech, or billing product, with the breadth to speak credibly about an entire platform. * Working knowledge of payment processing fundamentals: gateways, processors, PCI\-DSS, ACH and card networks, chargebacks and disputes. * Hands\-on experience using generative AI tools for meaningful product or operational work. Be prepared to walk us through a prototype you built yourself, an analysis you ran and then verified, a recurring part of your workflow that you automated, and a case where you decided against using AI and why. * The ability to translate ambiguous customer problems into clear product decisions, with strong judgment about user experience, tradeoffs, sequencing, and scope. * Experience working closely with engineers, designers, customers and partners. * Solid interpersonal skills and strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present tradeoffs to both engineers and executives. * Demonstrated public speaking ability: conference sessions, webinars, user group meetings, or client briefings in front of external audiences. * An excellent ability to collaborate with others, both in person and remotely. Hands\-on experience with iMIS or a comparable association management system (AMS), non\-profit technology, or membership and CRM software preferred * **What we offer** At ASI, we've forged an employee\-first culture, fostering a dynamic and cohesive environment where collaboration thrives, and continuous improvement is our focus. Over the past 30 years, we’ve established a solid foundation for long\-term success by empowering our team to challenge the status quo and driving positive change by encouraging new ideas, fresh perspectives, and positive attitudes. **Compensation** The compensation for this position is determined based on a wide variety of factors, including but not limited to an individual’s skill set, experience, training, certifications, education, and geographic location, as well as business needs and internal equity. A reasonable estimate of the current compensation range for this position is $125,000 \- $145,000\. **Benefits** In addition to a competitive base salary and bonuses for eligible positions, we offer a competitive and comprehensive benefits package, which includes: * Generous Paid Time Off * Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Life and AD\&D Insurance * Flexible Spending Account * Healthcare Savings Account * Wellness Benefits * 401k Retirement Plan with Discretionary Match * Opportunities for Professional Growth and Development * Volunteer Time Off * Study Leave * Employee Assistance Program Hybrid Remote Work ***Join our team and positively impact thousands of ASI customers around the world!*** **www.advsol.com/careers** ASI provides equal opportunities to all employees and qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, marital status, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected category. *Applicants requiring accommodation in the application and/or interview process should notify the ASI Human Resources Department at* hrdept@advsol.com . jobs.title: Events Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description: **About ADVOC8** At ADVOC8, we create experiences that build trust, shift minds and win hearts. Our special sauce? Chemistry, collaboration and an endless supply of curiosity. We're a team of strategic thinkers, creative problem\-solvers, thoughtful storytellers and logistical magicians expertly bringing ideas to life from strategy and creative through to production and execution. We work with brands, nonprofits and associations to create experiences that make an impact. And we do this all in a flexible 'work from anywhere' environment where we celebrate differences and encourage each of our 'advocates' to bring their unique perspectives to the table each and every day. **About \&drop** ================ \&drop is the brand merchandise and promotional products division of ADVOC8 creative agency, serving major brand clients including Google, YouTube, TikTok, and PokémonGO. We specialize in strategic, creative merchandise solutions from complex event kits and experiential programs to comprehensive branded goods strategies. We're a boutique agency that thinks like a creative partner, not a commodity distributor.**The Role** ------------ We're looking for an Event Logistics Coordinator who's been in the trenches at events and knows what it's like to unpack a kit on\-site. This role bridges event production reality and warehouse operations — you'll manage complex event kits from our facility while anticipating what teams need in the field. You'll spend 60% of your time on the warehouse floor ensuring kits are packed correctly, labeled clearly, and ready to ship, and 40% planning, problem\-solving, and interfacing with clients about logistics. This isn't just inventory management — it's understanding that a missing power strip can derail a $100K activation. This is an operations role, but you need event production DNA. You'll work within \&drop's operations team, collaborating closely with ADVOC8's event production team and communicating directly with clients about logistics planning and execution. This role reports to the Director of Operations and is **based in our Charlotte, NC, warehouse facility.** If you've ever been on\-site at an event and thought "I wish whoever packed this kit understood what we're dealing with here" — this role is for you. You'll be the person who makes sure that never happens to someone else.**What You'll Do** ------------------ ### **Event Kit Management \& Warehouse Operations (60%)** * Oversee preparation, packing, and quality control of event kits containing displays, branded elements, and activation materials * Ensure every component is included \- because you know what it's like to unpack a kit on\-site and find something missing * Direct warehouse associates and temps on daily kit assembly, following pull lists and pack lists * Maintain warehouse organization systems for complex, multi\-component event assets * Label and organize kits using event production nomenclature (not just "box 1, box 2") * Troubleshoot packing challenges in real\-time \- figure out creative solutions when plan A doesn't work * Keep warehouse areas orderly, assets properly stored, and inventory systems current ### **Client Communication \& Strategic Planning (30%)** * Interface directly with clients about production logistics, shipment timelines, and specifications * Participate in planning calls to understand event needs and translate them into warehouse execution * Anticipate on\-site requirements based on your field experience (tools, backup materials, assembly considerations) * Proactively communicate shipment status and flag potential issues before they become problems * Know when you can solve problems independently vs. when to escalate * Build trust with clients through confident, clear communication about logistics realities ### **Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Systems (10%)** * Work daily within Google Workspace and warehouse management systems * Collaborate with ADVOC8's event production team on program planning and execution requirements * Create and maintain documentation for recurring event programs * Track kit inventory, flag reorder needs, and manage asset lifecycle * Troubleshoot tech issues and adapt to new platforms quickly * Identify process improvements to increase efficiency and reduce errors **What You Bring** ------------------ ### **Must\-Haves** * Hands\-on warehouse experience — on the floor, comfortable with equipment, and physically handling assets, not adjacent to warehouse operations * Real system ownership — you own inventory, orders, and asset records in an actual system, not a spreadsheet checkout sheet * Scenic and fabricated asset experience — on the intake, install, and lifecycle side, not sourcing and ordering — we manage roughly 700 scenic assets, many of them multi\-piece * Procedure discipline — nothing moves without a paper trail, and you hold that line * A process improver's mindset — willing to push back and improve process rather than just inherit it * Organ  season with multiple programs running * You spot potential problems three steps ahead and already have plan B ready * You can talk fluently with both warehouse staff and brand managers * Production team and clients view you as the logistics expert who makes their lives easier **What We Offer** ----------------- Compensation: $60\-70K depending on experience Growth: Clear path into project/production management and operations leadership as programs scale Impact: Build operational systems and processes for a growing division serving major tech and entertainment brands Learning: Work cross\-functionally with creative agency production team while developing logistics expertise Environment: Small collaborative team with direct access to leadership Clients: Support high\-profile programs for YouTube, Google, TikTok, Niantic, and other innovative brands**Location \& Logistics** ------------------------- * **Based in Charlotte, NC warehouse facility** * Open to candidates within a reasonable driving distance of Charlotte — this is not a remote position, but you don't need to already live in the city itself * Occasional travel to client sites or vendor facilities possible but not frequent * Standard business hours with occasional flexibility needed for event timelines **OTHER REQUIREMENTS*** Successful completion of a background check **BENEFITS*** Collaborative and creative work environment * Competitive base salary, with additional performance\-based incentives * Health Insurance: 100% coverage of base level medical insurance plus buy up options to meet the needs of you and your family * Health Insurance: Dental and vision insurance * 401k, FSA, and stipend for mobile phone usage * Professional development and training reimbursements * Flexible work schedule * Unlimited vacation and personal time * Paid parental leave and Grandternity Leave Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.; at this time, we are not able to provide sponsorship. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply even if you don’t meet all qualifications. At ADVOC8, we are committed to fostering transparency and equity in compensation. Please note that this salary range is subject to change based on evolving market conditions, company budget, and other factors, and does not include potential bonuses, benefits, or other forms of compensation. Final compensation may vary depending on the candidate's negotiation, location, and the specific role's requirements. jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description: **Aegis Overview** Aegis operates at the intersection of data science and global brand integrity. We build proprietary intelligence systems that protect telecommunications companies from fraud, channel abuse, and partner risk — and we do it at scale, in real time, across multiple continents. Aegis utilizes the most sophisticated Internet and mobile web surveillance and capture tools available today to deliver: · Business Analysis and Analytics for Brand Protection and Compliance · Third Party Partner Risk Assessment, Onboarding, and Monitoring · Fraud Detection and Prevention for the Digital Customer Experience · Market Intelligence · Operational Insight and Transformation **Aegis Solutions** Aegis provides multi\-level investigative solutions to its clients through proprietary software tools that integrate and transform data into actionable information with intuitive user interfaces and dashboards. The Company operates two highly focused business units: · Brand Protection and Compliance · Multi\-source Business Intelligence and Analytics Every solution implementation is customized and integrated to meet the individual customer’s processes and objectives. In our brand and partner protection products and services, we “connect the dots” using proprietary software to create insight as well as partner and program visibility across business channels to improve performance, risk mitigation, profitability, revenue optimization, and management efficiency. We integrate our customers’ data with open\-source information from across the Internet to deliver customized, actionable, world class business intelligence. **Position: Data Scientist** We're looking for a Data Scientist who wants to own hard problems end\-to\-end: designing models, deploying them into production pipelines, and translating results into decisions that matter to senior stakeholders. This role sits inside our Data Intelligence Department alongside engineers, analysts, and domain experts who move fast and expect the same from you.This position is based in any one of Aegis Mobile’s offices in Tysons Corner, VA, Mobile, AL, or Columbia, MD, with the potential for hybrid or remote work. ***Job Summary*** We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytically strong Data Scientist to contribute to and create advanced data\-focused solutions supporting our global telecommunications clients. As a member of the Data Intelligence Department the ideal candidate will regularly integrate knowledge of data science, applied AI, and machine learning for predictive modeling and analysis. This is a position requiring focus and flexibility, independence, effective organizational skills, and a willingness to improvise when crafting novel solutions. As a member of the Data Intelligence Department the ideal candidate will investigate and capture the data and intelligence needed to deliver business analytics for brand protection, partner risk assessment, and operational insight and efficiency. This is a position requiring excellent analytical and communication skills, understanding of the software development lifecycle, and confidence in presenting to senior\-level stakeholders. **Key responsibilities:** · Design, build, and deploy predictive and ML models that support telecom fraud detection, partner risk scoring, and operational analytics. · Architect and maintain data pipelines — batch and real\-time — in Azure, and contribute to a scalable, well\-governed data ecosystem. · Build agentic AI workflows and LLM\-based applications using frameworks such as LangChain or Azure AI Studio, including RAG systems and enterprise workflow automation. · Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for non\-technical senior stakeholders — in writing and in person. · Create dashboards and analytical artifacts in Power BI that surface insights across business units. · Evaluate emerging AI/ML capabilities and prototype solutions for future deployment. · Collaborate across teams to identify and scope new opportunities for data science and AI integration. **Basic Qualifications:** · 4\+ years of professional experience in data science or ML engineering. · Advanced Python skills — production\-quality code, not just notebooks. · Strong command of SQL and Azure data services (Azure Data Factory, Synapse, or equivalent). · Hands\-on ML experience: feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment. · Familiarity with LLM workflows: embeddings, vector stores, RAG, and modern AI architecture. · Experience with Power BI or Tableau for stakeholder\-facing dashboards and reporting. · Version control discipline — Git or Azure Repos. · Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. · **Preferred Qualifications** · Experience implementing agentic AI workflows or LLM orchestration (LangChain, Azure AI Studio, Semantic Kernel, or similar). · Hands\-on work with Azure ML, Databricks, Foundry, or comparable MLOps platforms. · Background in anomaly detection, fraud modeling, or sentiment analysis. · Prior telecom industry experience. · Understanding of data governance, PII handling, and enterprise data security standards. **Additional Requirements** · In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification process upon hire. **Aegis is unable to provide employment sponsorship for this position.** *·* All people hired are required, without exception, to pass a criminal background check and a drug screen *· Candidates may be asked to provide references* **Why You’ll Want to Work with Aegis:** Aegis is an innovative, diverse, and dynamic company with tightly woven teams constantly exploring new ways to produce advantages for our clients. With offices in Virginia, Maryland, and Alabama, we provide opportunities to work in a variety of settings and use the collaborative brainpower around you to ask and answer interesting questions. You can expect to see the solutions you develop rapidly incorporated into our world class products and services that are critical to the global telecom industry. We have a broad range of backgrounds and interests: experts in fields such as finance, real estate, politics, naval engineering, law enforcement, and even professional equestrian sports come together to make an intriguing and educational work environment. We offer excellent benefits and competitive salaries. Find out more at www.aegismobile.com. Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Referral program * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Columbia, MD 21046

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Crypto
jobs.description: **Who We Are:** **Alpaca is a US\-headquartered, global leader in agent\-first brokerage infrastructure** for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more. Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional\-grade APIs. This includes broker\-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts. Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open\-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award\-winning, developer\-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it. **Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top\-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.** **Our Team Members:** We're a dynamic team of 400\+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond! We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply. **Your Role** ------------- As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for architecting, implementing, and maintaining the systems and services that form the foundation of Alpaca Crypto and empower millions of users who are trading billions of dollars worth of assets. For this role, we are seeking an experienced engineer who is obsessed with delivering defect\-free solutions, has proven experience architecting and building at scale, and who is not afraid of challenging conventions or voicing their opinions. In this role, you will have the autonomy to design and implement solutions to achieve defined goals while actively participating in defining those goals in cooperation with a cross\-functional team. **Things You Get To Do** ------------------------ * Design, build, and maintain Alpaca's crypto exchange and market\-making systems * Develop crypto wallet, funding, and tokenization services * Implement backend services and web applications * Maintain good software quality and test coverage * Participate in code reviews * Troubleshoot incidents and reported bugs * You may be asked to be on\-call to assist with engineering projects that are timely in nature **Who You Are (Must\-Haves)** ----------------------------- * Knowledge of trading systems and experience building exchanges, market\-making systems, matching engines, or other high\-throughput, low\-latency, regulated, fault\-tolerant financial systems * Experience in building crypto * BSc/MSc or equivalent experience in Computer Science or related field * Minimum 4 years of experience of backend software development * Experience with at least one modern programming language like GoLang, C/C\+\+ etc. Our platform is based in Golang * Experience with messaging queues and message brokers. * SQL or relational database skills * Hands\-on knowledge with Bash, Linux \& Docker. Kubernetes experience is a plus * Excited about what we are building at Alpaca **Who You Might Be (Nice\-to\-Haves)** -------------------------------------- * Experience with Kubernetes, CKA, CKAD certification * DevOps mindset is an asset * Experience with CI/CD * Good understanding of the financial market * Experience with major cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure) * Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies * Knowledge of microservice architectures * Knowledge of clean code principles ### **How We Take Care of You:** * Competitive Salary \& Stock Options * Health Benefits * New Hire Home\-Office Setup: One\-time USD $500 * Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card *Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.* *Recruitment Privacy Policy*

jobs.title: AV/IPTV Field Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** The AV Field Engineer’s primary responsibility shall be to adjust, test, configure and commission Audio Video \& IT systems, bringing projects to completion and ensuring quality. They must also understand design, demonstrate installation and commissioning techniques. The candidate must be able to understand large audio/video systems, have a solid technical background and have a understanding of video, audio, control, data/networking systems. The Field Engineer will work closely with the Field Manager, Engineers, Installers and Project Managers to provide both general and specific recommendations on installation standards, technologies, personnel, job specifics and implementation. For all types of systems, upon completion, the Field Engineer shall provide red lined drawings and, in some cases, may act as Project Supervisor. **Responsibilities:** * Attend project kick off meetings, providing your perspective of what’s needed to successfully commission AV systems. * Proactively identify areas of concern with system design, equipment integration, and end\-user functionality needs. * Read, analyze, and notate floorplans, elevations, sections, signal drawings, mounting and pin details. * Communicate with the client, project manager, and design engineer, providing accurate status updates, risk assessments, delay alerts, and suggestions. * Create, modify, \& test audio Digital Signal Processing (DSP) programs (Biamp, QSC, BSS). * Deploy and test control system programs (Crestron, Extron, QSC). * Configure, test, and verify operation of all AV system components, especially; projectors, displays, DSPs, amplifiers, speakers, control systems, video codecs, scalers, processors, transmitters \& receivers, wireless mics, recording devices, touch panels, etc. * Troubleshoot issues with IP networking, DHCP, DNS, routing protocols, multicast, IGMP, VoIP, SIP, and videoconferencing applications. * Occasionally pull and terminate all types of video, audio, and control cabling with 95% accuracy. * Complete system commissioning reports and perform system tests to verify proper functionality. * Serve as installation “quality control inspector” of all work performed by Alpha Video staff and contractors, ensuring safety and quality standards are met. * Provide effective end user training \& event support for commissioned systems. * Analyze and resolve service call escalations. * Provide occasional Tier 3 technical support to Alpha Video employees and clients. * Research new products to remain current as technology advances. * Other duties as assigned. **Requirements:** * Up to 70% travel, occasionally on a last\-minute basis. * Occasional evening and weekend work. * Complete and maintain an OSHA 30 Construction certification. * Ability to pass a background check. * Ability to obtain (shortly after hire) and maintain necessary gaming licenses. * Maintain a valid driver's license. **Qualifications:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * High level of organization. * High level of job site familiarity i.e. construction and corporate atmosphere. * Must be able to communicate effectively in a team. * Technical background. * Knowledge of A/V theory and IP networking. * Ability to read and comprehend CAD drawings, blueprints and technical drawings. * Hands on experience with audio/video switching, connectivity, routing, terminations and signal flow * Excellent soldering skills. * Must have excellent computer skills. * Solid knowledge of system configurations. * Audio Video systems configuration ability. * Audio design and theory. * Video design and theory. * Self\-motivated. * Resourceful. * Ability to solve unusual or unexpected problems. **Preferred:** * Knowledge of legacy and state\-of\-the\-art multimedia systems used in best\-in\-class conference centers and large venues. * Working knowledge for the configuration of Cisco, Zoom, Teams, Poly video platforms and hardware. * Wide variety of experience with AV equipment and control systems, including Extron, Crestron, Dante, Q\-Sys, Biamp, displays, LED walls, processors, etc. * Demonstrated expertise in configuring high and low\-end video projectors and displays such as Epson, Sony, Panasonic, Christie, etc. * Proficient understanding of LAN/WAN hardware and software for switches, hubs, routers, point\-to\-point data circuits via copper and fiber for audio, video and control In\-depth hands\-on knowledge of audio and video production tools such as cameras, switchers, monitors, live streaming systems, etc. and able to correctly set up and diagnose problems with such equipment. * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to supervise small teams. Sensitivity and tact in dealing with staff/partners/clients at different levels in a diverse environment. **Education/Experience:** * High school diploma or equivalent. * A minimum of five (5\) years relevant experience. * Bachelor’s degree preferred. **Computer Skills:** * Proficient with Microsoft Office, including Word, Outlook, and Excel. * AutoCAD and Bluebeam experience preferred. * Experience with Crestron Toolbox, and Extron Global Configurator, and Q\-Sys required. **Certificates and Licenses:** * CTS, CTS\-I. * Additional AV certification preferred. * Additional advanced or product specific certifications are preferred.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, AWS Invoicing
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Invoicing, Global Tax and Compliance team is looking for software development engineers with a strong sense of ownership and passion for delivering creative solutions for complex problems at "Amazon scale". You will design highly scalable systems, develop distributed services, and build solid platform solutions based on the real\-time customer data and demanding service\-level agreements. You will collaborate with some of the best engineers in the industry and work on some of the most complex challenges in large\-scale computing. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one\-on\-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. Key job responsibilities This role is responsible for transforming a critical billing, invoicing, tax infrastructure component into a scalable, multi\-tenant platform that supports complex enterprise customers with global tax obligations across multiple entities and jurisdictions. You will lead architecture decisions, drive engineering execution, and partner closely with product, tax compliance, and dependent platform teams to deliver capabilities that directly unblock AWS's largest strategic customers and international expansion. Platform abstraction design: Build scalable distributed systems and clear dat models that allow platform to evolve independently and rapidly. Cross\-team technical integration: Partner with Tax Profile, Tax Compliance and KYC, Tax Planning, and Marketplace teams to define interfaces, resolve dependency bottlenecks. Engineering excellence: Establish technical standards for the team including code quality, operational readiness, testing strategy, and scalability patterns. Alexa Endpoints sits at the heart of this transformation, the layer that brings the next\-generation Alexa to life on the devices customers use every day. We work directly at the intersection of AI technology and the Alexa app, building the systems that connect Alexa's intelligence to the hardware in customers' homes. More specifically, this role is on a team building the software and customer experiences that interface with the Alexa App to launch the next\-generation of Alexa devices. The team owns critical systems that bridge Alexa's cloud and on\-device capabilities, working closely with device, hardware, and software teams to deliver a seamless, world\-class experience. This team is considered strategic and has visibility with leadership at the highest levels. We're looking for the best and brightest across Amazon to help us realize and deliver this vision to our customers right away. The role offers a chance to build and launch device\-powered AI experiences from the ground up, and work closely with an exceptional group of product, engineering, hardware, and science leaders to shape the future of Alexa. Key job responsibilities * Influence the strategic direction and vision of the organization through an understanding of the intersection of business/customer needs and how these intersect with technical capabilities and opportunities across Alexa's cloud and device software. * Provide technical leadership, vision and career guidance to team members. * Create a culture of pride in engineering and operational excellence and drive best practices within teams and across the organization. * Be strategic about defining and building an engineering culture that takes ownership and delivers high performance engineering solutions. * Work closely with technical (engineering and science) teams, hardware/device teams, design, and product/program management in an agile environment to deliver the best technical designs and approaches. * Anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make trade\-offs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints — especially across the software/device boundary. jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer, Test Infrastructure (SITL/HITL)
jobs.description: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years. **About The Team** ------------------ The Sentry Tower Software team develops robotic systems that provide force protection capabilities, monitoring the perimeter of secure areas, land or sea, for approaching people, vehicles, and vessels. We live in a world where security officers are increasingly overwhelmed by sensor data feeds. Our products leverage advanced sensor fusion and autonomy to seamlessly render activity in the environment to Lattice's common operating picture. **About the Job** ----------------- Sentry Towers are robotic systems: motors, cameras, radars, radios, and sensor boards, running on NVIDIA Jetson compute in the field. Verifying that a system like this works means accounting for physical actuation, real sensor data, and hardware that fails in ways no unit test anticipates. We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to own our simulation and hardware test infrastructure and make automated, whole\-system testing the default for everything we ship. A regression that escapes here does not surface on a developer's laptop. It surfaces on a tower at a site someone has to fly to, guarding a perimeter that does not pause while we debug. You will work across both halves of the problem. Our software\-in\-the\-loop environments are declaratively defined multi\-node virtual towers, complete with a simulated ground control station, synthetic sensor feeds, and a game\-engine\-driven world, which lets us run whole\-system scenarios in CI with no hardware attached. Our hardware\-in\-the\-loop side drives real Jetson\-based towers through a board test server: provisioning them over the network, flashing firmware, installing full system images, and reporting results back through our CI pipeline on a nightly and weekend cadence. Both foundations are in place and working, so you are inheriting infrastructure rather than starting from nothing. What does not exist yet is most of what sits on top: the functional test suites, the scenario library, and the diagnostic tooling that turn a booting tower into a verified one are yours to design. Firmware integration, compute platform bring\-up, and both our Air Defense and Counter\-Intrusion business lines depend on this capability, and what you build becomes the standard they test against. Test infrastructure is a job where the wins are invisible and the failures are loud. You will spend real time on work nobody asks for by name: chasing intermittent failures to root cause instead of retrying them, waiting on hardware that is scarce and shared, and rebuilding coverage when a compute generation changes underneath you. The measure of the role is bugs that never reach a tower, which means much of your best work leaves no trace anyone thanks you for. Our Product: https://www.anduril.com/sentry **WHAT YOU'LL DO** ------------------ * Own and grow our SITL environments: add product variants and scenarios, keep the simulated sensor and video pipelines faithful enough to be trustworthy, and keep whole\-system test runtimes short enough to fit inside a normal development cycle. * Build out functional coverage on the HITL bench across the behavior that matters: motion control and trajectory execution, camera and sensor bring\-up, firmware update paths, network failover, and clean recovery from power loss and unexpected reboots. * Own the CI integration end to end: scheduling, dependency chaining between test stages, artifact and log capture, result reporting, and the flake triage that keeps a hardware pipeline trusted instead of ignored. * Grow the test platform continuously as the product line does. New compute generations, new payloads, and new product variants each need coverage, and keeping the framework ahead of the roadmap is the enduring core of this role. * Make failures diagnosable without touching the rig. Invest in log capture, serial console capture, and test artifacts so an engineer can root\-cause from the CI output alone. * Partner with hardware and manufacturing engineers to stand up the physical HITL benches, specifying the fixtures, switching, power control, and instrumentation needed to exercise towers unattended. This is a substantial upfront build with periodic expansion as new hardware arrives. * Partner with firmware, platform, and business l **NICE TO HAVE** ---------------- * Experience with robotics or vehicle simulation, whether game\-engine\-based (Unreal, Unity), Gazebo, Isaac Sim, or a custom in\-house simulator. * Familiarity with NVIDIA Jetson provisioning and flashing workflows. * Experience with virtualization and VM\-based integration testing, including GPU passthrough. * Background in hardware test engineering, HIL rigs, or manufacturing test systems. * Familiarity with CAN, serial protocols, or bus\-level diagnostic tooling. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including: ### **Benefits** At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you're supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. *For more information,* *Explore Our Benefits**.* ### **Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams** Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information. To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind: * **No Financial Requests:** Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates. * **Please always verify communications:** + Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will *only* come from an @anduril.com address. + Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com. * **Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach:** If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links. * **What to Do If You Suspect Fraud:** Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts. ### **Data Privacy** To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice/. By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third\-party service provider to conduct pre\-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third\-party service provider provides risk\-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public\-record information, and other lawful open\-source or commercial data sources. This third\-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: **The Blueprint (Role Profile)** -------------------------------- We are looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to join our flagship manufacturing plant in Lexington, SC. The incumbent will support our machining and assembly departments, providing daily operational support as well as assisting with the design of new process to better service customers. He or she will ensure capability exists to meet product specifications and quality standards while making recommendations for improvements to processes, methods and controls. The incumbent will report the Engineering Manager, but may take daily direction from one of our Manufacturing Engineers that is assigned to their respective area or department. He or she will also interact with Operators, Machinists, Supervisors and other management team members. Come build your future with us! **The Build (Responsibilities)** -------------------------------- * Develops Computer Numerical Control (CNC) programs for various types of machines (CNC lathes, vertical machining centers, horizontal machining centers, multi\-axis machines, Swiss Turn CNC Machines). * Utilize Esprit Cam or similar Cam systems such as Master Cam, or SurfCam * Establishes appropriate machining methods and tool sequences. * Conducts machine cycle time studies, sharing recommendations and information with team members and other leaders. * Assists in the evaluation and development of manufacturing processes by studying product requirements and researching, designing, modifying, and testing manufacturing methods and equipment. Utilizes ERP software. * Assists setup associates with process or tooling issues, recommending necessary fixturing and tooling used in manufacturing. * Analyzes and solves process and tool\-related problems, ensuring or increasing productivity. * Makes recommendations to modify or replace equipment when necessary to support demand or improve productivity. * Establish and update manufacturing standards (rates, BOM’s, etc.). * Ensure integrity of prints, bills of material, setup sheets and routings. * Leverages continuous improvement tools to drive improvements. * Implements plant capital program through selecting, justifying, and purchasing new equipment * Promotes safety awareness with other key members of the plant team. **The Toolbox (Qualifications)** -------------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in engineering or related field * Five years’ experience writing CNC programs in a machining environment * Broad understanding of turning and machining technologies and processes. * Demonstrated proficiency with CAD (solid modeling) and CAM software * Proficient with GD\&T * M \& G\-Code experience. * Professional and positive attitude as well as a passion for continuous improvement * Strong time management skills with the ability to effectively coordinate multiple projects * Aerospace experience is a plus * Experience in using Solid Works / Auto Cad and Esprit Cam is a plus * Experience with TB DECO and Tornos Swiss CNC machines is a plus

The company's custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards\-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com. **Role Overview** ----------------- Astera Labs is hiring a Principal Design Verification Engineer to own functional verification of our high\-speed SerDes/PHY IP — the connectivity engine powering rack\-scale AI infrastructure. You will architect verification environments, drive coverage closure, and ensure first\-pass silicon success on the analog/digital boundary that defines next\-generation AI systems. This is a high\-impact, hands\-on role at the heart of Astera Labs' hyper\-growth story. You'll partner directly with PHY analog/mixed\-signal designers, digital architects, and SoC integration teams to verify multi\-Gbps SerDes blocks that ship into the world's most advanced AI platforms, including UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/Gen 7, and Ethernet\-based connectivity products. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * **Verification Architecture \& Strategy** * + Architect UVM\-based verification environments for SerDes/PHY IP, including PMA, PCS, and PHY\-MAC interface layers + Define verification plans, coverage models, and sign\-off criteria for high\-speed serial link blocks + Drive methodology decisions across analog/mixed\-signal co\-simulation, gate\-level simulation, and emulation flows * **Execution \& Coverage Closure** * + Develop SystemVerilog/UVM testbenches, sequences, scoreboards, and reference models for multi\-Gbps SerDes lanes + Execute functional, performance, and corner\-case verification across equalization, CDR, training, and link bring\-up scenarios + Lead coverage analysis and closure, debug failures with designers, and drive regressions to clean tape\-out * **Physical Layer \& Protocol Verification** * + Verify PHY behavior against industry specifications including PCIe Gen 6/Gen 7, UALink, UCIe, and Ethernet PHY standards + Model and validate channel behavior, link training state machines, and analog handoff scenarios + Partner with analog/AMS designers on Real Number Modeling (RNM) and behavioral models for SerDes blocks * **Cross\-Functional Leadership** * + Mentor junior DV engineers and set technical direction across the verification team + Collaborate with SoC integration, firmware, post\-silicon validation, and customer engineering teams + Contribute to verification IP reuse strategy and tooling improvements across product lines **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field * 8\+ years of design verification experience on high\-speed SerDes, PHY, or mixed\-signal IP * Strong understanding of the physical layer, including equalization (CTLE, DFE, FFE), CDR, training sequences, and link bring\-up * Expert\-level proficiency in SystemVerilog and UVM * Hands\-on experience with analog/mixed\-signal co\-simulation and Real Number Modeling (RNM) * Working knowledge of one or more high\-speed serial protocols: PCIe, UALink, UCIe, Ethernet, or CXL **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering * Experience verifying PCIe Gen 6/Gen 7, UALink, or UCIe SerDes/PHY IP * Familiarity with emulation platforms (Palladium, Veloce, or ZeBu) and gate\-level simulation flows * Scripting proficiency in Python or Perl for verification automation and regression management * Experience supporting post\-silicon bring\-up and correlating pre\-silicon coverage with silicon results * Proven ability to lead technically across a multi\-disciplinary team in a fast\-paced environment Salary range is $160,000 to $200,000 depending on experience, level, and business need. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Innovate with purpose** At BILL, we believe in empowering the businesses that drive our economy. By replacing outdated financial processes with innovative tools, we help businesses—from startups to established brands—make smarter decisions and gain control of their operations. And we don't stop there: we're creating the future of financial automation so businesses can spend more time on what matters. Working here means you become part of a vision\-driven team that's ready to tackle challenges and build cutting\-edge solutions. We value purpose, drive, and curiosity—and we thrive in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment. We're remote\-first, with office spaces in San Jose, CA and Draper, UT — and opportunities to connect in person when it counts. BILLders collaborate to deliver real impact for businesses that need more time in their busy weeks. BILL builds high performing teams and we seek to hire the best talent for every role. We're committed to building a workplace that fosters inclusion and diverse perspectives, valuing each person's unique skills and experiences. We'd love to hear from you—you might be just what we're looking for, whether in this role or another. ✨ Let's give businesses more time for what matters. **Make your impact at a leading Fintech Company** BILL is looking for a Staff Software Engineer to build and scale our accounting software sync solutions. If you are passionate about building great products, excited about solving real\-world customer issues, enjoy mentoring junior engineers, and are interested in working on challenging problems on a daily basis, this is the job for you! This individual will be a member of the Sync team and will be responsible for designing and implementing scalable products for the BILL business payment network. Proven experience in leading, scoping, designing and implementing end\-to\-end software solutions is a must. **Sync Team:** The Sync team is responsible for building, maintaining, enhancing, and scaling deep two\-way synchronization solutions between BILL payment platform/network and all major accounting software products used by its customers. Used by nearly 90% of our paying Small Business customers, sync is one of the core features that allows our customers to keep their bills, payments and other data in sync with their accounting systems. The sync team is working on moonshot goals to improve our user experience by 10x and building new microservices in AWS to provide new features for customers to keep their data in sync with a variety of third party systems. **We'd love to chat if you have:** * 8\+ years of software development experience * Ability to lead a team of developers in building complex software solutions * Proven ability to take the product through all stages of development from concept to launch * Expertise with all aspects of SDLC including code reviews, unit testing, automation testing and CI/CD * Experience with system design * Expert\-level knowledge of Java, SQL and NoSQL databases * Expertise in making step\-function improvements in performance and scale of platforms * Business acumen \- able to leverage the platform to solve business problems * Passion for great products and building great customer experiences * Experience leveraging Gen AI technologies to accelerate software engineering by designing prompts, rigorously evaluating outputs, and integrating LLMs **Ideal to Have:** * Expertise with using AWS services to build microservices * Familiar with frontend development with React and Angular * Experience with dev tools like Splunk, Datadog, Mixpanel, LaunchDarkly etc. * Accounting domain knowledge (knows the basics of double\-entry accounting, General Ledger, AP/AR) * Knowledge and experience in one of \- accounting OR ERP OR FinTech (back\-end, e.g., Payments) * Some familiarity or interest with Machine Learning and Recommendation engines **What's in it for you?** Redefining how businesses automate their work is a fast\-paced, exciting, and fun environment. But we also have benefits and perks to ensure the magic isn't only experienced by our customers, but by our employees as well. Here is a preview of some of the amazing benefits here at BILL: * 100% paid employee health, dental, and vision plans (choose HMO, PPO, or HDHP) * HSA \& FSA accounts * Life Insurance, Long \& Short\-term disability coverage * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * 11\+ Observed holidays and wellness days and flexible time off * Employee Stock Purchase Program with employee discounts * Wellness \& Fitness initiatives * Employee recognition and referral programs * And much more Don't believe us? Check out our culture, benefits, and teams on our career site, LinkedIn Life, or YouTube pages. BILL is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe our best ideas come from the unique stories, perspectives, and experiences of our team members. We welcome people of all backgrounds, abilities, and identities to bring their authentic selves and contribute to our culture. jobs.title: Senior Engineer -AI Security, Systems Engineering & Developer Productivity
jobs.description: **Job Description:** At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day. Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits. We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths \- whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve. Bank of America is committed to an in\-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in\-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role\-specific responsibilities and business needs. At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us! **Job Description:** Seeking a highly technical, hands\-on Senior Engineer with deep Systems Engineering expertise to lead AI security, platform modernization, and developer productivity initiatives across Digital Technology. The role will drive secure adoption of AI capabilities, establish the roadmap for AI vulnerability management (including Mythos remediation), accelerate engineering modernization, and enable rapid release capabilities required to address emerging security threats and platform risks. This individual will serve as a technical leader, architect, and builder, developing solutions that improve engineering efficiency, strengthen security posture, and accelerate software delivery. This job is responsible for defining and leading the engineering approach for complex features to deliver significant business outcomes. Key responsibilities of the job include delivering complex features and technology, enabling development efficiencies, providing technical thought leadership based on conducting multiple software implementations, and applying both depth and breadth in a number of technical competencies. Additionally, this job is accountable for end\-to\-end solution design and delivery. **Responsibilities:** * Ensures that the design and engineering approach for complex features are consistent with the larger portfolio solution * Define the technology tool stack for the solution and evaluate and adapt new testing tool/framework/practices for team(s) * Enables team(s)/applications with Continuous Integration/Continuous Development (CI/CD) capabilities and engages with other technical stakeholders pertaining to efficient functioning of CI\-CD pipeline * Guides and influences team(s) on design and best practices for high code performance –e.g. pairing, code reviews * Provides end\-to\-end delivery of complex features, including automation, for either a single team or multiple teams, at the program level * Conducts research, design prototyping and other exploration activities such as evaluating new toolsets and components for release management, CI/CD, and features * Works with stakeholders to establish high\-level solution needs and with architects for technical requirements * Lead identification, triage, prioritization, and remediation of AI\-related vulnerabilities. * Build developer productivity solutions that accelerate secure software delivery. * Drive platform modernization initiatives, including JDK upgrades, framework upgrades, and technical debt reduction. * Enable rapid\-release capabilities for critical vulnerability remediation and security response. * Partner with Architecture, Security, Infrastructure, and Development teams to establish enterprise\-wide engineering standards. * Develop automation that reduces remediation lead times and improves engineering efficiency. * Champion secure AI adoption and establish best practices for AI\-powered software development. **Required Qualifications** * 7\+ years of software engineering, systems engineering, and platform engineering experience. * Strong hands\-on experience with large\-scale distributed systems, application architecture, and enterprise platform design. * Proven expertise in AI/LLM consumption patterns, AI platform integration, and secure AI application development. * Deep understanding of AI security risks, vulnerability management, and remediation practices. * Experience leading vulnerability remediation programs, including analysis, prioritization, and mitigation of AI\-related security findings (e.g., Mythos scans). * Experience developing remediation roadmaps and driving enterprise\-wide security modernization initiatives. * Strong knowledge of application security, secure coding practices, OWASP, authentication, authorization, encryption, and API security. * Hands\-on experience with Java ecosystem modernization, including JDK upgrades, dependency management, and framework modernization. * Experience designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, DevSecOps, and release engineering capabilities. * Strong cloud, containerization, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation experience. * Ability to provide technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and drive adoption of engineering standards and best practices. * Strong problem\-solving, architecture, and stakeholder management skills. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience building AI\-powered developer productivity tools and software engineering accelerators. * Experience with GitHub Copilot, Copilot Studio, GenAI development frameworks, prompt engineering, and agentic AI architectures. * Experience establishing rapid deployment models, including ad\-hoc and 48\-hour release capabilities for security remediation. * Knowledge of AI governance, model risk management, compliance, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with security scanning technologies, vulnerability assessment platforms, and automated remediation workflows. * Experience building reusable engineering platforms, developer portals, self\-service tooling, and platform engineering solutions. * Familiarity with enterprise observability, operational excellence, and SRE practices. * Experience leading large\-scale technology modernization programs across multiple business lines. * Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing architecture decisions at an enterprise level. * Financial services and regulated industry experience preferred. **Skills:** * Automation * Influence * Result Orientation * Stakeholder Management * Technical Strategy Development * Application Development * Architecture * Business Acumen * Risk Management * Solution Design * Agile Practices * Analytical Thinking * Collaboration * Data Management * Solution Delivery Process **Shift:** 1st shift (United States of America) **Hours Per Week:** 40
