jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer – Android
jobs.description: **Req \#** 207934 **Location** Skaneateles Falls, New York, United States **Job Category** Research and Development **Date posted** 09/21/2026 **Overview** ------------ This is where new knowledge is discovered. Baxter’s Research and Development teams work cross functionally to innovate, develop and introduce creative solutions for patients needs globally. From Scientists to Engineers, your work creates the products that save and sustain lives. * Support for Parents * Continuing Education/ Professional Development * Employee Health \& Well\-Being Benefits * Paid Time Off * 2 Days a Year to Volunteer **Success Profile** ------------------- What makes a successful Research and Development team member at Baxter? Take a look at some of the top traits we’re looking for and see if you’re a fit. * Courage * Action Oriented * Collaborates * Cultivates Innovation * Manages Ambiguity * Drives Results **This is where** your work makes a difference. At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond. Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results. Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride. **This is where your work saves lives** As a **Principal Android Software Engineer,** you will lead architecture and delivery of shared Android capabilities that power multiple clinical product applications worldwide. You will own significant portions of the Android system design—reusable services and libraries, hybrid WebView/React UI foundations, device connectivity patterns, and common clinical workflows—while mentoring engineers and raising the bar for quality in a regulated medical\-device environment. An ideal candidate brings deep hands\-on Android expertise, a clear technical vision for multi\-product platform software, and the ability to drive complex cross\-team decisions independently. Strong communication and collaboration with product teams, systems, hardware, and other platform partners are essential. **What you'll be doing:** * **Lead Platform Android Architecture and Delivery:** Define and evolve shared Android platform architecture (Kotlin services, DI, WebView/JS bridge patterns, messaging/broker integration, networking foundations) used by multiple product apps, and drive implementation of high\-reliability reusable capabilities. * **Own Cross\-Product Platform Capabilities:** Lead design and development of common on\-device building blocks such as authentication, clinical data and patient workflows, foreground services, camera and ML integration patterns, local networking, and secure peripheral/device connectivity APIs that product teams can adopt consistently. * **Enable Product Teams:** Partner with product engineering teams consuming the platform, gather requirements and feedback, publish clear contracts and guidance, and keep product apps aligned with platform conventions, versioning, and release trains. * **Raise Engineering Quality:** Set coding standards, lead design and code reviews, strengthen unit/instrumentation/automated test strategy, and guide CI/CD, static analysis, and release practices appropriate for medical software shared across products. * **Mentor and Multiply the Team:** Coach senior and mid\-level engineers, unblock technical issues, and establish patterns that improve velocity and long\-term maintainability across platform and consuming product software teams. * **Collaborate Cross\-Functionally:** Work with systems, hardware, clinical, and product partners to translate multi\-product needs into robust Android platform designs; represent Android technical trade\-offs in planning and design reviews. * **Document and Sustain:** Create and maintain architecture, design, and test documentation that supports regulated development, knowledge sharing, and sustaining engineering for shared platform components. **What you'll bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * 10\+ years of software development experience, including extensive Android application development. * Proven experience leading technical architecture and development across complex mobile platforms, shared services, or multi\-product ecosystems. * Expertise in Kotlin and modern Android development, including networking, dependency injection, multithreading/coroutines, APIs, and CI/CD practices. * Experience building reusable mobile SDKs, libraries, platform services, and scalable appli ents, with knowledge of compliance\-focused software development and a focus on delivering reliable, high\-quality applications. *Baxter is committed to supporting the needs for flexibility in the workplace. We do so through our flexible workplace policy which includes a required minimum number of days a week onsite. This policy provides the benefits of connecting and collaborating in\-person in support of our Mission. The flexible workplace policy is subject to local laws and legal requirements. At its discretion, Baxter may decide to adjust, suspend, or discontinue as business needs change.* We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. At Baxter, we are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. The estimated base salary for this position is $120,000\-$165,000 annually. The estimated range is meant to reflect an anticipated salary range for the position. We may pay more or less than of the anticipated range based upon market data and other factors, all of which are subject to change. Individual pay is based on upon location, skills and expertise, experience, and other relevant factors. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses. For questions about this, our pay philosophy, and available benefits, please speak to the recruiter if you decide to apply and are selected for an interview. **Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.** \#LI\-TV1 **US Benefits at Baxter (except for Puerto Rico)** This is where your well\-being matters. Baxter offers comprehensive compensation and benefits packages for eligible roles. Our health and well\-being benefits include medical and dental coverage that start on day one, as well as insurance coverage for basic life, accident, short\-term and long\-term disability, and business travel accident insurance. Financial and retirement benefits include the Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP), with the ability to purchase company stock at a discount, and the 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan (RSP), with options for employee contributions and company matching. We also offer Flexible Spending Accounts, educational assistance programs, and time\-off benefits such as paid holidays, paid time off ranging from 20 to 35 days based on length of service, family and medical leaves of absence, and paid parental leave. Additional benefits include commuting benefits, the Employee Discount Program, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), and childcare benefits. Join us and enjoy the competitive compensation and benefits we offer to our employees. For additional information regarding Baxter US Benefits, please speak with your recruiter or visit our Benefits site: Benefits \| Baxter **Equal Employment Opportunity** Baxter is an equal opportunity employer. To learn how you can protect yourself, review our Recruitment Fraud Notice.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Marketplace
jobs.description: As the **Senior Engineering Manager** with the **Marketplace** team, you will lead a team of engineers responsible for building and operating critical marketplace platform capabilities that power the growth and success of Best Buy's Marketplace ecosystem. You will drive the development of scalable seller, catalog, inventory, pricing, order management, fulfillment, and integration services that enable third\-party sellers to efficiently onboard, manage products and store insights, and deliver exceptional customer experiences. In this role, you will partner closely with product, engineering, business, and operations teams to define and execute the technical strategy for Marketplace platforms. You will ensure platform reliability, scalability, security, and operational excellence while enabling innovation and accelerating Marketplace growth. As a people leader, you will foster a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, collaboration, and engineering excellence while coaching and developing high\-performing teams. This role is hybrid, which means you will be required to work on site Tuesday through Thursday at the Best Buy corporate office in Richfield, Minnesota. You can work virtually from home or another non Best Buy location on Friday. The recruiter or hiring manager will provide more details during the hiring process. **What you’ll do*** Lead and develop engineering teams delivering Marketplace Platform capabilities, fostering a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous improvement, and innovation. * Architect and develop scalable solutions within a distributed CQRS, Event Sourced microservices architecture using Java Spring, leveraging Agentic AI as a core development tool. * Partner with product, architecture, UX, and business stakeholders to define priorities, technical strategy, and execution plans aligned to business objectives. * Drive predictable delivery across multiple initiatives by managing scope, timelines, risks, dependencies, and team capacity while promoting Agile and CI/CD best practices. * Provide technical leadership for modern cloud\-based and enterprise systems, ensuring high standards of quality, security, performance, scalability, reliability, and operational readiness. * Coach and mentor engineers while collaborating with platform and vendor teams to integrate new technologies, improve engineering effectiveness, and support long\-term business outcomes. **Basic Qualifications*** 5\+ years of relevant back\-end software engineering experience * Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field OR equivalent combination of education and/or experience * 4\+ years of experience as a software developer in standard web technologies like React, JavaScript, Java, Spring, Kafka, Rabbit, and Groovy. * 2\+ years managing and/or leading engineering teams to include day to day management and career development. * 2\+ years on monitoring and alerting tools sets like Splunk, Kibana, GoAlert, Grafana, Dynatrace and others. * 2\+ years of experience in GCP functions like Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Big Data, and BigQuery. * 2 or more years of experience with SQL / No SQL databases (AWS Aurora, Cassandra, PostGres, etc.) * 1\+ years of experience with Cloud Computing platforms (e.g., Amazon AWS, Google Cloud Platform etc.) **Preferred qualifications*** Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * Relevant professional experience in engineering, technology delivery, or platform development. * Experience managing engineering teams, including hiring, coaching, performance management, and career development. * Experience leading teams that build custom solutions using modern languages, cloud technologies, SDLC practices, and engineering tools. * Experience managing delivery across multiple products, programs, or cross\-functional initiatives with complex dependencies. * Experience working in retail, supply chain, order management or similar technology domains. **What’s in it for you** We’re committed to helping our people thrive at work and at home. Best Buy offers a range of benefits to support your overall well\-being and provide support as you need it, especially at key moments in your life. Our benefits include:* Competitive pay * Great employee discount * Financial savings and retirement resources * Support for your physical and mental well\-being Best Buy provides different types of leaves of absence (LOA) and potential pay sources to employees based on eligibility. The length of your LOA depends on your situation, where you live, your full\-time or part\-time employment status, and federal and state regulations. Intermittent or reduced\-schedule leave is also available for certain medical or family care leaves. Paid time off (vacation or PTO) is offered to full\-time and part\-time employees based on work location, employment status, salary or hourly status (exempt/non\-exempt), and years of continued or bridged service. Certain roles, where market norms demand it, are eligible for various forms of incentive pay to drive performance and offer recognition for achieving financial and strategic results. For more information about our incentive pay plans, including eligibility, please refer to our Incentive Programs Summary. For more information about benefits, LOA and paid time off, please refer to our Benefits Guide. **About us** As part of the Best Buy team, you’ll help us fulfill our purpose to enrich lives through technology. We bring that to life every day by humanizing and personalizing tech solutions for every stage of life — in our stores, online and in customers’ homes. Our culture is built on deeply supporting and valuing our amazing employees who make it all possible. We’re committed to being a great place to work, where you can unlock unique career possibilities. Above all, we aim to provide a place where you can bring your full, authentic self to work now and into the future. Tomorrow works here.™ Best Buy is an equal opportunity employer. **Application deadline:** Minimum of 5 days from the posting date. You can find that date above the job title at the top of the page. Position Type: Full time

jobs.title: Director of Business Developement & Healthcare Partnerships
jobs.description: THE OPPORTUNITY Big Star Transit operates specialized passenger transportation across markets in Texas, Ohio, Michigan, Pennsylvania, Florida, Georgia, Oregon, and California. We run ADA paratransit and microtransit for eight\-plus public transit authorities We are now entering healthcare directly, and this role owns that. The opening is not a better van. It is a technology gap. Our PiVit Connex platform is multi\-tenant and contract\-aware, with native will\-call return management, real\-time eligibility verification, and a direct Uber Health integration. Our Orion TCMS gives clients a live audit portal showing credential status for every driver and vehicle. That combination lets us manage a healthcare organization's entire transportation function, including their own vehicles and drivers, not just the trips we drive. That means we are not selling rides. We are selling the coordination layer, on management agreements and recurring\-revenue structures, to buyers who carry real financial risk on whether patients get to care: dialysis organizations, PACE programs, and health systems. This is a genuine build. You will be our first dedicated healthcare seller. There is no existing playbook, no inherited pipeline, and no healthcare reference account to lean on. What there is: real operating scale, deployed vehicles and drivers in eight markets, a technology platform, and a company willing to put fee at risk to win the first accounts. If that sounds like a problem, this is the wrong role. If it sounds like the reason to take it, keep reading. WHAT YOU WILL OWN ● Build the healthcare book from zero across three segments, in this priority order: PACE organizations, dialysis chains and independent clinics, then health systems. ● Sell platform and management agreements, not per\-trip work. PMPM structures for PACE, subscription and panel pricing for dialysis, retainer\-plus\-overage for health systems. ● Own the full cycle: territory mapping, prospecting, clinical and operational discovery, solution design, pricing, contracting, and handoff to operations. ● Demo the technology yourself. You will run live PiVit Connex and Orion walkthroughs in customer meetings. This is central to the sale, not a hand\-off to a sales engineer. ● Lead with the buyer's metrics, never ours: post\-treatment wait time, center attendance rate, missed treatment rate, discharge\-to\-departure time, cost per participant per month. ● Sell into deployed capacity first. We have vehicles and drivers already funded by transit contracts and idle in the midday window. You will work with operations to identify that capacity and price against it. ● Price for margin. You are measured on contribution margin, not bookings, and you will have real authority over how deals are structured. ● Open new markets through existing customers. Our asset\-light model lets us stand up capacity anywhere in roughly 60 days. ● As the book scales, hire and lead the healthcare sales team. WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR We care much more about what you have sold and to whom than how long you have sold it. The strongest candidates come from one of these backgrounds: ● Renal care: DaVita, Fresenius, US Renal Care, Satellite, American Renal, or a vascular access or home dialysis organization. ● Risk\-bearing or capitated care: PACE operators, D\-SNP or MA plans, value\-based care enablement, or population health services sold on PMPM or shared\-risk structures. ● Payer, broker, or care logistics: regional account leadership at ModivCare, MTM, SafeRide, Verida, Alivi, a Medicaid MCO, or a patient logistics platform. ● Post\-acute services sold into health systems: home health, SNF, hospice, DME, or infusion. REQUIREMENTS ● 5\+ years selling services into dialysis organizations, PACE or capitated providers, payers, health systems, or post\-acute providers. HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED We do not set a 90\-day revenue quota on a healthcare sales cycle. Here is the actual ramp: ● Days 1 to 90: Target accounts mapped against our deployed capacity in Dallas–Fort Worth and Columbus, with the transportation decision maker identified at each. 20 first meetings held. ● Days 91 to 180: First one to two agreements signed, expected to be PACE or dialysis. ● Days 181 to 270: First health system opportunity opened. Three to four additional agreements signed. First new\-market pilot structured through an existing customer. ● Days 271 to 365: Judged on signed annualized contribution margin and on the share of that revenue in recurring structures. WHY BIG STAR ● Technology that is actually differentiated. Will\-call return management, multi\-tenant contract\-aware dispatch, live client\-facing compliance auditing, and a native Uber Health integration. Most competitors in this space demo nothing at all. ● Deployed capacity to sell against. Vehicles and drivers already funded and on the ground in eight markets, with real idle capacity in the exact windows healthcare demand falls. ● WAV depth. It opens doors nothing else opens. ● Certified DBE, MBE, and SBE, which creates procurement access most competitors do not have. ● A company that will back you. We will put fee at risk, run paid pilots, and stand up capacity in a new market to win an account. You will not lose deals because leadership would not move. ● Direct access. You report to the CRO, you shape pricing and positioning, and you build the team behind you. ● Compensation tied to profitability and to recurring revenue, not vanity bookings. template debugging * **Observability** — Prometheus/Grafana stack; OpenTelemetry, Mimir, or Loki a plus * **SRE** **practices** — SLOs/SLIs, error budgets, incident response, blameless postmortems * **AI**/**LLM** fluency — Daily use of AI coding tools; prompt engineering, code generation, critical evaluation of LLM output **What You Should Have** * K8s Ecosystem: Karpenter, Cilium, KEDA, Kyverno, External Secrets, cert\-manager, Argo Rollouts/Kargo * IaC \& CI/CD: Terraform/Terragrunt module authoring, Atlantis, GitHub Actions (composite actions \+ reusable workflows), ArgoCD ApplicationSets, ECR image lifecycle Migration: Jenkins GHA, ECS EKS, CloudFormation* Terraform, monolith decomposition * Languages: TypeScript/Node.js (primary ecosystem), Python, Go (bonus), Bash * AWS: EKS, ECR, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, DocumentDB, Elasticsearch, S3, SQS, EventBridge, IAM/OIDC, Cognito, SSM, VPC, Route53, CloudFront, CloudWatch, Athena, Organizations * Observability: Grafana, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry (Collector \+ SDK), Prometheus, PagerDuty * Cloudflare: CDN, DNS, WAF, Bot Management, Workers (TypeScript/Hono, KV, R2\), Terraform at scale, Logpush * AI \& Automation: Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot, MCP server integrations, prompt engineering for infrastructure tasks * Bonus: Envoy Gateway, FinOps, Snowflake, prior software development experience **What You'll Receive** * **Hybrid** **Work** **Flexibility**: Embrace a balanced work model with remote work on Mondays and Fridays and in\-office collaboration from Tuesday to Thursday. * **Generous** **Time** **Off**: With a strong focus on work/life balance, we offer all employees paid time off starting on day one, multiple paid holidays throughout the year, your birthday off, and a winter break at the end of the year * **Volunteering** **Time**: Participate in our volunteer program with 4 paid days annually to contribute to your community. * **Modern** **Office** **Perks**: Our vibrant Miami office features cutting\-edge amenities, such as an electric sit/stand desk, dual monitors, a gym, and a variety of snacks and beverages. * **Comprehensive** **Benefits** **Package**: Enjoy top\-tier Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life insurance, along with a 401(k) plan featuring a 4% match. * **Commuter** **Benefits**: Park conveniently in our building’s garage at no charge to you. jobs.title: Electrical Assistant Project Manager II
jobs.description: **Position Summary** This position supports the execution of construction projects by assisting project managers in overseeing planning, financial tracking, subcontractor management, and quality control efforts to meet business, client, and operational objectives. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Collaborates with preconstruction teams to support project estimating, cost control, and schedule development. * Reviews and coordinates scopes of work, ensuring alignment with drawings, specifications, and project objectives. * Prepares and reviews submittals for accuracy, completeness, and compliance. * Compiles and analyzes pay applications, change requests, and other financial documents related to project progress. * Participates in subcontractor bidding, evaluations, and award recommendations, including the preparation of proposals. * Assists in contract administration, including monitoring deliverables and compliance with contract terms. * Oversees time tracking and reporting in coordination with field supervision and administrative staff to ensure accuracy and adherence to company policy. * Communicates and coordinates with owners, architects, engineers, inspectors, and subcontractors to support project alignment and timely decision\-making. * Organizes and facilitates project meetings to address coordination, material needs, and labor concerns. * Drafts correspondence, reports, meeting minutes, and other project documentation. * Maintains and updates resource data including vendor contacts, material specifications, and regulatory requirements. * Assists with or coordinates material procurement and delivery to ensure field teams have the resources needed. * Performs other related duties as assigned to ensure efficient and effective processes, completion of projects and smooth operation of department. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, or a related field preferred; high school diploma or GED required. * Minimum of 2\+ years of experience in electrical or general construction project coordination or management. * Prior electrical estimating experience is a plus. * Journeyman Electrician’s License is a plus. * Strong computer literacy and comfort working with project management and estimating tools. **Required Skills, Knowledge, and Abilities** * Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment. * Excellent organizational, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook), Bluebeam, Accubid, and scheduling software. * Ability to read and interpret construction documents, technical specifications, and schematics. * Proficient in construction takeoffs and basic estimating. * Working knowledge of electrical construction materials and practices. * High attention to detail with the ability to exercise discretion and independent judgment. * Demonstrated leadership capability and a commitment to a safety\-first culture. * Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record. **Work Environment** *The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* This job may work inside or outside with possible exposure to extreme hot or cold temperatures and weather elements in restricted or confined spaces, and on slippery or uneven surfaces. This job may have exposure to working on ladders, scaffolds, aerial lifts, catwalks, and other exposures typical of heavy construction. This job also operates in an office setting. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, photocopiers, and filing cabinets. **Physical Demands** *The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* * Must be able to traverse and inspect all areas of jobsite in all types of weather; this may include walking, climbing reaching, bending crawling, standing, or stretching. * The employee must be able to regularly lift and/or move up to 10 pounds, lift and /or move up to 50 pounds * Move about on the feet regularly. Sit for extended periods of time. * Requires the ability to sit and work at a computer for extended periods of time. * May require travel. * Exposure to characteristic construction site dangers. * Talk and hear, ability to communicate with others both written and orally and by telephone. * Possess good vision, normal or corrected. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.*

jobs.title: Cloud Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Position Overview** The Cloud Site Reliability Engineer will own the reliability, performance, and security of Cadwell's cloud\-hosted infrastructure supporting healthcare facilities that depend on Cadwell's software suite for neurodiagnostic care. Working within the Enterprise Service Delivery team, this role builds and maintains infrastructure as code, deployment automation, monitoring and observability, and disaster recovery capabilities for Cadwell's AWS environments, and leads incident response for hosted customer systems. The Cloud Site Reliability Engineer partners closely with software engineering, enterprise support, and project delivery teams to ensure hosted deployments meet the uptime, data protection, and regulatory expectations of clinical environments. **Key Responsibilities** * Build, maintain, and continuously improve Cadwell's AWS cloud infrastructure supporting hosted customer environments, applying infrastructure\-as\-code practices using Terraform, YAML, and JSON/Jinja. * Automate build, test, and deployment pipelines for cloud\-hosted Cadwell applications to reduce manual effort and eliminate configuration drift across customer environments. * Build and maintain log ingestion, monitoring, alerting, and observability systems that provide early warning of degradation in hosted clinical environments. * Lead incident response for cloud\-hosted environments, serving as the escalation point for availability and performance events and conducting post\-mortems with corrective actions tracked to closure. * Design, implement, and routinely test backup and disaster recovery strategies for hosted customer data to meet the recovery time and recovery point objectives committed to customers. * Optimize cloud compute, storage, and lifecycle policies to balance performance, clinical data retention requirements, and cost across the hosted footprint. * Implement and maintain cybersecurity best practices across cloud infrastructure, including identity and access management, network segmentation, encryption, patching, and vulnerability remediation. * Partner with software engineering to improve application reliability, scalability, and performance, contributing to architecture decisions for new and migrating hosted deployments. * Partner with Cadwell's enterprise support and project delivery teams on hosted environment onboarding, migrations, and upgrades, providing cloud infrastructure expertise throughout the customer lifecycle. * Ensure cloud infrastructure and processes comply with applicable healthcare data privacy and security requirements (e.g., HIPAA, GDPR) and with Cadwell's quality system, including IEC 62304 software lifecycle processes. * Document infrastructure architecture, runbooks, and escalation procedures so that support and on\-call staff can operate hosted environments consistently. * Other activities as directed, assigned, or requested. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Expert\-level knowledge of core AWS services and architectural patterns, including compute, object storage, networking (VPC, security groups, load balancers), managed databases, and container orchestration with ECS. * Demonstrated command of infrastructure as code and deployment automation, including Terraform, YAML and JSON/Jinja templating, CI/CD pipeline design, and scripting in Bash, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * Practical knowledge of cloud security, including identity and access management, least\-privilege design, secret management, encryption in transit and at rest, network segmentation, and vulnerability remediation. * Hands\-on experience building monitoring, logging, and observability systems, and designing alerting that surfaces real problems without creating noise. * Sound judgment in backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning, including replication, restore validation, and recovery objectives appropriate to clinical data. * Solid grounding in managed database administration and cloud cost management, including backups, patching, performance tuning, right\-sizing, storage lifecycle policies, and capacity planning. * Familiarity with healthcare data privacy and security requirements such as HIPAA and GDPR, and with software lifecycle standards such as IEC 62304\. * Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to technical and non\-technical audiences, lead incident response under pressure, and mentor engineers and support staff on cloud practices. * Ability to work both independently and as an effective team member, exhibiting Cadwell's core values of integrity, initiative, accountability, commitment to excellence, and service to others. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. * 8\+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, cloud infrastructure, or DevOps, including recent hands\-on experience operating production AWS environments. * Demonstrated experience operating production infrastructure under formal on\-call and incident management practices. * Experience working in a regulated environment (medical device, healthcare, or financial services) preferred. * 2\+ years of support within a healthcare environment preferred. * AWS certification such as Solutions Architect or SysOps Administrator preferred. * Familiarity with virtualization technologies such as VMware, Hyper\-V, or Citrix is preferred. * Familiarity with HL7 integration tooling such as Mirth Connect is preferred. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions** * Positions working with Cadwell equipment generally may require some reaching, bending, stooping, squatting, crawling, kneeling, pushing, pulling, and occasional lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds, finger dexterity, repetitive motions, standing, walking, sitting, hearing, visual acuity, color vision, and 2\-way written/verbal communication. More specific details may be provided as needed or requested. * Extensive use of a computer will be required. * Reliable high\-speed internet required. * Participation in an on\-call rotation for hosted environment escalations, including occasional after\-hours and weekend response, is required. * Infrastructure maintenance is frequently scheduled outside of customer clinical hours; flexibility to work evenings or weekends for planned changes is required. * Travel up to 10% for company meetings. *Cadwell Industries, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and as such affirms the right of every person to participate in all aspects of employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, citizenship, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic. If you are interested in applying for employment and need special assistance or an accommodation to apply for a posted position, contact our Human Resources department at careers@cadwell.com.*

jobs.title: Product Manager, Conversational AI & IVR
jobs.description: Philadelphia, PA, United States (On\-site) Contract (2 months 18 days) Published 5 hours ago stakeholder management crm integration UX/UI product management customer service skills Debugging Skills problem \- solving analytical skills kpi management * Comcast is seeking a Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of conversational experiences across AI\-powered voice and digital platforms. This role starts with the customer—understanding where experiences break down, identifying unmet needs, and turning those insights into better products. The Product Manager will directly use customer feedback, conversation data, behavioral data, and journey analysis to improve self\-service experiences and reduce customer effort. * We’re looking for a Product Manager who likes to build, prototype, and experiment—using modern AI development tools to turn ideas into working concepts and accelerate product discovery. The ideal candidate is technically capable and comfortable with APIs, data, prompts, prototypes, debugging, and AI coding agents, without needing to be a production software engineer. This individual will partner closely with engineering, design, data science, operations, and customer experience teams to deliver scalable, measurable solutions. **Key Responsibilities:** Product Strategy \& Roadmap: * Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for conversational and AI\-powered customer experience products. * Identify unmet customer needs and breakdowns across voice, chat, messaging, and self\-service journeys. * Turn customer feedback, conversation data, behavioral data, and journey analysis into product priorities and experiments. * Prioritize investments based on customer impact, business value, and measurable outcomes. Product Delivery \& Optimization: * Own the product lifecycle from discovery through launch and continuous improvement. * Develop business requirements and align teams around product objectives. * Partner with engineering, AI/ML, UX, conversation design, and operations teams to deliver high\-quality solutions. * Monitor product performance and optimize experiences using customer feedback, analytics, and business outcomes. * Use AI\-assisted development and prototyping tools to quickly explore ideas, build working proofs of concept, test assumptions, and collaborate more effectively with engineering and design. Conversational AI \& IVR Leadership: * Lead the evolution of conversational, messaging, virtual assistant, contact center, and AI\-powered customer experiences across voice and digital channels. * Improve automation, containment, and self\-service effectiveness while reducing customer effort. * Partner with AI and conversation design teams to enhance intent recognition, customer journeys, and service outcomes. * Manage integrations between conversational platforms and enterprise systems, including CRM, billing, support, and digital applications. * Stay current on emerging technologies, including Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), speech recognition, and conversational AI. Stakeholder Management * Build strong partnerships across business, technology, operations, customer experience, and leadership teams. * Present product strategy, roadmap updates, business cases, and performance results to stakeholders. * Align diverse teams around shared goals and measurable outcomes. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * 5\+ years of Product Management experience delivering customer\-facing digital products. * Experience owning products from concept through launch and ongoing optimization. * Experience with conversational, messaging, virtual assistant, contact center, or AI\-powered customer experience platforms across voice and/or digital channels. * Experience delivering conversational products across voice, chat, messaging, or other digital channels; experience spanning multiple channels is strongly preferred. * Experience managing or partnering on customer\-facing user experiences and interfaces. * Strong understanding of Agile product development methodologies. * Experience defining product requirements, roadmaps, KPIs, and success metrics. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills. * Proven ability to lead and influence cross\-functional teams. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in telecommunications, broadband, media, customer service, or contact center technologies. * Experience with conversational AI and customer engagement platforms such as Google Dialogflow, Nuance, Genesys, Cognigy, Kore.ai, Amazon Lex, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Services, or other conversational/customer engagement platforms. * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, or similar tools, with the ability to prototype or build lightweight applications and product experiences. * Experience with Generative AI, LLM\-powered experiences, prompt design, or AI orchestration frameworks. * Familiarity with NLP, NLU, speech technologies, and conversational design principles. * Experience improving IVR containment, self\-service adoption, and contact center experiences. * Knowledge of customer journey mapping, service design, experimentation, and product analytics. * Experience integrating conversational platforms with CRM and enterprise systems. * Familiarity with accessibility and inclusive design practices. **Success Profile:** The successful candidate will be: * Customer\-obsessed, with an expectation to stay close to customer needs, friction points, and outcomes. * A hands\-on builder who is comfortable getting into the product, experimenting with new technology, and creating prototypes rather than relying exclusively on engineering teams to explore ideas. * Data\-driven and comfortable using customer feedback, conversation data, behavioral data, journey analysis, and product analytics to make decisions. * Technically capable and comfortable working with APIs, data, prompts, prototypes, debugging, and AI coding agents. * A clear communicator who can bring business and technology partners together around customer outcomes. The pay range that the employer in good faith reasonably expects to pay for this position is $39\.30/hour \- $61\.40/hour. Our benefits include medical, dental, vision and retirement benefits. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis. *Tundra Technical Solutions is among North America’s leading providers of Staffing and Consulting Services. Our success and our clients’ success are built on a foundation of service excellence. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable law, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Unincorporated LA County workers: we reasonably believe that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment: client provided property, including hardware (both of which may include data) entrusted to you from theft, loss or damage; return all portable client computer hardware in your possession (including the data contained therein) upon completion of the assignment, and; maintain the confidentiality of client proprietary, confidential, or non\-public information. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected client information technology systems and related data security obligations.*

jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Sunnyvale, CA **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Hybrid **Department** -------------- IT \& Security Cerebras Systems builds the world's largest AI chip, 56 times larger than GPUs. This architecture allows Cerebras to deliver industry\-leading training and inference speeds; over 10 times faster than GPU\-based hyperscale cloud inference services. Cerebras is seeking a Software Supply Chain Security Engineer to help build a secure foundation for our build and development workflows. In this role you will be responsible for assessing and hardening every layer of our source to artifact pipeline, from how we store and manage code to what we deploy into our clusters. The ideal candidate brings a combination of wide breadth of knowledge on a variety of software supply chain topics throughout the whole SDLC process, a pragmatic and results\-driven outlook on security, and the flexibility and attention to detail to work in a fast\-paced development environment without compromising our security standards. ### **Responsibilities** * Define core security teams to identify supply chain gaps and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for ensuring confidence in CI/CD artifacts * Develop threat models for each layer of the build and deploy stack, outlining trust boundaries and the interplay between first and third\-party mechanisms * Work with engineering leads and devops architects to build in secure supply chain principles from the beginning * Balance engineering outcomes with security controls, enabling the company to deliver securely quickly * Document security posture and strategy for technical and nontechnical audiences from both 1p and 3p perspectives ### **Skills and Qualifications** * 8\-10 years of experience with software supply chain and SDLC topics including secure code management, build pipeline hardening, artifact signing and attestation, and the end\-to\-end integration thereof. * Masters in Computer Science or PhD (preferred) * Strong hands\-on engineering abilities in devops and SDLC contexts * Ability to work in fragmented and legacy build environments, experience with modernizing stacks is a plus * Familiarity with AWS, Jenkins, SLSA, and best practices for secure artifact provenance and builds are a plus * Strong written communication skills, with the ability to make security concepts approachable for non\-specialists. * Direct work with Agentic workflows and deep understanding of LLM and reasoning cycles. **Why Join Cerebras** People who are serious about software make their own hardware. At Cerebras, we have built a breakthrough architecture that is unlocking new opportunities for the AI industry. With dozens of model releases and rapid growth, we’ve reached an inflection point in our business. Members of our team tell us there are five main reasons they joined Cerebras: * Build a breakthrough AI platform beyond the constraints of the GPU. * Publish and open source their cutting\-edge AI research. * Work on one of the fastest AI supercomputers in the world. * Enjoy job stability with startup vitality. * Our simple, non\-corporate work culture that respects individual beliefs. **Apply today and become part of the forefront of groundbreaking advancements in AI!** *Cerebras Systems is committed to creating an equal and diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Construction Project Manager
jobs.description: **The Opportunity** For more than 35 years, Chris\-Tel Construction has partnered with public and private clients across Florida to deliver award\-winning projects through Construction Management, Design\-Build, and General Contracting services. As a Project Manager at Chris\-Tel, you’ll take an active role in the planning, coordination, and execution of commercial construction projects from preconstruction through closeout. You’ll work closely with Project Executives, Superintendents, owners, architects, subcontractors, and internal teams to keep projects on schedule, within budget, and aligned with Chris\-Tel’s standards for quality, safety, and client service. This role is ideal for an experienced construction professional who understands the full project lifecycle and can confidently manage costs, schedules, contracts, subcontractors, client relationships, and the day\-to\-day demands of a commercial construction project. If you’re organized, proactive, solutions\-focused, and ready to take ownership of your projects, we’d love to hear from you. **What You’ll Do** * Manage construction projects to ensure project goals, schedules, budgets, quality standards, and client expectations are met. * Develop and maintain strong relationships with owners, architects, subcontractors, vendors, and project team members. * Participate actively in the preconstruction process and assist with pricing efforts. * Manage project submittals, RFIs, contracts, and other project documentation. * Manage the procurement process, including developing subcontractor scopes of work and ensuring agreements and insurance requirements are in place before work begins. * Prepare and manage monthly Project Status Reports, job cost information, cash flow reporting, and project financial performance. * Prepare schedules of value and manage owner billing in accordance with contract requirements. * Review subcontractor applications for payment with the Superintendent for accuracy. * Review subcontractor change\-order requests and prepare, submit, and negotiate owner change\-order requests. * Manage project budget modifications and monitor the financial impact of project changes. * Coordinate and develop project schedules with the Superintendent, including look\-ahead and Critical Path Method schedules. * Identify and manage schedule delays and associated cost and time impacts. * Manage subcontractors and vendors to ensure project milestones, contractual requirements, quality standards, and schedules are met. * Lead Owner Architect Contractor (OAC), staff, and subcontractor meetings and ensure meeting documentation is properly maintained. * Partner with the Superintendent to maintain quality\-control and safety standards throughout the project. * Coordinate permitting, third\-party testing, inspections, Temporary Certificates of Occupancy, and Certificates of Occupancy as required. * Manage the project closeout process, including permits, punch lists, and final project documentation. * Communicate project risks or issues that could affect the Company’s financial performance, reputation, schedule, or client relationships. * Mentor and support Assistant Project Managers and Project Engineers as assigned. * Participate in Company training and professional\-development opportunities. **Who You Are** * An experienced construction professional with at least six years of document control, project engineering, project coordination, or related construction\-industry experience. * Experienced with commercial construction projects, including one or more of the following: independent living facilities, housing authority projects, multifamily housing, industrial facilities, or educational institutions. * A bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or a related field is preferred; an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience will also be considered. * Experienced in managing project documentation, submittals, RFIs, contracts, budgets, schedules, change orders, and subcontractor coordination. * Able to confidently review and interpret blueprints, construction drawings, specifications, budgets, contracts, submittals, RFIs, and other project documents. * Familiar with Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Kahua, or similar construction\-management platforms. * Proficient with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Project. * OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification is preferred. **What Makes You Successful** * Strong organization and time\-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. * The ability to take ownership of project responsibilities and follow through from planning through completion. * Strong problem\-solving and conflict\-management skills. * Professional written, verbal, and presentation skills. * The ability to communicate technical and project information clearly to clients, project teams, subcontractors, and leadership. * A proactive and collaborative approach to working with field and office teams. * The ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients, architects, subcontractors, vendors, and internal team members. * A commitment to project safety, quality, schedule, financial performance, and client satisfaction. * The ability to receive and act on constructive feedback. * A commitment to integrity, professionalism, continuous learning, and Chris\-Tel’s core values. **Supervisory Responsibility** This position may supervise Project Engineers and Assistant Project Managers as assigned and will provide day\-to\-day direction and prioritization of their work. The Project Manager is also responsible for managing subcontractors contracted by Chris\-Tel and ensuring their work is completed in accordance with contractual requirements, project specifications, schedules, and Company standards. **Travel** This position will primarily work from project jobsites or Chris\-Tel’s main office. Occasional local travel is required. A valid driver’s license is required for this position. **Work Environment** This position operates in both construction\-site and office environments and may involve prolonged periods of standing or sitting. Jobsite work may include exposure to varying temperatures and humidity. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position. All employees are expected to maintain a strong commitment to the health and safety of coworkers, clients, subcontractors, vendors, and the general public. **Why Join Chris\-Tel?** * ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) * Vehicle allowance * Fuel card * Health insurance with 100% paid employee\-only coverage * Dental insurance * Vision insurance * Flexible Spending Account (FSA) * Short\-Term Disability * Long\-Term Disability * Voluntary Life and AD\&D Insurance * Aflac ancillary insurance * Identity theft protection * Pet insurance * Paid time off * Paid holidays * 401(k) retirement plan * Paid training and professional development * Tuition reimbursement **Equal Opportunity Employer** Chris\-Tel Construction is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to any status protected by applicable law. Chris\-Tel Construction is a Drug\-Free Workplace. Job Type: Full\-time Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Health insurance * Paid time off * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of experience do you have in commercial construction project management? * Which types of commercial construction projects have you worked on? * Which of the following do you have experience managing? Please list all that apply: construction drawings/blueprints, project specifications, contracts, submittals, RFIs, and project budgets. Ability to Commute: * Fort Myers, FL 33901 (Required) Work Location: In person

Proficiency in event\-driven and messaging systems, including Kafka, Solace, Tibco, and MQ, with experience designing and operating high\-throughput data pipelines. Hands\-on experience with containerization and cloud\-native platforms, specifically Kubernetes, Docker, and OpenShift. jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Job Title Project Engineer Department Public Utilities City Information The City of West Palm Beach is a municipality where high performers blossom and operational excellence is a hallmark. To maintain and build upon its stellar workforce, the City is strongly committed to providing its employees with competitive salaries that are at or above market and comprehensive health and retirement benefits that are second to none. In furtherance of these goals, the City has implemented a new salary structure in which all non\-public safety pay ranges and minimum starting salaries were increased by 7%. Additionally, all City positions including on\-call and part time positions have a minimum hourly starting rate of $17\.00 or higher. Certain non\-public safety positions may qualify for hybrid work arrangements under specific conditions. If you are a high performer, seeking an opportunity to blossom and grow, we have a place for you in our workforce. We invite you to join our team – apply today! The City of West Palm Beach (pop. 117,286 – 2021\) with its sunny, palm\-lined streets, scenic waterfront views, quaint shopping districts, historic neighborhoods and year\-round outdoor festivals is a slice of paradise. Among the City’s many attributes is an active and vibrant downtown and waterfront that serves to host a variety of nationally recognized cultural and leisure activities for residents and visitors alike. Incorporated in 1894 and encompassing over 55 square miles, the county seat of Palm Beach County is one the fastest growing areas in the country. The City offers a dynamic setting in which to live, work, play and enjoy all the attributes of South Florida living. Our ethnically and culturally diverse community and workplace are the bedrock of our strength and resilience. Explore the many opportunities available for joining our diverse and winning team! Summary Under limited supervision, performs engineering related services; and performs other duties as assigned. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** (Which are not in any hierarchical order) 1\. Under the supervision of a Professional Engineer, performs engineering services related to the design of various capital improvements and rehabilitation projects for public utilities infrastructure including water distribution, sanitary collection, stormwater, lift stations, water resources, water and wastewater treatment plants, and incidental roadway improvements. 2\. Prepares construction drawings and specifications for the planning, design, rehabilitation, and construction of utilities projects. 3\. Coordinates with representatives from other agencies and City staff to resolve issues related to the design to ensure projects meet the requirements of the City standards and specifications. 4\. Under the supervision of a Professional Engineer, performs research, engineering studies, and calculations related to assigned areas of responsibility. 5\. Performs cost analysis for utilities projects. 6\. Assist engineers with various aspects of complex projects (data collection, condition assessment, etc.) 7\. Develop exhibits for engineering reports and presentations through the use of computer graphics software, including slides, maps, charts, and graphs. 8\. May assist or make independent presentations to community/neighborhood groups regarding proposed or on\-going projects. 9\. Responds to inquiries from the public concerning utilities and other engineering\-related matters. 10\. Develops, manages, and monitors engineering contracts with outside consultants and contractors. 11\. Assists with the review of engineering drawings for City projects and developer’s projects. 12\. Review technical specifications, contract documents, and cost estimates. 13\. Review contract documents including schedule of bid items. 14\. Evaluates and approves consultant and contractor pay requests. 15\. Performs other related work as assigned. Salary Depending on qualifications the starting salary for this position will be in the range of pay grade 68: Minimum $77,058 annually Benefits: Health Insurance, Vision, and Dental Insurance; Basic life insurance and LTD insurance; Defined contribution plan (401a); Deferred compensation plan (457\) ; Twelve (12\) paid holidays; Accrued annual/vacation and sick days; Employee Health Clinic; and Other voluntary benefits. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree with a major in Civil Engineering or closely related field **(education will be verified using the “Education Requirements” listed below)** with utility experience emphasis, or any equivalent combination of training. Engineer in Training Certificate from the State of Florida is required, or ability to obtain within six (6\) months from date of employment. Have two (2\) years of varied progressively responsible technical engineering experience which includes experience in either the design and/or construction of utility projects; OR combination of education from accredited engineering curriculum and/or experience will be considered as meeting experience requirements. Some experience or training using AutoCAD and/or ARCGIS software is required. Experience with hydraulic modeling software is highly desirable. A current and valid Florida driver’s license is required. For application purposes, a valid driver’s license from any state (equivalent to a State of Florida Class E) may be utilized; with the ability to obtain the State of Florida driver’s license within thirty (30\) days from date of employment. **Education Requirements**: To be considered valid (or verified) for position qualification purposes, and consistent with City Hiring Policy 4\-5, a High School, GED or equivalent diploma, and all higher education degrees or certifications must have been issued by: a) a public education institution in the State of Florida or any State or Territory of the United States; or b) an institution accredited by an accrediting organization that is recognized by the Florida Department of Education or the U.S. Department of Education; or c) an institution that is accredited by an organization that is recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA); or d) an institution whose degree or certification is accepted by institutions identified in either a, b or c above for the purpose of admission to institutions identified in either a, b, or c above. International degrees will be evaluated to determine if they satisfy qualification requirements. **Special Driving Requirements:*** Have not lost any driving privileges by reason of revocation, suspension or denial of license, or have been convicted and/or had an adjudication withheld of three or more moving violations or, * Have not had one DUI (Driving Under the Influence) in any preceding twenty\-four (24\) month period. License suspension of two weeks or less or suspensions based only on non\-moving violations that have been cleared will not automatically result in revocation of driving privileges. Additional Details The selection process for this position may consist of any, all or a combination of the following tests: evaluation of training and experience, written examination, structured oral interview or other assessment method. **State of Emergency:** When normal operations of City departments are suspended or interrupted due to a declaration by the Mayor that a state of emergency exists, all employees will be deemed critical by the City. For the preparation and/or continuation of emergency operations or for special work detail, employees deemed necessary shall be required to work. Employees deemed critical by the City but not needed for the initial preparation and/or continuation of emergency operations or for special work detail may be directed not to report to work, and given paid administrative leave or they may be reassigned to another location that best meet the needs of the City. How To Apply If you are interested in applying for this position you may apply online by selecting the **Apply Now** button. Applications must be received in Human Resources by the closing date. **The City of West Palm Beach is an equal employment opportunity employer. The City values the service of veterans to our country, supports recruitment of veterans and veterans' preference will be given in accordance with Chapter 295 of the Florida Statutes for those who met the minimum requirements of the position. Background investigation and physical is required as a condition of employment. Drug and alcohol screening may be required depending on the position.** Currency USD Closing Date Amount of Travel Work At Home

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - AutoReview
jobs.description: ### **About CoLab** At CoLab, we help mechanical engineering teams bring life\-changing products to market years sooner. We build AI for engineers designing cars, medical devices, and jet engines. Products this complex aren't sketched and sent to production. Teams spend months on iterations, reviews, and tests, predicting how every part performs before anything is built. CoLab is where those reviews happen, and we capture the rationale behind every change. Other tools show what changed between versions. Only CoLab knows why. That's how our AI helps manufacturers like Bobcat, Triumph Motorcycles, and GE Appliances make better decisions, eliminate rework cycles, and get to market faster. Proudly based in St. John's, Newfoundland, CoLab started with one customer in 2018\. Since then we've raised a $72M Series C, been named the 57th fastest growing company in North America by Deloitte (Fast 500™), signed multi\-year AI partnerships with companies like Bombardier, and grown to a team of 250\+. ### **About the Role** We're hiring an Engineering Manager to lead the team building AutoReview—CoLab's AI\-powered capabilities for automating mechanical design review. This is a people leadership role that requires real technical depth. You won't need to be the engineer writing every solution, but you should understand software and web architecture well enough to pressure\-test an approach, spot when an estimate doesn't add up, and ask the question that changes the conversation. You'll work closely with Product to turn broad ideas into a roadmap the team can confidently execute. That includes making early calls on feasibility and scope, then giving engineers the context and autonomy to work through the details. The technical problems are substantial: DFM checks, clash detection, BOM consolidation, clearance analysis, bulk AutoReview workflows, and increasingly, the intersection of 2D engineering data and machine learning. ### **Our Ideal Candidate** * You've managed engineers working on technically complex web applications—ideally involving geometry, 3D data, geometric processing, CAD, graphics, or adjacent domains. * You care deeply about people and understand the technology they're building. You stay connected enough to the work to identify risks early without becoming the person everyone depends on for every decision. * This team is smart, motivated, and eager to move. Your job isn't to manufacture ambition; it's to provide clarity so that ambition is focused on the right problems. * You'll also help establish clearer, respectful boundaries between Engineering and Product ownership. If you enjoy building that kind of trusting partnership while navigating ambiguity, you'll do well here. ### **Job Responsibilities** * Lead, coach, and support the engineers responsible for Build AutoReview. * Partner closely with Product to define priorities, assess feasibility, roughly scope initiatives, and build realistic timelines. * Maintain enough technical context across projects to surface risks, dependencies, and questionable assumptions early. * Help the team deliver major AutoReview initiatives, including DFM checks, assembly analysis, and bulk review workflows. * Work across Engineering, Product, and the applied ML Team as AutoReview expands into areas where ownership and technical approaches are still evolving. * Create focus when priorities change quickly because of new customer insight, technical developments, or advances in AI and ML. * Build an environment where engineers have clear context, meaningful ownership, and the support to do excellent work. ### **Qualifications** * Experience managing software engineers in a technically complex product domain. * Strong technical foundation in modern web application and software architecture. * Experience with geometric processing, 3D/CAD applications, graphics, or similar technical systems is a strong asset. * Demonstrated ability to partner with Product on roadmap planning, technical feasibility, estimation, and prioritization. * Comfortable navigating evolving AI/ML technologies and understanding how they affect product and architecture decisions. * Able to move quickly through new information, make thoughtful decisions, and communicate tradeoffs clearly. ### **Extra Details** This is a full\-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options. We offer comprehensive benefits and flexible vacation. **This is a remote position open in Canada and the US.** ### **Equity Note** Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don't meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

jobs.title: Structural Project Manager
jobs.description: Colliers Engineering \& Design is currently seeking a Structural Project Manager to join our Structural Engineering team in our Austin, TX office. From industrial design to multifamily, Colliers Engineering \& Design engineers will ensure your project meets today’s safety standards as well as your functional requirements. Our structural engineers are able to design the structural systems for buildings, foundations, and earth retention for all types of new construction, additions, adaptive reuse, and renovations. Our engineers have the knowledge and experience to design projects utilizing steel framing, conventional and pt concrete, mass timber, conventional wood framing, light gauge, and masonry. Project Managers are responsible for the project schedule and meeting project budgets in addition to engineering duties. Project Managers will assign tasks and deadlines to Project Engineers and Graduate Engineers while maintaining oversight of the progress. Project Managers may act as Project Engineer, especially on smaller projects. Project Manager will be in contact with the client to ensure knowledge of the schedule, major design coordination issues, and any construction administration challenges. By developing strong connections with our clients, Colliers Engineering \& Design engineers ensure our designs meet project goals. Our projects include new buildings, renovations and re\-purposing. Streamlined coordination with other in\-house services will facilitate an efficient approach and complete engineering package that spans all phases of structural design and construction. This includes feasibility studies, scope and condition assessment, code compliance review, static/dynamic load analyses, drawing preparation, bidding services, and construction administration. * Provide primary point of contact for Principals and design team including Architect and General Contractor. Attend project meetings with Architects and other design professionals, Owners, and Contractors. * Manage project schedule, activities, and budget. * Work with Structural Director to manage client accounts and maintain continuity of service. * Identify when scope of work is exceeded and notify client. Summarize project status and communicate additional service requests to Structural Director. * Communicate with Structural Director when milestones are completed and project schedules are updated Invoice work as milestones are completed. * Review time and cost for projects both complete and in process. * Maintain project phases within accounting software: create projects \& all associated phases by utilizing administrative staff, verify all project fees for phases, etc. * Identify un\-billed time and determine which invoice the time should be associated with or identify added scope and coordinate with the Structural Director and client to bill for the un\-billed time on a monthly basis. * Maintain CA billing on a monthly basis by reviewing the progress of each project under construction with internal resources. * Supervise and manage the work of Project Engineers, Graduate Engineers, and Interns. Develop specific tasks for resource allocation with review and follow up. Anticipate and provide guidance where unconventional conditions exist. * Coordinate with technical staff to employ internal drawings templates for new projects. * Ensure all calculations and details are in accordance with relevant codes (IBC, ASCE\-7, ACI, AISC, NDS, AISI, etc) based on project\-specific jurisdiction. * Review structural drawings for foundation and framing layout, coordination with Architectural drawings and inclusion of standard notes and details. Ensure structural drawings meet internal standards. * Review drawing packages prepared by Project Engineers and make adjustments as needed to ensure quality of product and meet client expectations. * Act as Project Engineer as required to develop familiarity with internal standards and for complex projects or projects located in high seismic or hurricane prone regions. * Edit and compile relevant specification sections addressing structural items. Coordinate with Architect on sections and format. * Manage all construction administration tasks including submittals, shop drawings, RFIs and review of testing reports. * 10\+ years of experience required in building structural design * P.E. required. * Should have relevant continuing education courses showing annual advancement of career. * Possess an intermediate to advanced understanding of structural design software such RISA, RAM, TEKLA, TEDDS, SAFE, PROFIS, etc. with a willingness to learn and adapt to new software. * A willingness to learn and adapt to new software and client needs. * Understanding of steel, concrete, masonry, and wood design principles. * Light gauge experience is preferred. * Knowledge of current building and material design codes and standards such as IBC, ASCE7, AISC360, ACI318, ACI 530 or NDS. * Strong Microsoft Office skills. * Able to work independently and also collaboratively on a team. * Strong communication skills. * Ability to read, write and understand English for purposes of comprehending written job\-related communications and verbal instructions and interactions.

stakeholder expectations. * Ability to build trust with technical and non\-technical stakeholders while maintaining clear decision rights and accountability. * Commitment to secure, reliable, maintainable, high\-quality solutions that produce measurable business and member outcomes. * Ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and model CRC values. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and common development, source control, work management, testing, deployment, monitoring, and reporting tools.

jobs.description: **About Us** We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature\-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best\-in\-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category\-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next\-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! If you are a technical professional looking for an opportunity to grow, Copeland has an exciting opportunity for you! Based in our Sidney, OH location, you will work in conjunction with product and research engineers along with lab supervisors to design, develop, and qualify compressors for HVACR systems. We are seeking a lead technician to contribute to our overall growth and continued innovation in our HVACR labs, specifically the OFC bearing assembly lab. **AS THE 3** ***rd*** **SHIFT OFC BEARING LEAD TECHNICIAN, YOU WILL:** * Lead a team of technicians that will assemble oil\-free centrifugal bearings at our bearing lab on Stolle Avenue * Assign work daily to meet customer demands and program deadlines * Communicate daily schedule, concerns, and updates through supervisor and engineering teams * Provide training and onboarding of new hires * Become proficient in the bearing assembly process and assist in improvements, changes, and problem solving * Provide performance coaching and mentorship to technicians * Support technicians and management to create a safe and clean work environment using 5s\+1 techniques and current safety procedures Support hands on work as needed * **SCHEDULE:** This is a 3rd shift position with a flexible start time of 11:00 PM or 11:30 PM. 8 hour working shifts are required with a 30\-minute unpaid lunch. We also offer 2, 10\-minute breaks throughout the day. Our teams work together to ensure our chosen work schedules enable our creativity and productivity as we serve the needs of our customers. **REQUIRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS:** * Associate degree or Certificate in technical discipline and three (3\+) years relevant experience * Exceptional troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills * Demonstrated ability to resolve complex projects into actionable tasks, create realistic timelines, and execute tasks * Ability to effectively collaborate with other groups and product engineering * Proven computer skills including MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint * Exceptional communication (written \& verbal) skills and team lead or management experience * Experience in developing testing procedures, training documents, and creating logs of critical lab operational records Legal Authorization to work in the United States. Sponsorship will not be provided for this role * **PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE \& SKILLS:** * Associate degree in Electro\-Mechanical Engineering, HVAC, Industrial Operations, or another engineering/manufacturing\-related degree and (7\+) years of experience * Experience in developing testing procedures, training documents, and creating logs of critical lab operational records * Understanding of ISO/IEC 17025 compliance requirements for laboratory operations and experience in preparing laboratory for annual ISO/IEC 17025, UL and ANAB audits * In\-depth understanding of performance test lab metrics and KPIs * Leadership experience with direct reports * Experience in quality; ASQ Certification preferred * Basic/intermediate level of statistics, physics, and math Excellent presentation skills * **Why Work in the Greater Miami Valley Area** Our facility is located in Sidney, OH, conveniently located within driving distance to several larger cities, such as Dayton, Troy, and Columbus. The area's generally low costs of living, excellent school systems, and low crime rates create a family\-friendly environment. The area is home to several growing communities with restaurants, festivals, shopping, and arts scenes that make them exciting places to live and work. **About Our Location** Our newly renovated Sidney campus has 1M square feet of manufacturing floor with an additional 120k square feet of leading\-edge lab facilities. This location is the headquarters for our HVACR Americas business unit. Through our many years of compressor expertise, our products help bring comfort and convenience to refrigeration, commercial, industrial, and residential spaces. Approximately 1,600 employees work in Sidney, who all support a multitude of business functions. With the blend of businesses and functions represented under this one roof, there are many opportunities for advancement within the Sidney location. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! **Our Commitment to Inclusion \& Belonging** At Copeland, we cultivate a strong sense of inclusion and belonging where individuals of all backgrounds, and with diverse perspectives, are embraced and treated fairly to enable a stronger workforce.
