jobs.title: Director of Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description: **HATCHWORKS AI\-Director, Enterprise Architecture**HatchWorks AI · Remote (US\-based) · Full\-Time15\+ Yrs Exp. · Reports to CTO **ROLE SUMMARY**The Director, Enterprise Architecture is a senior leadership role that sits at the intersection of client delivery, pre\-sales engineering, and practice building at Hatchworks. This role carries both strategic and hands\-on responsibility: leading architecture on high\-value client engagements, serving as the technical voice in the sales cycle, and shaping the Enterprise Architecture practice from the ground up.The ideal candidate is a seasoned architect who can operate fluidly across the full engagement lifecycle — from scoping and estimating work alongside sellers, to architecting solutions, to enabling delivery teams for success. This role will lead the Hatchworks' Enterprise Architecture \& DevOps circle, managing a team of architects and driving the standards, patterns, and mentorship that define how we deliver. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **1\. Client Delivery\-** Target: up to 75% of billable time; emphasis on Strategy engagements over Build where possible. * Serve as lead architect on client engagements, including both Strategy projects (AI roadmaps, architecture assessments, modernization strategies) and Build projects (implementation, migration, platform engineering). * Prioritize high\-leverage contribution — enabling and delegating to project teams rather than operating solely as an individual contributor. * Manage the architecture workstream within client Projects, with a path toward owning entire client Programs as the practice matures. * Provide hands\-on technical leadership in areas such as cloud infrastructure (Azure, GCP), data architecture, DevOps, security, and AI/ML integration. **2\. Pre\-Sales Engineering\-** Target: \~25% block (approximately 10 hours/week) dedicated to Sales Engineering. * Act as the Pre\-Sales Engineer in a triad with a Pre\-Sales Strategist and a Seller, providing technical depth to the sales process. * Participate in and facilitate discovery workshops. * Lead solution architecture, technical scoping, and estimation for prospective client engagements. * Own the technical narrative in proposals and presentations, ensuring that what we sell is what we can deliver. * Drive a clean Sales\-to\-Delivery handoff by documenting architectural decisions, assumptions, risks, and context for the Delivery teams that will execute. * Support staffing on projects he helps sign, ensuring continuity from sale through early delivery. **3\. Practice Leadership \& Mentorship\-** Target: 4–5 hours/week for mentorship and ad\-hoc project support. * Serve as the leader of the Enterprise Architecture practice (circle/tribe) at Hatchworks, defining its standards, toolkits, and career paths. * Mentor junior and mid\-level architects, developing them into the next generation of Enterprise Architects. * Provide impromptu architectural guidance and support across other active projects as a senior technical resource. * Contribute to internal initiatives that raise the bar on delivery quality, reusable frameworks, and architectural governance. **EXPECTED TIME \& BILLING ALLOCATION\-**This role operates on a blended billing model. The approximate weekly breakdown is: * **Client Engagements** — \~30 hours/wk · \~75% of time · Client\-billable * **Pre\-Sales Engineering** — \~10 hours/wk · \~25% of time · Sales Engineering block * **Mentorship \& Support** — \~5 hours/wk · \~12\.5% of time · Internal Client billing should be high\-value: enabling teams, leading architecture, and delegating effectively — not just heads\-down IC work. **QUALIFICATIONSRequired** * 15\+ years of progressive experience in software engineering, with at least 5 years in enterprise or principal architect roles. * Demonstrated experience in a consulting or professional services environment, with direct client\-facing delivery responsibilities. * Deep technical expertise in cloud platforms (Azure and/or GCP), with hands\-on experience in infrastructure, data, DevOps, and security. * Proven ability to lead pre\-sales activities: discovery, solution design, scoping, and estimation. * Track record of leading and mentoring engineering teams (10\+ engineers). * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for executive and non\-technical audiences. * Experience with architecture governance, standards definition, and cross\-project technical oversight. **Preferred** * Experience with AI/ML strategy, roadmapping, or implementation in enterprise environments. * Background in cloud migration and application modernization at scale (50\+ application portfolios). * Familiarity with Kubernetes, microservices architecture, and event\-driven systems. * Prior experience building or leading an architecture practice or center of excellence. * History of closing or directly contributing to new business ($1M\+ engagements). **GROWTH TRAJECTORY\-**This role is designed to scale with Hatchworks. Immediately, this Director will operate as the senior\-most architect on engagements, a key voice in pre\-sales, and the lead of the Enterprise Architecture \& DevOps hub – owning the hiring, development, and deployment of a team of architects, and driving the standards that govern how Hatchworks delivers technical excellence.The progression from supporting individual client Projects to managing entire client Programs is a key milestone for this role, and one that Hatchworks is actively building toward. Pay: $175,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Chicago, IL 60606

jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Senior Platform Engineer Summary We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join the Platform Engineering team at HDAI. You will be a core contributor to the infrastructure that powers HealthVision, a clinical analytics platform that processes data for health systems through serverless pipelines running AI inference, LLM\-powered summaries, and real\-time patient analytics on AWS. The platform runs across hundreds of AWS accounts in a multi\-tenant model with per\-customer isolation, orchestrated through Terraform and GitHub Actions. You will work across the full infrastructure stack: ECS, Lambda, DynamoDB, MongoDB, S3, SQS, VPC networking, and CI/CD. There are legacy systems to retire, cost to cut, and automation to build. You will have real ownership, work closely with the Manager of Platform Engineering, and collaborate across engineering. We expect you to use AI tools daily to multiply your output. Responsibilities Infrastructure delivery. Build and maintain AWS infrastructure through Terraform. Write shared modules, manage per\-customer workspaces, and ensure environments are reproducible and version\- controlled. You'll be executing infrastructure changes across hundreds of workspaces regularly. Automation and tooling. Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work across the engineering organization: CI/CD pipeline improvements (GitHub Actions, including our self\-hosted runner fleet), deployment tooling, customer onboarding automation, environment provisioning, operational scripts. Migration execution. Help move workloads onto the compute and data stores that fit them best, retiring legacy systems along the way. Plan and execute migrations, move data safely, and decommission old infrastructure. Reliability and observability. Improve monitoring and alerting across the platform using Datadog and CloudWatch. Participate in incident response and post\-incident reviews. Security and compliance. Implement HIPAA\-compliant infrastructure patterns: IAM least\-privilege policies, encryption at rest and in transit, network isolation, audit logging, and data retention controls.Partner with the Security and Compliance team to maintain our SOC 2 and HITRUST posture. Cost optimization. Identify and implement cost savings: S3 lifecycle policies, right\-sizing compute, eliminating unused resources, consolidating per\-account overhead. Build cost visibility tooling and alerts. Cross\-team collaboration. Everyone who ships on this infrastructure is your customer, and Product Engineering is your closest one. Learn their workloads well enough to tell them a better way to run them. Qualifications Required: 5\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or SRE. Strong hands\-on AWS experience across core services: Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, SQS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, ECS/Fargate. Terraform proficiency: modules, workspaces, state management, CI/CD\-driven plan/apply. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation (GitHub Actions preferred). Comfort with Python (our pipeline services are Python\-based) and/or TypeScript. AI\-native engineering practice. You use AI tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow. Linux and networking fundamentals, and the security instincts to handle patient data carefully. Clear written and verbal communication. You collaborate closely and communicate proactively with team members on a daily basis. A self\-starter who can independently own problems from identification through solution and delivery. Preferred: Experience with multi\-tenant SaaS infrastructure, especially per\-customer account isolation patterns. Experience with serverless architecture at scale (hundreds of Lambda functions, DynamoDB single\-table design, SQS\-based orchestration). Experience with Datadog or similar observability platforms. Experience operating self\-managed databases on EC2 (MongoDB, Postgres, or similar). Experience planning and executing production migrations: re\-platforming live workloads without downtime or data loss. Experience working in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, FedRAMP , or similar).Kubernetes and Helm. Our self\-hosted GitHub Actions runners run on EKS via actions\-runner\- controller. Familiarity with AWS Organizations, Transit Gateway, RAM (Resource Access Manager) Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $185,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dedham, MA 02026

jobs.title: Embedded IT Manager
jobs.description: Embedded Embedded IT Manager Position Summary The Embedded IT Manager serves as the primary technology point of contact for assigned enterprise clients throughout the Omaha metropolitan area. This role works closely with client leadership, employees, vendors, and InfiNet teams to keep technology initiatives moving, solve operational challenges, and make sure the client's technology supports the way their business actually works. Because strong relationships and an understanding of day\-to\-day operations are central to this role, the Embedded IT Manager is expected to be based in the Omaha area and regularly work onsite with assigned clients. Over time, the Embedded IT Manager becomes an extension of the client's team, developing a strong understanding of their people, processes, applications, vendors, priorities, and technology environment. This is a hands\-on player\-coach role that combines client IT leadership with direct technical execution. The Embedded IT Manager / Systems Administrator personally performs systems administration, troubleshooting, maintenance, and implementation work while also helping clients manage technology priorities, improve business processes, coordinate vendors, oversee projects, support business applications, and connect the right InfiNet resources to specialized needs. The role is expected to resolve technical issues directly when they fall within its scope and bring in additional InfiNet expertise when appropriate. The Embedded IT Manager also serves as an important connection between the client and InfiNet, advocating for client needs while helping clients take full advantage of InfiNet's technical expertise, services, and resources. Essential Responsibilities Client IT Management \& Partnership * Serve as the primary IT management resource for assigned enterprise clients. * Build strong working relationships with client leadership, department managers, employees, and key stakeholders. * Develop a thorough understanding of each client's operations, technology environment, applications, vendors, and business priorities. * Participate in operational meetings, planning discussions, employee onboarding initiatives, department changes, and technology\-related decision making. * Help clients prioritize technology needs and determine the appropriate next steps, resources, and ownership. * Maintain visibility into open technology initiatives and help ensure commitments and follow\-ups are completed. * Serve as a consistent connection between the client organization and InfiNet. * Advocate for client needs internally and coordinate the appropriate InfiNet resources when additional expertise is required. Hands\-On Systems Administration \& Technical Support * Provide hands\-on administration and support for client technology environments, both onsite and remotely. * Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Microsoft 365, Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Server, Active Directory, endpoints, networks, virtualization platforms, backup systems, and security tools. * Manage user accounts, access permissions, group policies, device configurations, software deployments, and other day\-to\-day administrative tasks. * Diagnose and resolve escalated technical issues involving servers, workstations, cloud services, connectivity, applications, identity, and security. * Perform routine maintenance, patching, monitoring, backup verification, security remediation, and system health reviews. * Implement and support technology upgrades, migrations, new systems, and infrastructure improvements. * Maintain accurate technical documentation, system configurations, credentials, procedures, and client environment records. * Identify issues that require specialized expertise and coordinate an effective handoff to the appropriate InfiNet engineer or service team while retaining ownership through resolution. * Balance strategic and managerial responsibilities with the daily technical work required to keep client systems secure, reliable, and productive. Business Applications \& Process Improvement * Learn and understand the business\-critical applications clients rely on to operate. * Work with employees and department leaders to identify technology\-related pain points and inefficiencies. * Gather business requirements and translate them into practical technology solutions. * Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting, integrations, and automation. * Support, enhance, and troubleshoot line\-of\-business applications and integrations. * Design, develop, and maintain custom solutions when appropriate, including solutions utilizing Microsoft .NET and Java. * Work with InfiNet technical resources and third\-party vendors when solutions require specialized expertise. * Help clients continuously improve how technology supports their day\-to\-day operations. Vendor \& Technology Coordination * Serve as a primary point of contact for software vendors, technology providers, and third\-party consultants. * mmunication until issues and initiatives are resolved. Project \& Initiative Management * Coordinate technology projects and initiatives from planning through implementation. * Define requirements, responsibilities, timelines, dependencies, and next steps. * Work closely with InfiNet service, engineering, project, and account management teams. * Coordinate client employees, vendors, and technical resources involved in projects. * Identify potential risks, roadblocks, and resource requirements. * Maintain clear communication with stakeholders throughout technology initiatives. * Help ensure projects are completed successfully and operational needs are addressed before handoff. IT Planning \& Operations * Assist clients with technology budgeting, prioritization, lifecycle planning, and upcoming business needs. * Participate in planning for employee onboarding and offboarding, office changes, department growth, new applications, and other operational initiatives. * Establish and maintain appropriate technology standards, configurations, procedures, and technical documentation. * Provide guidance related to Microsoft 365, Azure, business applications, security, integrations, and general technology best practices. * Identify recurring technology issues and work with InfiNet teams to address underlying causes. * Stay informed about technologies that may improve client operations, efficiency, or employee experience. * Help clients understand their technology options and make informed decisions without unnecessary technical complexity. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or equivalent professional experience. * 5\+ years of experience in IT management, business technology, systems administration, application support, consulting, or a related role. * Demonstrated hands\-on systems administration experience supporting business technology environments. * Working knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 administration, Azure, endpoint management, networking, virtualization, backup, and cybersecurity fundamentals. * Ability to independently diagnose and resolve technical issues while recognizing when escalation or specialized engineering support is appropriate. * Ability and willingness to divide time between client leadership, project coordination, systems administration, and direct technical support. * Experience working directly with business leaders, department managers, employees, vendors, and technical teams. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, SQL Server, and related Microsoft technologies. * Experience supporting or enhancing line\-of\-business applications. * Experience with application development and integration technologies such as C\#, ASP.NET, .NET/.NET Core, Java, APIs, and SQL. * Experience gathering business requirements and translating them into technical solutions. * Experience coordinating technology vendors and external partners. * Strong troubleshooting, organization, and follow\-through skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Ability to manage multiple initiatives, priorities, vendors, and stakeholders simultaneously. Preferred Qualifications * Previous experience as an Embedded IT Manager , Business Systems Manager, Technology Manager, or similar role. * Experience working within an MSP, consulting, or professional services environment. * Experience supporting organizations with multiple line\-of\-business applications and technology vendors. * Experience with business process analysis, workflow optimization, and automation. * Experience managing technology projects or coordinating cross\-functional initiatives. * Project management experience or related certifications. * Microsoft, CompTIA, Cisco, or other relevant infrastructure and cloud certifications.

jobs.title: Data Engineer - New York Jobs CEO Council
jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** This role is central to building the technical foundation that will power the Jobs Council's next generation of impact measurement \- designing, building, and maintaining the data pipelines, schemas, and medallion architecture that connect fragmented data systems across programs, employer partnerships, and student engagement into a unified, analytics ready infrastructure. The Data Engineer will serve as the organization's internal technical lead for data integration and platform stewardship, reporting to the Senior Director for Data Strategy and working alongside the Data Analyst to ensure the Jobs Council's data infrastructure can support real\-time reporting, predictive modeling, and AI\-enabled insights at scale. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants to build something from the ground up and see the direct impact of that work in how a mission\-driven organization understands and advances workforce equity in New York City. The New York Jobs CEO Council fosters collaboration among business, education, and community leaders to prepare New Yorkers in diverse, low\-income communities for the future of work and meet employer needs. The future of New York City's economy and workforce requires breaking down industry and educational silos and opening the door to local talent. We are guided by our goal to place 100,000 low\-income New Yorkers from underserved and underrepresented communities into career\-pathway, living wage jobs by 2030, with 25,000 of those hires coming from CUNY. **About You** * **Analytical mindset** : You're curious, detailed oriented, with excellent problem\-solving abilities. * **Cross\-Disciplinary Background:** Experience that spans both data science and data engineering — you understand how data gets used downstream, not just how it gets stored. * **Comfort with Broad Ownership:** You've thrived in small or scaling organizations where wearing multiple hats was the norm — and you've sought out that kind of ownership and variety rather than resisted it. * **Building Experience** : You've built data infrastructure from the ground up — standing up tables, schemas, and pipelines in environments where the structure didn't yet exist. * **Strong Communicator :** You're comfortable as the technical expert in the room — asking the right questions and translating complex data concepts for leadership, vendors, and analysts alike. * **Self\-Directed** : You're able to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and drive your work forward — you don't wait for structure to exist before you create it. **What You'll Do:****Core Data Engineering (primary responsibilities, 70\-80%)** * **Pipeline Ownership:** Design, build, and maintain automated ETL/ELT pipelines across various platforms (Db2, Salesforce, event platforms, Handshake, SurveyMonkey, 8x8, and SFTP partner feeds) * **Schema \& Data Modeling:** Design the database tables and schemas for analytical flexibility and long\-term reuse. * **Medallion Architecture:** Own and maintain the bronze/silver/gold layered architecture that supports advanced reporting, predictive models, and AI\-enabled insights. * **Data Governance \& Platform Stewardship:** Implement governance controls, data quality checkpoints, role\-based access, and documentation across the platform. * **Data Model Maintenance:** Execute continuous improvements to the data model as organizational needs evolve. * **Technical Lead/Liaison:** Serve as the internal technical lead and contribute in strategic data integration discussions to ensure data model sustainability, governance, and longevity. **BI, Reporting \& Business Logic Partnership (secondary responsibilities, 20\-30%)** * **Dashboard Design and integration:** Support the build\-out of purpose\-built dashboards for the Engagement team, Partnerships team, leadership, and external audiences. Partner with the Data Analyst to ensure the data model allows for KPI delivery. * **KPI Reporting Automation:** Support the implement of automated reporting by maintaining the data model and developing target specific tables/views to allow for seamless visualization tools. * **Data Dictionary and Documentation:** Maintain an up\-to\-date data dictionary and table/schema directory to allow for Data Analysts to self\-service complex reporting. * **AI/ML Automation:** Structure the data model in a way that can be utilized for various AI/ML tools (chatbots, reporting/spreadsheet generation, etc.) **Your Background:*** 5\+ years of hands\-on data engineering experience in production environments * Expertise in ETL/ELT pipeline design, data modeling, and cloud\-native platforms * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and API/webhook\-based integration patterns * Experience with relational databases, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), and modern lakehouse/medallion architectures * Track record of building automated reporting infrastructure and reusable data templates * Analytical mindset with excellent problem\-solving abilities Salary for this role is commensurate with experience, ranging from $140,000\-$155,000 annually. jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Utilidata is a fast\-growing NVIDIA\-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid — bringing real\-time visibility and power\-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them. The AI Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and owning the end\-to\-end infrastructure that serves Utilidata's AI and ML models across edge deployments, cloud environments, and data center integrations. They are also responsible for designing, building, and owning the integration of power data with AI inference software. This is Utilidata's first dedicated role of this kind, and will serve as the foundational function for how the company deploys and operates AI capabilities in production. The role requires deep technical expertise in ML model serving, distributed systems, and GPU infrastructure, with a strong emphasis on reliability, performance, and scalability. jobs.title: VP, AI & Applications
jobs.description: Utilidata is a fast\-growing NVIDIA\-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid — bringing real\-time visibility and power\-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them. The VP, AI \& Applications leads the intelligence layer of Karman — the algorithms, control methods, and optimization techniques that turn microsecond\-resolution measurement data into closed\-loop control actions and quantifiable customer value. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role owns how Karman creates value across the data center power system: the internal power distribution system, the utility connection, and ancillary loads and generation including cooling, capacitor shelves, and on\-site solar plus battery. The VP partners with the VP, Engineering on the platform that runs these methods in production, and with VP, Product on how value is packaged and delivered to customers. **Responsibilities*** Lead and set technical direction for the team responsible for Karman's algorithms, control methods, optimization, and applied research — including power flow control and closed\-loop adaptive control — through direct management of a Director and Principal\-level individual contributors * Drive technical co\-development with strategic technology partners across hardware, firmware, and commercial tracks, and provide customer\-facing technical leadership, working with GTM and Product * Develop and manage release plans for algorithms and applications work, with clear engineering direction, validation strategy, and tracking against committed product capabilities * Partner with the VP, Engineering to ensure algorithms and control methods are designed for production deployment on the Karman software and hardware platform * Stay hands\-on early in the role and scale toward leader\-of\-leaders as the team grows * Collaborate with the People Team to attract, onboard, and retain top talent in algorithms, applied AI, and control systems * Optimize resource allocation, budgeting, and timelines for team effectiveness * Develop and report on success metrics that measure the team's contribution to organizational objectives **Minimum Qualifications*** 10\-15\+ years of professional experience leading teams that develop algorithms, control systems, optimization methods, or applied AI in production * Deep technical background in one or more of: control theory, power systems, optimization, applied machine learning, or signal processing * Demonstrated experience in algorithms and decision\-making paradigms with edge AI tools, including control systems that run offline or isolated for extended periods * Track record of developing leaders and growing the careers of senior engineers and researchers; sees mentorship and team development as a core measure of personal impact * Demonstrated ability to lead a senior, technically deep team while remaining hands\-on enough to shape architecture and methods directly * Experience translating research and prototypes into shipped products in a startup or fast\-moving environment * Strong communication skills, including the ability to represent technical work credibly to executives, customers, and external technical organizations * Experience with intellectual property strategy and the patent process * Willingness to travel up to 20% of time **Enhanced Qualifications (Nice to Have)*** PhD strongly preferred in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Control Systems, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related technical discipline * Experience with energy systems, power electronics, or grid\-edge applications * Published research, granted patents, or recognized contributions to control systems, applied AI, or power systems * Background in real\-time systems, deterministic control loops, or hard real\-time operating systems * Experience with digital twins, hardware\-in\-the\-loop simulation, or co\-simulation environments **Salary Range:** $230,000 to $290,000 base compensation depending on experience plus stock options. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - C++/Architecture & Design
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e\-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high\-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e\-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield\-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. We are seeking a highly experienced Sr. Software Engineer to lead the architecture, design, and development of complex software systems that power next\-generation semiconductor inspection and metrology products. This role is ideal for a hands\-on technical leader who thrives on solving challenging engineering problems, defining scalable software architectures, and influencing the technical direction of sophisticated hardware\-software platforms. You will work closely with systems engineers, software developers, physicists, algorithm teams, and product engineers to design and deliver high\-performance C\+\+ applications that drive innovation across KLA's product portfolio. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of complex software systems using modern C\+\+. * Define scalable, maintainable, and high\-performance software architectures aligned with product and technology roadmaps. * Drive software design decisions, conduct architecture reviews, and establish technical standards across development teams. * Develop robust frameworks, libraries, and reusable components that improve product consistency and engineering productivity. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including systems engineering, algorithms, hardware engineering, and product development to deliver integrated solutions. * Analyze complex technical requirements and translate them into elegant, scalable software designs. * Drive resolution of critical system\-level issues through root cause analysis and architectural improvements. * Evaluate and introduce new technologies, tools, and development methodologies through proof\-of\-concept initiatives. * Promote engineering excellence through best practices in software design, code quality, testing, automation, and continuous integration. * Optimize software performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability across distributed and real\-time systems. * Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across multiple projects. * Influence long\-term software strategy and contribute to future platform and product architecture decisions. * Communicate complex technical concepts, tradeoffs, and architectural recommendations to engineering and business stakeholders. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. * Minimum of 12\+ years of professional software development experience with a strong emphasis on C\+\+ development. * Proven experience designing and delivering large\-scale, complex software systems from architecture through deployment. * Deep expertise in object\-oriented design, software architecture, design patterns, and modern C\+\+ development. * Strong understanding of multi\-threaded, distributed, and high\-performance software systems. * Experience developing software for complex engineering, scientific, semiconductor, industrial automation, or hardware\-integrated applications. * Demonstrated ability to architect scalable and maintainable software solutions that span multiple products and teams. * Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills in complex software environments. * Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC), code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD workflows, and software qu stems. * Familiarity with image processing, machine vision, scientific computing, or data\-intensive applications. * Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical initiatives across multiple teams. * Exposure to cloud technologies, software automation frameworks, and modern DevOps practices. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- * Architecting software solutions that support next\-generation semiconductor products. * Driving key technical decisions that improve scalability, performance, and reliability. * Reducing technical debt while accelerating product development. * Establishing engineering best practices that elevate software quality across teams. * Serving as a trusted technical leader and mentor within the organization. **Minimum Qualifications** Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $159,500\.00 \- $233,967\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-CA\-Milpitas\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. jobs.title: Electronics Technician
jobs.description: **Position Summary** We are seeking a detail\-oriented and technically skilled electronics professional to support the design, assembly, testing, troubleshooting, and repair of electronic products, prototypes, and test systems. This role requires strong soldering and electronics repair experience, the ability to support multiple projects simultaneously, and effective collaboration with engineers, interns, and other team members. **Key Responsibilities – includes but are not limited to, the following:** * Perform advanced soldering and desoldering on through\-hole, SMT, wire harness, and microprocessor components (including microprocessor replacement). * Troubleshoot embedded electronic systems and diagnose technical issues efficiently. * Support and help coordinate the work of interns while managing multiple assignments and priorities. * Design, assemble, and test electrical components for customer products, prototypes, and test systems in accordance with engineering instructions, technical manuals, and established electronics practices. * Assist engineers with the development and implementation of new designs. * Research, source, and order parts as needed, and maintain inventory for test fixtures, repairs, and related materials. * Test electronic units, including prototypes and customer products, using standard test equipment; analyze results to evaluate performance and determine the need for adjustments or repairs. * Maintain a clean, organized, and safe lab work environment. * Perform additional shop and technical support duties as assigned. **Required Qualifications** * Demonstrated experience in soldering and desoldering through\-hole, SMT, wire harness, and microprocessor components. * Strong experience troubleshooting, repairing, and testing electronic and electromechanical devices. * Ability to manage multiple projects and work effectively in a fast\-paced environment. * Strong organizational and communication skills with consistent attention to cleanliness and order in the lab. * Professional communication skills, including verbal, written, phone, and email communication. * Define and enforce lab working procedures – managing request flows, escalations, enforcing basic minimum work order details to proceed with jobs. * Ability to work both independently and collaboratively as part of a team. * Ability to train junior technicians in soldering/desoldering techniques. * Proficiency with computer\-based systems and software, including Microsoft Office; familiarity with AutoCAD is a plus. **Preferred Qualifications** * Associate degree in Electronics Technology or equivalent hands\-on experience. * Experience in the Tier 1 automotive industry. * Experience with SAP or similar inventory/data management systems. * Military 2M certification or equivalent civilian soldering certification. Pay: $25\.83 \- $31\.11 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Software Data Engineer (Bachelor’s degree required from a U.S.-accredited university) - On W2
jobs.description: **Role Overview:**We are seeking a motivated early\-career Software Engineer (2\+ years of experience) with a Computer Science background to join our team as a long\-term contributor. You will work alongside experienced vehicle data engineers and analysts to build internal tooling, automate job orchestration, and maintain CI/CD pipelines — enabling the team to move faster and focus on higher\-order analysis work. This is a heads\-down engineering role with a meaningful impact on the team's overall productivity. The right candidate will be technically sharp, self\-directed, and eager to learn about the large\-scale data domain and product application over time. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain internal tooling that supports team data workflows and reduces manual effort * Own and improve GitHub CI/CD pipelines to support reliable, repeatable deployments * Develop and manage automated Databricks job orchestration and workflow scheduling * Collaborate with data engineers to support pipeline development on an as\-needed basis * Write clear documentation for tooling, processes, and automation solutions * Support Repo management \- participate in code reviews, uphold software quality standards, and contribute to team engineering practices * Develop or consume REST APIs to connect internal systems or trigger automated workflows **Technical Skills:** * **Python:** primary development language for tooling, automation, and scripting * **GitHub / Git:** branching strategies, pull request workflows, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD pipeline management * **Databricks, Snowflake, or Equivalent:** notebooks, jobs, Workflows for job orchestration and scheduling * **SQL:** querying and transforming structured data; basic ETL/data engineering concepts * **Workflow Orchestration:** understanding of dependency management, scheduling, and pipeline patterns * **VS Code:** modern IDE proficiency including extensions, debugging, and integrated terminal workflows, and GitHub Copilot integration. **Nice to Have:** * **REST APIs:** experience building or consuming RESTful APIs in Python (e.g., FastAPI, Flask, requests) * **Databricks Asset Bundles:** or equivalent infrastructure\-as\-code approaches for Databricks resource management * **Docker / Containers:** basic containerization concepts for reproducible environments * **Delta Lake / Parquet:** familiarity with columnar and transactional data formats used in lakehouse architectures * **Off\-Road / Telematics:** any exposure to vehicle data, CAN bus, or telematics systems is a strong plus **Experience \& Education Required:** * 2\+ years of professional software development experience, including internships or co\-op roles * Bachelor’s degree in Computer science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field (or equivalent practical experience) * Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable Python code * Experience working in a collaborative Git\-based development workflow * Experience with Identifying business needs and developing recommendations and solutions Pay: $40\.00 \- $45\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * Python: 2 years (Required) * GitHub: 2 years (Required) * SQL: 2 years (Required) Work Location: On the road

The structure of our organization is designed to amplify your capabilities while gaining the benefits of being an employee\-owner. What truly sets this opportunity apart is the chance to collaborate every day with dedicated, skilled, and supportive leaders. Whether you are in the office, in the field, or behind the scenes, working at LJA gives you the chance to grow through hands\-on experience and exposure to a broad range of clients and services. **WHAT MAKES LJA DIFFERENT** At LJA, our employee\-owners take pride in their work and their workplace. We’re guided by leaders who foster a culture of respect, collaboration and a shared vision of success. Our difference is evident in the experiences and opportunities we provide: * Employee\-owned. Client\-focused * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) * Consistently ranked as a ***Top Workplace*** * Internal recruitment team, in\-house training, and a marketing department specific to our industry * We celebrate flexibility, allowing every team and office to lead with their proven approach * Our culture champions continuous learning and personal growth * We believe success comes through constant evolution and communication * We are passionate about having fun and making money, all while creating impact **POSITION OVERVIEW:** As a **Graduate Engineer** at LJA **Land Development**, you will use AutoCAD Civil3D, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office and other design and production software to provide design, production, and project administrative support in the delivery of feasibilities, opinions of probable cost, studies, exhibits, construction plans, takeoffs, bid packages, models, and development support tasks for an extensive list of public and private clients. Our exciting and entrepreneurial culture will allow you to think creatively, solve problems and meet the needs of our clients daily. **A TYPICAL DAY MIGHT INCLUDE:** * Collaborate with technical experts, peers, and support roles to perform design calculations, prepare equipment or material specifications, and generate technical drawings and exhibits * Expanding your engineering toolbox and vocabulary to add knowledge of advanced techniques, applied theory, industry concepts, and best practices. * Assignments require the investigation of a limited number of variables; supervisory assistance is provided on unusual problems and possible solutions. * Working in an office equipped with meeting rooms, amenities, and excellent technology. * Investigating existing site conditions, jurisdictional criteria, and constraints to inform design iterations and direction. * Check\-ins with your manager and other engineering mentors to identify areas of excellence and growth opportunities. * Providing information or exhibits to inform client and internal leaders in decision making related to the execution or implementation of project objectives. **REQUIRED EDUCATION/LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor of Science Degree from ABET accredited university (Civil Engineering Preferred) **IDEALLY, YOU SHOULD ALSO HAVE:** * Experience with AutoCAD Civil 3D * Previous work experience in the engineering industry * Experience with Bluebeam and Water Resources Software (HEC\-RAS \& HEC\-HMS) * Passed the FE Exam * Strong communication skills * Team Mentality **LEVEL UP WITH LJA** At LJA, we’re 100% employee\-owned. ensure product testability, manufacturability, and field reliability. * Oversee site metrology practices, First Article Inspections (FAIs), and equipment calibration schedules to guarantee continuous measurement integrity across manufacturing lines. * Establish key hardware quality metrics and trend reporting (DPPM, yield loss, field failure Pareto charts) to guide executive operational priorities and continuous improvement goals. **OUR IDEAL CANDIDATE** * 6\+ years of hardware quality, reliability, or manufacturing engineering experience, with at least 2\+ years in a direct engineering management or team leadership role. * Strong track record of establishing quality documentation and processes aligned with ISO 9001 standards within a lean manufacturing context. * Deep technical expertise in Root Cause Analysis methodologies (8D, 5\-Why, Fishbone, DMAIC) applied to electro\-mechanical hardware, solar/power systems, custom PCBAs, and vision devices. * Proven experience establishing and validating test methods, screening processes, and test equipment fixtures alongside Manufacturing Engineering teams. * Experience driving supplier quality, vendor corrective actions, governance. * Active experience collaborating with Hardware Engineering teams during early\-stage NPI gate reviews to ensure design for quality. * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline. * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is preferred. **BENEFITS** We believe you Agents operate on an event pipeline that feeds them what's happening across tens of thousands of edge devices and carries their decisions back out to the field. This role builds and hardens the cloud backbone of that platform the event pipeline agents consume from and act through, and the context stores they query. You'll own the cloud\-side reliability, throughput, and scale of the event pipeline, the router/dispatcher that fans events to intelligence services, the projections that make events queryable (including the agent\-facing, MCP\-exposed context layer), and the observability that keeps it healthy under load. jobs.title: Product Development Engineer - Controls, Firmware & Electromechanical R&D
jobs.description: **Product Development Engineer — Controls, Firmware \& Electromechanical R\&D** Lake Lite, Inc. · Avilla, Indiana (on\-site — not a remote position) · Full\-time · Small in\-house engineering team **$95,000 – $120,000 / year, based on experience** **You'd be the third engineer on a small in\-house team.** Lake Lite has two experienced engineers on staff — our lead product development engineer and our mechanical/electrical engineer. You'll have peers to whiteboard with, a mechanical designer to co\-design enclosures and mechanisms with, and design reviews that are real conversations. **We hire the person, then build the role.** We're not filling a slot on an org chart. If you're strong in an area we hadn't planned for — machine design, automation, product management, something we haven't thought of — that becomes part of what you do here. Tell us what you're best at and we'll aim the work at it. **Build the whole product, not one slice of it.** Lake Lite is a 25\-person R\&D\-driven company in Avilla, Indiana, and our product line covers the waterfront: controls for every style of boat lift (cable, hydraulic, air\-displacement, coastal, and powered lift screens), solar charging kits for boat lifts, advanced solar lighting for docks and homes, and a growing lineup of marine and waterfront equipment. Our products mix motor control, wireless remotes, sensors, solar power, app connectivity, and rugged mechanical design — and we develop all of it in\-house. **No boring one\-product job here.** You'll work on multiple products at once in a rapid\-development environment — writing the firmware, wiring up the bench, debugging with a scope, and carrying products from working prototype through validation to production. If you've spent your career (or your garage years) building electromechanical things that survive the real world, you'll feel at home here. **Who you'll work with** * **Lead Product Development Engineer** — your first stop when you need to know why something works the way it does, and a second set of eyes on your designs. * **Mechanical / Electrical Engineer** — you'll co\-design boards, enclosures, sealing, and mounting together instead of inheriting a box your board has to fit into. * **The owner** — directly, daily. He's an engineer and product developer himself, not a spreadsheet layer between you and the work. * **Production, purchasing, and sales** — all in the same building, so you hear from the field fast when something misbehaves on a real dock. **What you'll own** * Firmware design and development for boat lift controls and marine products (motor control, remotes, sensing, connectivity) * Hardware bring\-up, bench testing, and debugging of new control products * Product validation: test plans, environmental/field testing, and the fixes that follow * Supporting our mobile app features and the firmware interfaces behind them * Taking concepts to production alongside our mechanical design and production teams **What you must bring** * **4\+ years of embedded/electromechanical product development building things people actually use** — professional or seriously self\-taught; we care what you've built, not where you learned it * Solid embedded firmware skills (C/C\+\+ on microcontrollers) and comfort debugging real hardware * Hands\-on instinct: you reach for the multimeter, scope, and soldering iron without being asked * Self\-direction and follow\-through from prototype to production, not just proof\-of\-concept **Nice to have (tell us if you've got it)** * Motor control, power electronics, or RF/BLE/Wi\-Fi connectivity experience * Mobile app development or app/firmware integration * PCB design, PLC/automation experience, or SolidWorks familiarity * Marine, outdoor, or harsh\-environment product experience **A note on credentials:** an engineering degree is welcome but not required. If you're self\-taught and have real products to prove it, we'd rather see the products than the diploma. **Benefits** * 3 weeks paid vacation \+ 1 week paid wellness days \+ 13 paid holidays * Health insurance with company\-funded HSA contribution (spouse \& dependent coverage available) * Profit sharing plan and annual reviews **Where we are** Avilla, Indiana — about 30 minutes north of Fort Wayne, 10 minutes from Kendallville, 20 from Auburn, and an easy drive from Columbia City, Ligonier, Angola, and the Warsaw/Winona Lake area. On\-site, five days a week: this is hands\-on product work with a machine shop, a prototype bench, and a production floor in the same building. **How to apply** Send your resume plus something you've built — a product in the field, a side project, a GitHub repo, a video of the thing working. Applications that show real hardware/firmware work go to the top of the pile. We read everything and respond within two business days. Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off Application Question(s): * Describe a product you personally took from concept through validation to production. What was your role, and what did you learn? Ability to Commute: * Avilla, IN 46710 (Required) Work Location: In person

Please note the following important tips for applying.** * ### **All portions of the application must be completed in detail. Work history, applicable education, and answers to the supplemental questions are all required. Applications missing any one of these sections will be rejected as incomplete. Referral to a resume is not acceptable.** * ### **Set aside some time to complete your application. The system is unable to save applications that are in progress, and once you have submitted the application you cannot reapply.** * ### **We strongly recommend that you review all the information on your application for accuracy. Once an application is submitted, you will be unable to edit it.** * ### **Submitted applications are not viewable. If you would like to keep a record of what you will be submitting, we suggest you type your responses to the questions in a Word document, then copy and paste the answers into the application then save the Word document. Typing questions in Word will also minimize typing/grammatical errors since this is not an option in the system.** **NOTE: If you are a current employee, you MUST apply via the Career worklet in Workday and not through this site. If you submit an application on this site, it cannot be processed.** Engineering Technician II Open Date: 09/21/26 Close Date: 10/21/26 Salary: $42\.14 per hour Job Type: Regular Location: Valley View Campus, 1001 S. Valley View Blvd., Las Vegas For any questions regarding this announcement, please contact LVVWD Recruitment at recruitment@lvvwd.com. HOURS OF WORK: 4/10's, 6:00 a.m. \- 4:30 p.m., Mon\-Thurs FILING DEADLINE: The first 100 applications submitted ON or BEFORE 11:59pm, Tuesday, October 20th, 2026, WHICHEVER COMES FIRST. The ideal candidate would possess a broad knowledge of water treatment and transmission equipment such as pumps, valves, motors, actuators, motor control centers (MCC), protection relays as well as the preparation of multi\-discipline engineering drawings utilizing AutoCAD; show some familiarity with standard practices for the potable water industry; demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate complex ideas to non\-technical personnel, verbally or in writing; and have experience working with maintenance shop personnel. With minimal supervision and under tight deadlines, the ideal candidate would also be able to work effectively on critical projects and systems within a team environment. INTRODUCTION: Human Resources will screen applications and supplemental questionnaires. Candidates possessing the strongest skills and experience for this position will be forwarded to the hiring department for further evaluation and to determine who will be invited to the formal interview process. The candidate hired will be required to pass a drug screening, background check, and may be required to pass a job\-related physical evaluation.**GENERAL PURPOSE** Under general supervision, performs technical and paraprofessional engineering duties in support of a variety of engineering design and construction, resource planning and operations analyses; and performs related duties as assigned. **DESIRED MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** **Knowledge of:** Basic principles, practices and methods of engineering design and construction applicable to a large complex potable water utility; engineering mathematics, including algebra, geometry and trigonometry; fluid flow theory and design concepts; methods of hydraulic analysis and modeling; methods and procedures for development of engineering design and construction specifications; terminology, methods, practices, techniques and nomenclature of civil, mechanical and/or electrical engineering drafting; digital data handling and reporting methods and software; basic design and operations of the District's distribution and transmission systems; applicable District operating policies and departmental work procedures and quality standards; legal and regulatory requirements applicable to water works engineering. **Ability to:** Perform highly technical engineering analyses and calculations and reach sound accurate conclusions; read, understand and interpret engineering plans, drawings, specifications, maps and other technical materials applicable to the work; operate and use a variety of field test and data collection equipment to obtain highly accurate data; utilize GIS and other engineering/facilities databases to obtain information required for the work; precisely follow written and oral instructions; perform highly detailed work thoroughly, neatly and accurately; develop and maintain effective working relationships with District staff, consulting engineers, representatives of other agencies and others encountered in the course of work. **Training and Experience:** A typical way of obtaining the knowledge, skills and abilities outlined above is graduation from high school or G.E.D. equivalent, supplemented by college\-level course work in engineering, drafting, engineering mathematics or related fields; and four years of progressively responsible sub\-professional engineering or field survey experience; or an equivalent combination of training and experience. **Licenses; Certificates; Special Requirements:** Some positions may require a Nevada driver’s license and the ability to maintain insurability under the District’s Vehicle Insurance Policy. State of Nevada Division of Environmental Protection Distribution Operator in Training certificate within 12 months of hire. **PHYSICAL AND MENTAL DEMANDS** The physical and mental demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this class. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Physical Demands** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk, stand or sit; talk or hear, both in person and by telephone; use hands to finger, handle, feel or operate computers, data acquisition and other equipment and tools; and reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to lift or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision and the ability to focus. **Mental Demands** While performing the duties of this class, the employee is regularly required to use written and oral communication skills; read and interpret highly technical information and documents; analyze and solve technical engineering problems; engineering math and mathematical reasoning; observe and interpret situations; perform highly detailed work on multiple, concurrent tasks; work with constant interruptions; and interact with District staff, consulting engineers, representatives of other agencies and others encountered in the course of work.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I
jobs.description: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated **Site Reliability Engineer** to join our newly formed Enterprise GitHub Operations \& Tooling team. This is a foundational role where you will be instrumental in designing, building, and managing the core services and tooling that underpin our extensive use of GitHub Enterprise. You will be responsible for developing code and solutions that automate and enforce policies for our GitHub Organizations, streamline repository lifecycle management, and integrate tightly with our broader enterprise ecosystem. This role is ideal for an engineer with a strong background in operations or infrastructure, a passion for automation, and keen to leverage cutting\-edge technologies like Generative AI. **What You'll Do** * **Design \& Develop:** Architect, develop, and maintain robust, scalable software solutions for managing GitHub Enterprise resources. This will primarily involve writing code (Go) that interacts extensively with GitHub's APIs. * **GitHub Organization Orchestration:** Build tools and services to automate the creation, configuration, and policy enforcement across multiple GitHub Organizations. * **Repository Lifecycle Management:** Develop systems for standardized repository creation, management, archiving, and deletion, ensuring compliance and security best practices. * **Policy Enforcement:** Implement mechanisms, potentially including custom GitHub Apps and Actions, to enforce organizational policies around code quality, security, and contribution guidelines. This includes exploring alternatives to traditional pre\-commit hooks. * **Tooling Integration:** Integrate GitHub with other enterprise services (e.g., identity providers, security scanners, compliance platforms) to create a seamless developer experience. * **Automation:** Drive automation initiatives for operational tasks related to GitHub, reducing manual effort and improving efficiency. * **Generative AI Adoption:** Actively explore and implement the use of Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) within development processes to enhance productivity and code quality. * **Collaboration:** Work closely with security, infrastructure, and development teams to understand requirements, gather feedback, and ensure solutions meet enterprise\-wide needs. * **Documentation:** Create clear, comprehensive documentation for the tools and services you develop. * **Mentorship:** Provide technical leadership and mentor junior engineers within the team and across the organization. **What We're Looking For** **Mandatory Skills \& Experience:** * **Software Development:** Strong proficiency in the Go programming language. * **API Interaction:** Experience designing, consuming, and interacting with APIs. * **GitHub Ecosystem:** Solid understanding of GitHub Enterprise features, best practices, and strong practical experience with: + **GitHub APIs** (REST and GraphQL) + **GitHub Apps** (building, deploying, managing) + **GitHub Actions** (designing complex workflows, custom actions) + GitHub Enterprise, Organization and Repository settings. * **Operations/Infrastructure Background:** Proven experience in an operations, site reliability engineering (SRE), or infrastructure engineering role, with a strong appreciation for automation and stability. * **Modern SDLC Practices:** Familiarity with: + Dependency management. + Security remediation processes and secure coding practices. + Testing frameworks and methodologies. + Version control (Git) and Git workflows. * **Problem Solving:** Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive approach to identifying and addressing challenges. * **Infrastructure as Code (IaC):** Hands\-on experience with **Terraform** or similar tooling for managing cloud resources. **Highly Advantageous Skills \& Experience:** * **Generative AI Inclination:** A strong interest in, and practical experience with, leveraging Generative AI tools in daily development processes. * **Containerization \& Orchestration:** Familiarity with **Docker and Kubernetes** , including the use of Kubernetes controllers. * **Cloud Platforms:** Experience with **AWS or Azure** public cloud services, including networking, compute, and IAM concepts. * **Security Domain Knowledge:** Understanding of common security vulnerabilities and best practices in a cloud/DevOps context. **We know your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. We are delighted to offer country specific benefits. Click** **here** **to access benefits specific to your location.** We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. If you have a disability or other need that requires accommodation or adjustment, please let us know by completing our Applicant Request Support Form or please contact 1\-855\-833\-5120\. **Criminals may pose as recruiters asking for money or personal information. We never request money or banking details from job applicants. Learn more about spotting and avoiding scams** **here** **.** Please read our Candidate Privacy Policy . We are an equal opportunity employer: qualified applicants are considered for and treated during employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, national origin, citizenship status, disability status, protected veteran status, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. ***USA Job Seekers:*** EEO Know Your Rights .

jobs.title: Principal Data Engineer - Global Cybersecurity Data & Analytics
jobs.description: **Description**We deliver our customers peace of mind every day by helping them protect what they value most. Our passion for placing the customer at the center of everything we do is driving a transformational shift at Liberty Mutual. Operating as a tech startup within a Fortune 100 company, we are leading a digital disruption that will redefine how people experience insurance. Our Global Cybersecurity Data and Analytics team is tasked with gathering, processing, and analyzing data to provide meaningful insights for informed decision\-making, strategic planning, and operational improvements. We create accurate reports and visualizations that help the organization achieve its objectives, enhance security, and stay competitive. In addition, the data and analytics teams ensure data quality, compliance with regulations, and effective collaboration across departments. By leveraging advanced techniques and tools, they transform data into actionable intelligence that drives both short\-term optimizations and long\-term growth. **Job Introduction** The Global Cybersecurity Data and Analytics team is seeking an innovative, collaborative Principal Data Engineer to help build and grow our Data and Analytics practice. As a member of the team, you will play a crucial role in delivering innovative data\-driven solutions that enhance our organization's cybersecurity posture. Under general direction, acts as a technical expert who consults on highly complex projects. Responsible for the analysis, development, and execution of complex data solutions, to manage the information lifecycle needs of an organization. Collects, integrates, and analyzes data with the purpose of drawing conclusions about that information. Develops, constructs, tests, and maintains data architectures for data platforms, databases, analytical/reporting, or data science systems. Establishes and builds data systems including providing standards, policies, practice, procedures, governance, and quality assurance for data deliverables. Recommends methods to improve data reliability, quality, and efficiency. Devises or modifies procedures to solve technical problems. Leads and directs the work of team members. May mentor junior team members. **Responsibilities** * Consults on designing and developing complex programs and tools to support ingestion, curation, and provisioning of complex enterprise data to achieve analytics, reporting, and data science. * Builds and designs data architecture that improve accessibility, efficiency, governance, and quality of data. * Collects, cleans, and transforms traditional and big data to ensure data accuracy and accessibility. * Makes recommendations for how to improve data and drives those recommendations forward. * Builds in\-depth knowledge of technology enablers. * Documents existing processes, organizational structures, architectures, and external systems. * Contributes to the development and enhancement of solutions for key business outcomes. * Develops interactive and visually appealing data visualizations of large amounts of data to reveal patterns, trends, or correlations. * Provides guidance on capabilities and functionalities of Power BI visualization tools. * Presents to, and educates, a wide range of people on using visualizations. * Actively uses AI tools to improve the speed, quality, and scale of work; can point to concrete workflows where AI adds value; critically evaluates and validates AI\-generated output; and applies AI responsibly, protecting confidential and customer data. **Qualifications*** Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical or business discipline or equivalent experience, technical degree preferred * Generally, 8\+ years of professional experience * In\-depth knowledge of IT concepts, strategies, and methodologies * In\-depth knowledge of diverse and emerging technologies and new architectural concepts and principles * Knowledgeable in data engineering languages and tools; proficient in new and emerging technologies * In\-depth understanding of layered solutions and designs; in\-depth understanding of shared data engineering concepts and product features, as well as security minded * In\-depth knowledge of business operations, objectives, and strategies; in\-depth understanding of global business and technology trends and the financial services industry * Highly developed negotiation, consensus building \& influencing skills, facilitation, and adaptability to respond to change quickly * Highly developed oral and written communication skills; strong presentation skills * Ability to effectively collaborate with all levels of the organization * Solid Python Pandas and SQL programming skills with analytical and critical thinking skills with an understanding of big data technology * An understanding of machine learning principles, statistics and algorithms. * Understanding of Data Warehouse solutions, modeling and governance **Experience** * Working knowledge of AWS, Azure and GCP cloud environments * Power BI development (DAX and M query) and Power BI gateway * Snowflake administration experience * AWS Airflow * History of working with ETL (extract, transfer and load) and data pipeline technology * Proven experience in data modeling, governance and analytics * Ability to leverage and build APIs * Python programming knowledge * SQL query and data management **About Us****Pay Philosophy:** The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role. At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well\-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about\-lm/careers/benefits Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law. **Fair Chance Notices** * California * Los Angeles Incorporated * Los Angeles Unincorporated * Philadelphia * San Francisco
