jobs.title: Lead Data Scientist
jobs.description: Apply now » **Date:** Sep 21, 2026 **Location:** Atlanta, GA, US, 30308 **Company:** Norfolk Southern Corp. Requisition 40325: Lead Data Scientist \- Machine Learning ***A resume helps you stand out to hiring managers and recruiters; your resume communicates your experience and your brand. While it is not required, we encourage you to include an up\-to\-date resume along with a completed job application to give you the best opportunity to be considered. A complete resume helps us to better understand your unique background, relevant experiences, and passions. We look forward to learning about you.*** Norfolk Southern offers a unique opportunity to be part of our proud legacy that spans nearly 200 years. We are a customer\-centric, operations\-driven team dedicated to advancing safety, serving communities, and driving innovation for tomorrow's rail. As part of Norfolk Southern, you’ll join a collaborative team where there are opportunities for growth across the organization. We are building a culture where everyone can thrive by owning and driving exceptional results, being humble and leading with trust, serving our customers with excellence, and collaborating and coaching to win. **Job Description** ------------------- Norfolk Southern is seeking a Lead Data Scientist \- Machine Learning to lead the design, development, deployment, and monitoring of advanced machine learning solutions that drive operational efficiency, safety, reliability, and business value across the enterprise. This role combines deep technical expertise in machine learning with strong leadership and business engagement skills. The Lead Data Scientist will work closely with Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, Software Engineering, and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, develop scalable solutions, and mentor a team of data scientists. This position will focus on Machine Learning models (regression, classification, clustering, etc.) and it will not have a Computer Vision focus. Hands\-on role requiring the individual to conduct research, develop and deploy analytical models, and take partial ownership of productionization activities to ensure successful implementation of solutions. **Who we are and what we do:** The AI and Data Science team is centralized across the entire organization. We work with various product teams across various business units to define high\-impact business problems, solve them using novel techniques, and execute and monitor them throughout their lifecycle. Most of our models make it to production, they never sit in a research lab. But we also do quite a bit of research to stay up\-to\-date with the latest technologies/algorithms. We are very collaborative; you will likely get lots of ideas from the team. **What kind of problems do we solve:** There are high\-frame cameras beside our tracks, capturing images of trains and rail cars as they pass. We design various Deep Learning and Computer Vision algorithms to detect certain objects of interest or issues and defects. We then optimize their performance and deploy them at the edge for real\-time scoring and notification of our mechanical personnel upon detections. Our locomotives stream 350\+ sensor information in real\-time. We create predictive models to predict various component failures hours, days, and sometimes months in advance. The team is responsible for modeling operational data to develop data\-driven solutions for network optimization problems, including ETA prediction and other transportation and logistics use cases. The team provides a wide range of ad hoc analytical support and insights to diverse stakeholder groups. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Lead the design, development, validation, and deployment of machine learning solutions. * Architect end\-to\-end ML workflows from data acquisition through production deployment and monitoring. * Establish standards and best practices for model development, experimentation, testing, and governance. * Drive adoption of modern ML methodologies and tools across the organization. * Effectively utilize appropriate statistical, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning techniques to solve various business problems * Collaborate with various departments to identify opportunities for process improvement and developing analytics use\-cases. * Provide guidance, support and mentoring to junior team members. * Evaluate accuracy and quality of data sources, as well as the designed models * Stay up to date with the latest models and changes in technology * Design and develop (almost) production ready code. * Communicate results to colleagues and business partners. * Coordinate with application development teams to integrate developed models with existing applications. * Mentor and coach data scientists and machine learning engineers. **Education Required** ---------------------- * Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Statistics or related field, OR Bachelor’s degree with 7\+ years related machine learning experience. **Skills Required:** * 7\+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Research Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer or Computer Vision Scientist. * Demonstrated expertise in machine learning and/or deep learning methodologies, including model development, optimization, and deployment, utilizing algorithms, frameworks, and tools (e.g. XGBoost, LightGBM, Randon Forests, SVMs, clustering, dimensionality reduction, and neural networks). * Advanced Python expertise is required, with a strong focus on modeling, data analysis, and visualization. **Skills Preferred:** * Advanced degree, e.g., Ph.D. or M.S. in deep learning, neural networks, machine learning, data science, computer science, electrical engineering, engineering, statistics, engineering, industrial systems, mathematical sciences, applied mathematics, Physics or or related technology\-mathematics field. * 3\+ years of experience as a Data Scientist, Research Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or Operations Research. * Hands\-on and theoretical knowledge of various machine learning and deep learning algorithm and frameworks such as: xgboost/LightGBM, Random Forests, SVMs, PCA, t\-sne, kmeans, DBSCAN. * Knowledge of Spark (PySpark) is a plus * Knowledge of the cloud computing environment (e.g. Databricks) is a plus * Expertise with Time Series problems. * Familiarity with the railroad or transportation industry is a plus **Work Conditions** Environment: Hybrid 2 days on\-site and remote work 3 days per week. Shift Work: No On\-Call: No Weekend Work: No **Company Overview** Since 1827, Norfolk Southern Corporation (NYSE: NSC) and its predecessor companies have safely moved the goods and materials that drive the U.S. economy. Today, it operates a customer\-centric and operations\-driven freight transportation network. Committed to furthering sustainability, Norfolk Southern helps its customers avoid 15 million tons of yearly carbon emissions by shipping via rail. Its dedicated team members deliver more than 7 million carloads annually, from agriculture to consumer goods, and is the largest rail shipper of auto products and metals in North America. Norfolk Southern also has the most extensive intermodal network in the eastern U.S., serving a majority of the country’s population and manufacturing base, with connections to every major container port on the Atlantic coast as well as the Gulf of Mexico and Great Lakes. Learn more by visiting www.NorfolkSouthern.com. At Norfolk Southern, we believe in celebrating our individuality. By leveraging the unique backgrounds and viewpoints of our employees, we can create a culture of innovation, respect, and inclusion. We know that employees thrive in a workplace where differing viewpoints, ideas, and experiences are freely shared and valued. As such, we encourage all employees to contribute their distinctive skills and capabilities to our organization. **Equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetic information, veteran status, sexual orientation, and gender identity. Together, we power progress.** Apply now »

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Data Systems (Python)
jobs.description: ### **About Northbeam** Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions. We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey. We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. **About the Role** ------------------ **Northbeam is fundamentally a data product** \- the whole company. We don't sell shoes, ads, games, or database technologies. We sell data: quality integrations with a variety of platforms, fresh and reliable data pulls, correct aggregations, and algorithmic insights on top of that data, all packaged up in a user\-facing application. What this means is that out **data systems team** is foundational and load\-bearing. As a **data\-tilted software engineer** at Northbeam, you'll work alongside product managers, product engineers, and business leaders to turn customer needs into reliable data pipelines and products. You'll be supported by engineers who have built these systems before, with room to take on more ownership as you grow into the team. The work involves building, maintaining, and improving a labyrinth of integrations and transformations across a complex network of touchpoints. The system is powered by data spanning numerous ad platforms, a variety of order management systems (Shopify, Amazon, and others), and our own real\-time events collected as customers navigate their online stores. Curiosity, a bias toward shipping, and a real appetite for building data pipelines at scale are what matter most here. **Your Impact** --------------- This is a startup. The one thing that's constant is change. To start with, you can expect to: * Build and maintain data pipelines that ingest and transform data from a variety of sources, with an eye toward reliability and maintainability. * Develop and support APIs that enable secure, tenant\-aware data integrations with external systems. * Work within event\-driven and batch processing architectures to keep data fresh and consistent. * Contribute to API design and integration patterns that support both real\-time and batch ingestion across different authentication mechanisms (OAuth, API keys, etc.). * Add monitoring and alerting that surfaces data freshness issues, failures, and performance problems before customers notice them. * Improve existing data flows and transformations, weighing cost, efficiency, and speed of delivery in a cloud\-native environment. * Partner with data engineering, infrastructure, and product teams to make our integration platform easier to extend and onboard new sources into. You'll work with great people who have done this many times before. You'll teach them some new tricks, and pick up some old ones. If this sounds like your kind of chaos, we'd love to hear from you. ### **What You Bring** * 3\+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering, or integration engineering, with exposure to ETL, APIs, or data pipeline work. * Solid working proficiency in Python. * Experience building against REST APIs; familiarity with GraphQL or webhooks is a plus. * Comfort with SQL and some exposure to a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or similar). * Some exposure to orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, Dagster, or Prefect. * Willingness to work in a containerized environment (Docker). * A track record of shipping steadily and asking good questions when the path isn't obvious. ### **Bonus Skills \& Experience** * Experience implementing authentication flows (OAuth 2\.0, API keys, secrets management). * Familiarity with Kubernetes or other production deployment tooling. * Experience working with ERP systems, CRMs, CDPs, or other enterprise data tools and their APIs. * Exposure to event\-driven architectures and real\-time data processing tools. * Awareness of data governance and compliance considerations (GDPR, SOC 2\). * Experience in a multi\-tenant SaaS or data\-intensive environment. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (CloudNetwork)
jobs.description: **About Nu** ============ Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human\-centered services. Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability. Visit our Institutional Page ### **About the role** Every transaction at Nubank travels across a network before it reaches a customer. As we grow across countries, accounts, regions and hybrid environments, the connectivity layer underneath has to stay fast, segmented, auditable and cheap to run — while never becoming the thing that takes the platform down. As a Lead Software Engineer on a Cloud Network platform engineering team, you set and evolve the technical direction for how Nubank connects its cloud, hybrid and on\-premises environments. You own problems whose scope spreads across several teams and business units, and you are expected to bring structure to ambiguity rather than wait for it to be resolved for you. This is an IC6 role: you lead through technical depth, design authority and influence rather than direct reports. The goal you own is a cloud network platform that scales with the business, holds up under audit, and gets simpler over time instead of more complex. ### **You'll be responsible for** * Setting and evolving the technical direction of the cloud network platform owned by your team, aligning with Nubank's canonical approaches and contributing back to the broader technical community. * Leading high\-level and low\-level design for connectivity patterns across multi\-account, multi\-region, multi\-geo and hybrid\-cloud topologies, independently making sound architectural decisions in multi\-component, multi\-team designs. * Managing complex network projects and processes end to end — working independently, coordinating across subjects and stakeholders, and escalating for managerial support in a timely way rather than reactively. * Proactively reducing long\-term complexity through simplification, consolidation, deprecation and paved roads, explicitly balancing scalability, maintainability and cost, and considering both human and AI interaction with the platform. * Owning the operational health of the network platform in your team's scope: leading complex incident response (diagnosis, coordination, resolution), driving complex postmortems, and owning the short\- and long\-term tech debt strategy that comes out of them. * Promoting a culture of safe change — feature flags, gradual rollout, monitoring, fast rollback — applied to network changes, and driving simplification and cost optimization across the topology. * Setting and enforcing quality standards for the team's automation and infrastructure code: testing practices, code review bar, reusable modules, and anticipation of quality and maintainability needs coming from business strategy. * Defining observability for the platform — robust monitoring, controls and SLAs that surface issues proactively rather than after customer impact. * Bringing a strong end\-to\-end domain understanding: tracing a business process from product through the transactional path down to the network and data layers, and understanding how network design choices propagate through it. * Owning the network security posture of your scope, including PCI DSS or equivalent standards, segmentation, and controls that hold up under audit. * Evaluating buy vs. build options and new products and technologies, being data\-driven about stability, reliability, scalability and cost before committing to a solution. * Mentoring IC4/IC5 engineers on the broader system landscape, design reasoning and operational practice, and raising the bar of the people around you. * Participating in hiring as a core part of the role, contributing to function\-wide taskforces and initiatives, and documenting decisions so that knowledge travels across teams, not just within yours. ### **We are looking for a person who has** * CCIE, CCNP or equivalent experience — you are comfortable designing, building, implementing, maintaining and troubleshooting complex, large\-scale networking infrastructures. * Solid hands\-on experience in infrastructure automation and cloud computing (AWS preferred), with depth in AWS networking services — Transit Gateway, VPC design, Direct Connect, PrivateLink, Route 53, NAT/egress patterns, network firewalls — or similar technologies. * Deep experience planning, deploying and troubleshooting network solutions at scale: IP address management, BGP and dynamic routing, firewalls, load balancers, routers and switches, and hybrid connectivity. * Strong coding skills (python, .Net. Java, Go etc.) * Experience leading incident response and root cause analysis for high\-impact, ambiguous failures across team boundaries. * Strong leadership: you confidently lead complex projects that carry ambiguity and require strategic thinking, with or without formal authority. * Experienced communication: you convey complex technical messages clearly and persuasively to technical and non\-technical audiences, adjusting depth and examples to the room, and you facilitate productive discussion rather than just presenting. * Strategic acumen and long\-term perspective: you connect network platform decisions to business drivers such as operational efficiency, reliability and cost, link 6–12 month initiatives to the broader organizational strategy, and anticipate cross\-team impact and trade\-offs. * An analytical profile: you go after root causes and propose solutions that hold, working creatively and analytically in a continuous improvement environment. **Location for this opportunity (City, Country)** * Miami, United States * Washigton DC, United States * Durham, United States ### **Our Benefits** * Opportunity of earning equity at Nu * Medical Insurance * Dental and Vision Insurance * Life Insurance and AD\&D * Extended maternity and paternity leaves * Nucleo \- Our learning platform of courses * NuLanguage \- Our language learning program * NuCare \- Our mental health and wellness assistance program * 401K Saving Plans \- Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account * Work\-from\-home Allowance * Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable **Work Model for this Role** * **Hybrid 2\-3 times/week:** Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu\-hybrid\-work\-model/ Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers. To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

jobs.title: Senior Director, Enablement and Education Content Development
jobs.description: **Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.** **The Opportunity** ------------------- We build learning content in three places today, for three audiences, with three sets of practices. Nutanix is looking for a Head of Content Development to bring them together into one team, one craft, and one catalog. That catalog is genuinely complex. Technical courses and hands\-on labs for customers. Sales and partner programs. The assessments and lab\-based validations that show whether someone can actually do the thing. Job aids, reference material, playbooks, and the many useful things that are not courses at all. Different audiences, different formats, different shelf lives, one bar for quality. The hard part is not the merge on paper. It is working out honestly where these audiences are better served together and where they genuinely need specialization. One view of the catalog, one toolchain, and one set of standards will serve all of them. A customer learning a platform, a seller preparing for a conversation, and a partner engineer building a practice do not need the same things, and pretending otherwise produces content that suits nobody. Getting that judgment right is the job. The team is lean and will stay lean, which makes this a role about leverage rather than volume. The way we get more is by building better systems: a catalog people can navigate, a taxonomy that holds, processes that let subject matter experts and the field create and curate without waiting in a queue, and a toolchain that has moved on considerably in the last two years. We are already prototyping agentic authoring so a Nutanix expert can build a course without instructional design training. Where that goes next is substantially yours to decide, and the opportunity is to fundamentally change the pace, quality, and utility of enablement content for a wide range of users. **About the Team** ------------------ You'll join Customer Education and Revenue Enablement and report to the VP, whose remit spans enablement of sales, SE, and renewals, customer education, and partner enablement. You'll lead the consolidated content development function, with leads across the technical, sales and partner, and non\-course areas. You are a service to the rest of Enablement and Customer Education and a standard\-setter for it, and both halves matter. You work closely with Product Management and Product Marketing to have clear line\-of\-sight into what solutions and products are relevant to the various audiences. Global role\-based enablement, partner enablement, customer education, and the regional teams inform you on what the field needs and what must be assessed. You decide how it gets built, to what standard, and in what order, and you are the one who says when a request should not become a course at all. Three boundaries are worth knowing before you start. Technical certification sits with our Director of Certification, because an externally weighted credential carries requirements a content team should not be casually absorbing. You will work closely together and share a great deal of source material, but the certification is theirs. Credentialing is part of our Nexus community work and sits with that team. And our digital experience, internal tools, and AI platforms sit with another leader. You decide what the content and taxonomy need to be, and you'll work in step with them so it is executed well in the systems we actually run on. **Your Role** ------------- * **Bring three content practices into one.** Merge the sales, partner, and customer education development teams into a single function with shared standards, shared tooling, and a shared definition of done. Decide deliberately where consolidation genuinely helps and where an audience needs specialized treatment, and be able to explain the difference rather than defaulting to either. Design and execute on an effective and efficient organization structure and operating model. * **Own the catalog and the taxonomy behind it.** Know what exists, what it costs to maintain, what is current, what is used, and what should be retired. Own the taxonomy, tagging, metadata, and lifecycle model that make the catalog navigable by people and usable by the systems that surface it. This is the least visible work in the role and the work everything else depends on. * **Own coverage, in lockstep with the people who own need.** Work with role\-based enablement, delivery, partner enablement, customer education, and the regional leads to make sure the catalog covers what the business actually requires. Bring a point of view on the gaps rather than waiting for the requests, and be willing to say when a request is not the highest and best use of a lean team. * **Build the assessments.** Role\-based enablement and customer education define what must be assessed and to what standard. You build the instruments: knowledge checks, scenario assessments, and the hands\-on labs that demonstrate capability rather than recall. Own the abs, simulation, and AI\-assisted development are moving quickly. Know what is real, pilot deliberately, adopt what earns its place, and retire what does not. Work with the digital experience and AI function so what you choose fits the platforms we run on. Our agentic authoring work is live and needs an owner with a strong point of view. * **Get more from a lean team.** Prioritize ruthlessly, standardize what repeats, and reserve custom development for the work that genuinely warrants it. Be explicit about what you are not doing, so the answer is visible rather than silent. * **Lead and develop the team.** Bring together people who have worked to different standards, set one bar, and build the leads underneath you into owners of their areas. **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- * Deep experience leading **content or curriculum development at scale**, across more than one audience type, including technical content and hands\-on labs. * **Experience merging teams or practices**, and the people leadership that goes with a change nobody asked for. You will be combining three groups with different standards, different stakeholders, and different views on who was doing it right. * **Catalog and taxonomy discipline.** Tagging, metadata, versioning, currency, and retirement, run as an operating practice rather than an annual cleanup. This is the capability most often missing in otherwise strong candidates. * A record of getting more out of a small team through systems, standards, and prioritization rather than through heroics. * Assessment design experience, including performance\-based and lab\-based validation rather than knowledge checks alone. * Genuine currency with the modern content toolchain, including AI\-assisted authoring, and the judgment to tell a real capability from a demonstration. * Experience building contribution and governance models that let people outside the team create content without degrading the catalog. * The ability to say no well, to stakeholders who each believe their request is the priority, and to keep the relationship. * A combination of customer\-facing education experience; partner or channel content experience; localization at scale; experience working alongside a certification or credentialing function. * Willingness to travel internationally, approximately 25%. **Work Arrangement:** **Hybrid or Remote** This role can be remote or in a hybrid capacity. If remote, the role will require frequent travel to San Jose or Raleigh Durham. Should the role be within 50 miles of a Nutanix office, it will require coming into an office a minimum of 3 days per week. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.**Pay Transparency** The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $ and USD $ per annual. However, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors,including market location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a sign\-on bonus, restricted stock units, and discretionary awards in addition to a full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits (including 401(k) eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as vacation, sick time, and parental leave), depending on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at\-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base salary (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors. Our application deadline is 40 days from the date of posting. In good faith, the posting may be removed prior to this date if the position is filled or extended in good faith

jobs.title: Reporting Specialist - Power Start-Ups
jobs.description: **About Us** ============ At Onterris, we build careers grounded in purpose, responsibility and real\-world impact. “For Planet and Progress” is our north star that guides everything we do. We believe environmental responsibility and human progress are interconnected, interwoven and international. Our scientists, engineers, field teams, consultants and professionals collaborate across disciplines and geographies, guiding industries and governments, ensuring that communities and environments thrive. When you join us, you’re not just forging a career, you’re joining a movement. A movement for better thinking, smarter solutions and lasting impact. Together, we will advance our way of life and protect the integrity of our environment every step of the way. **A Day in the Life** ===================== As a **Reporting QC Specialist III,** you’ll be responsible for accurately calculating and validating stack testing results using spreadsheets and handwritten field records. A successful Reporting QC Specialist III independently completes stack testing calculations while ensuring data quality and compliance with established standards. The compensation range for this role is $28\.00 to $34\.00 per hour. To thrive in this role, you’ll be comfortable taking ownership of the following responsibilities: * Writing and assembling documents such as test protocols or test reports using templates, following style guides and SOPs * Citing tolerances for these, e.g. 3A, 7E, 10, RA% using reference methods and applicable standards * Understanding roles and responsibilities within the Quality Management System and third\-party accreditation standards * Perform technical editorial review of draft and final documents for details, grammar, spelling, calculations, results, and conclusions * Reporting QC Specialists III are successful at “from scratch reporting” of stack testing programs, and they are knowledgeable about regional tests and regulations * Can independently resolve most anomalies and when encountering new tests, methods, etc. can extrapolate based on previous similar experience * Preparing ERT without an ERT test plan or reference document * Calculating test results using spreadsheets and handwritten forms * Review work of and mentor junior staff * Performing various clerical work where needed * Contribute ideas to the reporting group (RMS/PIP) and support work groups that develop content, standard procedures, and other improvement measures **Your Expertise and Skills** ============================= These requirements reflect the knowledge, skills and abilities that help you do your best work here. * Ability to work independently and with minimal supervision * Bachelor's degree in science/engineering or related field preferred. High School diploma is acceptable where writing/math/other skills can be demonstrated * Ability to identify and investigate anomalies in data, such as inconsistent or suspect results, outlying run results, suspect handwritten data, etc., and escalate to other specialists or managers where necessary * 3\+ years technical writing experience * 3\+ years of experience with air test methods, permits, and regulatory requirements * Field testing experience is beneficial * Intermediate user of cloud\-based platforms (ex. Google Workspace), Microsoft Office Suite products (Excel \& Word), and PDF editing software * Capability to pass background checks and initial and random drug screening **Work Environment and Physical Requirements** ============================================== The physical and environmental requirements below reflect what’s typically needed to perform the essential functions of this role safely and effectively. We may provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, consistent with applicable law, to support performance of the essential functions. * Sitting, standing, and walking * Must be able to exert moderate physical effort, including lifting materials up to 20 pounds Onterris is a leading global environmental solutions company partnering with organizations to solve complex challenges where environmental pressures, regulatory expectations and operational risks intersect. Guided by our mission to advance the way of life without compromising the integrity of our environment, we believe environmental responsibility and human progress are fundamentally connected. Our scientists, engineers, field teams and consultants apply systems thinking that unites science, data and practical expertise to deliver solutions that strengthen our clients’ resilience, mitigate risk and protect the air, water and soil that sustain communities, while uncovering responsible paths forward for planet and progress. For more information, visit www.onterris.com . We are an equal opportunity employer and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We acknowledge that these experiences and perspectives help to enrich our teams and contribute to our ongoing success. We are committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation in our employment for all applicants. For US residents, click here to learn more.

Join us to be part of a forward\-thinking team where your skills will shape innovative solutions! We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment that encourages growth and creativity in software engineering—making a real impact through technology every day! Pay: $120,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Graduate Engineer - Construction Engineering
jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Construction Management \& Inspection Division is seeking a motivated **Entry\-Level Graduate Engineer** to join our growing team. This hybrid position combines office\-based engineering support with hands\-on field experience on transportation, utility, infrastructure, and site development projects. Under the guidance of senior engineers, project managers, and construction inspectors, the Graduate Engineer will assist with construction management, construction inspection, contract administration, project documentation, quantity verification, quality assurance, and coordination activities. This role provides an excellent opportunity for recent graduates to develop practical engineering skills while gaining exposure to all phases of construction delivery. **Essential Responsibilities** **Field Responsibilities** * Assist with inspection of construction activities to verify compliance with plans, specifications, permits, and contract requirements. * Observe and document contractor operations, work progress, and site conditions. * Perform quantity measurements and assist with verification of contractor payment quantities. * Monitor construction materials, workmanship, and installation practices. * Coordinate and document material testing and quality control activities. * Prepare daily inspection reports, field notes, photographs, and project records. * Assist with monitoring traffic control, maintenance of traffic, erosion and sediment control, and job\-site safety practices. * Attend project meetings and communicate project issues to senior staff. * Support project closeout activities, punch list inspections, and as\-built documentation. **Office Responsibilities** * Review construction plans, specifications, shop drawings, and submittals. * Prepare reports, spreadsheets, estimates, and project correspondence. * Maintain electronic project files and construction documentation systems. * Assist with schedule tracking, quantity reconciliation, and project record management. * Support project managers and resident engineers with administrative and technical tasks. * Compile field data and assist in preparation of project status reports. * Coordinate with clients, contractors, utility companies, and regulatory agencies as required. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor of Science degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Engineering, Construction Management, or a related engineering discipline. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and construction documents. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment. * Willingness to travel to project sites and work outdoors in varying weather conditions. * Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record. **Preferred Qualifications** * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification or ability to obtain within one year. * Internship or co\-op experience in construction, transportation, or civil engineering. * Familiarity with construction management software such as Procore, Primavera, or similar platforms. * Experience with CAD, GIS, or related engineering software. * OSHA 10\-Hour Construction Safety certification. **Physical Requirements** * Ability to walk uneven terrain, climb stairs, and navigate active construction sites. * Ability to occasionally lift up to 50 pounds. * Ability to work outdoors for extended periods in varying weather conditions. **Work Environment:** This position follows a hybrid work model consisting of both office and project\-site assignments. The majority of time will be spent supporting active construction projects in the field while completing documentation, reporting, and project coordination tasks from the office or remote work environment. **Expected Travel:** Local and regional travel to project sites as required. (Greater Baltimore Area) **TARGET SALARY RANGE**: $31\.50 \- $35\.00 (per hour) Contributing to the health and well\-being of team members is a top priority for Pennoni; therefore, we designed our benefits package to exceed industry norms while providing our team members with exceptionally competitive and comprehensive benefits. Founded more than five decades ago, Pennoni is an ENR Top 500 consulting engineering firm where individuality sparks innovation and growth. We're all about helping you build your career while fostering a great workplace culture – here, you'll work with supportive, talented teammates and find pride in your contributions. Join us to be part of a team that values your unique skills and drives excellence in every project! Equal Opportunity Employer / Veterans / Disabled

jobs.title: Senior Desiign Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title** Automation Design Engineer – Automotive Welding **Job Summary** You will design, develop, and test automated welding systems and robotic tooling for automotive manufacturing. Your work includes creating 3D models, selecting automation equipment, and ensuring designs meet safety and customer standards. **Key Responsibilities** * **Design Systems:** Create 3D models and 2D manufacturing drawings for robotic welding cells, end\-of\-arm tooling, and assembly fixtures using CAD software like SolidWorks or AutoCAD. * **Integrate Robotics:** Select and integrate industrial robots, welding guns (MIG, TIG, Resistance/Spot), sensors, and safety hardware. * **Collaborate:** Work with project managers, controls engineers, and the shop floor to ensure designs are practical and buildable. * **Review Safety:** Ensure all mechanical and automation designs follow OSHA, RIA, and customer\-specific safety standards. * **Support Build \& Launch:** Assist with assembly troubleshooting, robot path simulations, and final buy\-off at customer sites if needed. **Qualifications \& Skills** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * **Experience:** 3 to 5 years of experience in automation design, specifically within the automotive or tier\-1 welding supplier industry. * **Software Skills:** Proficiency in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks, CATIA, or Inventor) and robotic simulation tools (Robcad or Process Simulate). * **Knowledge Base:** Strong understanding of resistance spot welding, MIG welding, pneumatic components, and geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD\&T). **Job Title:** Process Automation Design Engineer – Automotive Welding Systems **Department:** Process Engineering / Automation **Reports To:** Engineering Manager **Position Summary:** The Process Automation Design Engineer is responsible for designing, simulating, and optimizing complete automated welding manufacturing lines. This role focuses on the macro\-level process layout, material flow, cycle\-time (thru\-put) analysis, and the high\-level integration of FANUC robotic arms into coherent production cells. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Process \& Layout Design:** Develop 2D/3D manufacturing line layouts, sequence of operations, and process flow diagrams for robotic MIG, spot, and laser welding cells. * **FANUC Robot Simulation:** Utilize simulation software (such as FANUC ROBOGUIDE or Process Simulate) to perform reach studies, interference checks, and cycle time analysis. * **System Integration:** Define the interaction between FANUC robots, material handling systems, safety gating, and PLC\-controlled equipment. * **Cycle Time Optimization:** Analyze and optimize robot paths and process steps to meet strict automotive customer throughput requirements. * **Specifications \& Standards:** Ensure all process designs comply with automotive OEM specifications (e.g., Ford, GM, Stellantis) and safety standards (RIA/OSHA). * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Tooling Design Engineers to align fixture placement with robot access paths and process constraints. **Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, or Automation Engineering. * **Experience:** 3\+ years in automotive process automation design, focusing on robotic welding lines. * **Technical Skills:** High proficiency in FANUC ROBOGUIDE, AutoCAD, and 3D CAD platforms. Deep knowledge of MIG/MAG and resistance spot welding parameters. * **Knowledge:** Strong understanding of automotive assembly line routing, safety circuits, and line balancing. **Job Title:** Tooling Automation Design Engineer – Welding \& FANUC **Department:** Mechanical Design / Tooling **Reports To:** Tooling Engineering Supervisor **Position Summary:** The Tooling Automation Design Engineer is responsible for the mechanical design of welding fixtures, clamping systems, and specialized End\-of\-Arm Tooling (EOAT) for FANUC robots. This role ensures parts are held precisely to meet tight tolerances during high\-stress robotic welding applications. **Key Responsibilities:** * **Fixture \& Tooling Design:** Design 3D geometric welding fixtures, manual/pneumatic clamping systems, and heavy\-duty robotic EOAT using SolidWorks, CATIA, or NX. * **FANUC Payload \& Center of Gravity (CG) Analysis:** Calculate load capacities, moments of inertia, and CG for EOAT to ensure compliance with specific FANUC robot payload profiles. * **Component Selection:** Specify standard automation components including pneumatic cylinders, toggle clamps, proximity sensors, grippers, and slide units. * **GD\&T Application:** Apply strict Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD\&T) to fabrication prints to ensure part repeatability and quality. * **Welding Environment Design:** Material selection and shielding design to withstand weld spatter, high heat, and harsh production environments. * **Build Support:** Support the toolroom build, assembly, shim\-tuning, and try\-out phases of fixtures and EOAT. **Qualifications:** * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Tool \& Die Design, or equivalent trade experience. * **Experience:** 3\+ years designing physical tooling, fixtures, and robotic grippers for automotive body\-in\-white (BIW) welding applications. * **Technical Skills:** Advanced 3D CAD modeling skills (SolidWorks preferred); strong knowledge of pneumatics and fluid power schematics. * **Knowledge:** Deep understanding of FANUC robot mechanical mounting interfaces and payload constraints.

jobs.title: Facilities Engineer
jobs.description: **Facilities Engineer** **Make an Impact You Can See** Polysciences, Inc. is a specialty chemical manufacturer headquartered in Warrington, Pennsylvania. Since 1961, we have developed and manufactured specialty chemicals and advanced materials used in life sciences, diagnostics, medical devices, electronics, research, and other demanding applications. Our Pennsylvania operations include five facilities supporting manufacturing, laboratories, warehousing, packaging, and technical operations. We're looking for a Facilities Engineer to take ownership of facility infrastructure and CAPEX projects ranging from approximately $50,000 to $5 million. You'll identify needs, engineer solutions, select contractors and vendors, and lead projects from concept through construction and commissioning. Projects range from upgrading critical utilities and aging infrastructure to building new laboratories and supporting manufacturing expansion. It's a hands\-on role with significant autonomy, technical variety, and visible results. **What You'll Do** **Capital Projects \& Engineering** * Lead facility and infrastructure CAPEX projects from $50K to $5MM through scope, design, budgeting, bidding, construction, commissioning, and closeout. * Develop project scopes, budgets, schedules, bid packages, and technical requirements. * Solicit and evaluate proposals; select and manage contractors, vendors, and external engineering resources. * Manage multiple projects, including schedules, budgets, risks, scope changes, and deliverables. * Recommend capital investments to address infrastructure needs, capacity constraints, reliability, and facility improvements. * Coordinate projects and shutdown requirements to minimize disruption to manufacturing and laboratory operations. * Provide management with clear project, budget, schedule, and risk updates. **Facilities, Utilities \& Infrastructure** * Provide engineering support for HVAC, electrical distribution, plumbing, compressed air, ventilation/exhaust, building controls, fire protection, and other industrial utilities and infrastructure. * Support manufacturing areas, laboratories, and technical spaces, including integration of new equipment and facility systems. * Troubleshoot facility and utility issues, perform root cause analysis, and develop solutions that improve safety, reliability, capacity, and efficiency. * Identify aging, obsolete, or capacity\-constrained infrastructure and recommend repair, replacement, or capital improvements. * Ensure projects address chemical hazards, OSHA requirements, building/fire codes, permitting, EHS and Quality requirements, and site procedures. * Participate in Management of Change (MOC), project risk assessments, safety reviews, and change\-control processes. * Provide technical oversight of contractors and maintain appropriate engineering drawings, specifications, and system documentation. **What You'll Bring** **Required** * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil, or related Engineering discipline. * Experience managing facility, infrastructure, and CAPEX projects in an operating manufacturing environment. * Experience in chemical manufacturing or another industrial environment involving chemical processes, chemical hazards, and comparable facility/EHS requirements. * Ability to manage capital projects from scope and budgeting through contractor selection, construction, commissioning, and closeout. * Experience developing scopes, budgets, schedules, technical specifications, and bid packages. * Knowledge of industrial facility systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, compressed air, ventilation/exhaust, controls, fire protection, and utilities. * Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, construction documents, and facility layouts. * Working knowledge of OSHA requirements, building codes, permitting, and industrial construction safety. * Strong project management, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and practical problem\-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Facilities, EHS, Quality, contractors, and vendors. * Ability to work onsite and travel between company facilities in Warrington and Horsham, PA, with occasional planned off\-hours or emergency support. **Preferred** * Direct experience in chemical, specialty chemical, pharmaceutical, life science, or other chemical\-intensive manufacturing. * Laboratory construction, renovation, or infrastructure project experience. * Experience with MOC or comparable engineering change\-control processes. * SAP/ERP, CMMS, CAD, or building automation system experience. * PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, OSHA 30, or PE credentials. **Why Polysciences?** This isn't a role where you'll simply process work orders or coordinate contractors. jobs.title: Project Cost Engineer
jobs.description: At PGE, our work involves dreaming about, planning for, and realizing a smarter, cleaner, more enduring Oregon neighborhood. Its core to our DNA and we haven’t stopped since we started in 1888\. We energize lives, strengthen communities and drive advancements in energy that promote social, economic and environmental progress. We’re always on the lookout for people passionate about leading and being a part of teams that are advancing innovative clean energy solutions that are also affordable and accessible to all. SUMMARY As a Project Cost Engineer at Portland General Electric (PGE), you will play a crucial role in supporting capital construction projects with a strong emphasis on budgeting, forecasting and cost control. Key Responsibilities: * P2 \- Intermediate: This level requires expanded professional\-level knowledge and experience in the employee’s own area, with incumbents continuing to acquire higher\-level knowledge and skills. Employees at this level expand their high\-level knowledge of the company, processes and customers; solve a range of complex problems; analyze possible solutions using advanced knowledge and established protocols; and operate independently with only a moderate level of guidance and direction. * P3 \- Career: This level requires in\-depth knowledge and experience, applying best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to improve products or services. Employees at this level solve complex problems by taking a new perspective using existing solutions; work independently with minimal guidance; and act as a resource for colleagues with less experience. We are excited for someone who enjoys working with capital construction projects and is passionate about meeting PGE's goals for clean energy and reliable service. Join our Generation, Transmission and Distribution Project Management Organization team and play a vital role in shaping the future of energy in Oregon! *We have 1 position available at either a p2 or p3 level. See determining levels below.* Your Role: P2 \- Associate Project Cost Engineer * Project Planning: Provides project controls for multiple small\- to medium\- sized generation, transmission and distribution projects and programs; OR, supports assigned elements or phases of large capital construction projects. Analyzes project needs and determines the appropriate project cost controls that will help ensure stakeholder and regulatory compliance and meet financial goals; assists with preparations needed to gain project authorizations and support requests from various areas, including but not limited to System Planning, Corporate Planning, Substation Operations, Distribution Engineering, Transmission Engineering and large projects, PSES and other company entities. * Project Cost Engineering: Maintains project budgets, cost baselines, and funding forecasts for multiple small to medium sized projects and programs. Tracks project costs against budgets and cash flow schedules. Prepares monthly cost forecasts and variance reports. Identifies cost risks and mitigation strategies early. Assesses cost impacts to schedule and scope changes. Prepares cost reports for project teams, leadership, and regulatory stakeholders. Maintains change log and decisions affecting forecasts and budgets. * Process Analysis and Improvement: Contributes to teams in the analysis of business processes, resource requirements and work efficiency; develops processes, analyzes throughput and refines and streamlines processes; recommends improvements; translates processes into quantitative metrics/KPIs for measuring and reporting on project performance. * Metrics: Recommends or develops project metrics or operational performance metrics to report on project performance. Reports on progress to financial metrics. * Project Controls: Implements project controls to help ensure cost control, regulatory, reporting and other project requirements are met. Updates forecasts in systems as appropriate. * Monitoring: Monitors project during all or assigned phases to identify real or potential deviations to project plans; identifies changes to project due to scope creep, and/or material changes and internal/external resourcing and determines impacts to project success. Communicates variances and works with project manager (PM) to obtain appropriate level change approval as required. * Project Reporting and Documentation: Works with PM to ensure coordination of efforts to issue timely, accurate project reports on project costs, problems, risks and other significant issues; provides information, reports and presentations to key stakeholders and other company entities. * Database Administration: Administers applicable project management computer systems; manages updates of project documentation; archives project documentation in accordance with records management requirements. * Coordination and Communication: Communicates with stakeholders to coordinate tasks and provide updates. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Promise modernizes how government agencies and utilities support people in financial difficulty. We build technology that makes it simple for residents to receive benefits, engage with assistance programs, set up flexible payment plans, and stay on track—while helping agencies increase efficiency, recover revenue, and deliver services with dignity. Our mission is to transform public systems so they work better for everyone, especially the most vulnerable. Our team includes experts from companies like Palantir, Google, Stripe , and esteemed government leaders. We work hard and believe deeply in what we do. We're looking for excellent people to build innovative, resilient technology. Backed by over $50 million in funding from top investors – such as Reid Hoffman, Howard Schultz, Michael Seibel, Y Combinator, 8VC, The General Partnership, First Round Capital, Kapor Capital, XYZ Ventures, and Bronze Investments – Promise has been recognized as one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies of 2022,” “Forbes Next Billion\-Dollar Startups 2024,” and Y Combinator’s \#1 GovTech startup. **About the Role** ================== As a **Deployment Strategist at Promise**, you’ll be on the front lines of impact—owning outcomes, not tasks. You’ll work hand\-in\-hand with government and utility partners to deeply understand their operations, pain points, and goals—then translate those insights into real, scalable solutions that drive measurable results. This is not a passive customer success role. You’ll **build**, **problem\-solve**, and **strategize** to ensure every deployment delivers lasting value—to our customers, their constituents, and Promise’s bottom line. You’ll push projects from launch to long\-term growth, always focused on outcomes that matter: adoption, efficiency, revenue impact, and customer success. If you love digging into complexity, building strong and lasting customer relationships, and delivering time\-critical solutions to meaningful real world problems, this may be the role for you. **What You’ll Do** ================== * **Build real solutions:** Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to design and deliver systems that integrate seamlessly into customer workflows and drive measurable impact. * **Own outcomes:** Take full accountability for the success of each customer—from implementation to renewal, expansion, and long\-term value creation. * **Understand customers deeply:** Get into the weeds of customer operations, data, and challenges until you can articulate their business better than they can. * **Provide a world\-class experience:** Ensure that every customer touchpoint is high\-quality, high\-substance, and unforgettable. Our customers should feel lucky to work with us. * **Drive value and growth:** Translate understanding into action plans that boost adoption, revenue, and efficiency—ensuring Promise becomes an indispensable partner. * **Turn insight into innovation:** Surface what’s working (and what’s not) from the field to influence product direction and future investments. * **Build authentic trust:** Build strong relationships across all levels—from line staff to senior executives—by showing up in a high\-quality way and delivering highly effective, innovative solutions. * **Get onsite**: Nothing builds credibility and trust like spending in\-person time with the customer, this role is approximately 40% travel. **What Will Help You Succeed** ============================== * **Experience:** 3\+ years in roles driving real outcomes—consulting, strategy, implementation, or customer success—ideally in govtech. * **Builder’s mindset:** You thrive in ambiguity, move fast, and care about building systems that *actually work* in the real world. * **Customer obsession:** You go beyond surface needs to understand the “why” behind every request and solve for long\-term success. * **Analytical horsepower:** You’re fluent in data, financial models, and metrics that define success—and you use them to guide decision\-making. * **Eye for growth:** You recognize opportunities for upsell, renewal, and expansion while strengthening customer trust and alignment. * **Cross\-functional collaboration:** You know how to turn insights from the field into product innovation by working shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineers, PMs, and designers. * **Flexibility \& grit:** You’re energized by being close to the customer, field work, and the challenges of solving gnarly problems at scale. **Who Thrives At Promise** ========================== ### **You’ll love it here if:** * You are energized by **big, complex challenges** and the opportunity to solve them. * You want your work to have a real**, measurable impact** on people’s lives. * You **take ownership** and run toward problems, not away from them. * You value **clear, candid, and constructive communication.** ### **Promise is not for you if:** * You prefer **hierarchy and rigid structures.** We operate with **freedom and responsibility.** * You are **uncomfortable with change.** We move fast, adapt often, and expect agility. * You want a **typical corporate culture.** We are mission\-driven, ambitious, and direct. * You believe **efficiency means “doing less.”** We believe **efficiency means doing better.** **How We Enable Our People** ============================ * 100% paid health coverage * Flexible\-time\-off (take what you need) and sick leave * Lunch, snacks, and coffee provided in office * Company retreats * Opportunities to travel and see the impact of your work directly * Hybrid work: we deeply value in\-person collaboration and are in\-office at least 4 days a week, but are flexible on what people need Promise is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant or employee because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, age, or military or veteran status. Additionally, the Company complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every jurisdiction in which it operates. Promise is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We also provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, pregnant individuals, and those with sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable laws. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@joinpromise.com. Promise engages in US government contracts and restricts hiring to US persons, which includes US citizens and permanent residents (e.g., Green Card holders). Additionally, candidates must reside in the US. Promise participates in E\-Verify. To learn more, view E\-Verify Participation Notice and Right to Work Notice. Compensation Range: $150K \- $210K

analysis. * Work closely with IC design teams to translate system\-level and product requirements into internal IC and subsystem specifications for new products. * Work with the packaging team to application and system\-level issues, identifying product limitations, and incorporating customer learnings into future product improvements and new product definitions. * Coach and mentor other systems and application engineers. **Required Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline * 12\+ years of relevant industry experience or an equivalent amount of education and experience * Demonstrated product definition and customer engagement experience with a track record of translating customer and market requirements into product architecture, features, and specifications. * Experience with power IC packaging technologies, including package concept development, pinout definition, and electrical and thermal considerations. * Hands\-on experience with package laminate/substrate design, including layer stack\-up, routing, and electrical and thermal considerations. * Demonstrated experience developing technical documentation for semiconductor products, including datasheets, user guides, and application notes. * Hands\-on experience with BLDC/PMSM motor drive systems for industrial, automotive, and consumer applications. * Experience with DC/DC and AC/DC power supply design. * Deep understanding of gate drivers, inverter power\-stage operation, and associated protection functions. * Familiarity with field\-oriented control and trapezoidal control algorithms for BLDC/PMSM motors. * Experience with microcontrollers, especially Arm Cortex\-M devices, including ADCs, PWM timers, PLL and clocking, Flash, and communication interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, CAN and LIN. * Experience with PCB design and layout, CAD tools such as AutoCAD, and circuit/system simulation tools such as MATLAB and QSPICE. * Strong attention to detail, analytical thinking, and system\-level troubleshooting skills. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to audiences with varying levels of technical expertise. * Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally to engage with customers. \#LI\-NN1 MAKE A DIFFERENCE AT QORVO We are Qorvo. We do more than create innovative RF and Power solutions for the mobile, defense and infrastructure markets – we are a place to innovate and shape the future of wireless communications. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, ChartCheck
jobs.description: ### **About Radformation** Radformation specializes in Radiation Oncology workflow automation. Our solutions save clinics time, eliminate planning errors, and enable the design of optimal treatments for patients. Our software focuses on three key areas: * Time savings through automation * Error reduction through automated systems * Increased quality care through advanced algorithms and workflows We are a fully remote, mission\-driven team united by a shared goal: to reduce cancer’s global impact and help save more of the 10 million lives it claims each year. Every line of code, every product release, and every conversation with our customers brings us closer to ensuring no patient’s treatment quality depends on where they live. ### **Why this role matters** Radformation is seeking a self\-motivated Senior Software Engineer to join our innovative and fast moving team. This role is ideal for someone who wishes to use their coding skills to improve cancer care throughout the world. You will work within Radformation’s fully remote teams to develop software for clinics. The Senior Software Engineer is responsible for all aspects of coding and software development for our ChartCheck application, both the front end and back end. For this position we prefer candidates with a wide range of expertise across the web / cloud spectrum of technologies and are looking for an engineer with strong C\# application programming skills to complement their web skills. ChartCheck is developed in C\# and JavaScript so skills there are necessary. Your software development and leadership skills will play an integral role as we design new products for cancer centers. ### **Responsibilities Include:** * Design, develop, and maintain features supporting radiotherapy plan checking workflows: DICOM integration, image visualization, dose visualization, plan visualization, DVH evaluation, and creating plan checks. * Develop performant, reliable WPF desktop software. * Integrate with oncology information systems via DICOM networking and related clinical interfaces * Collaborate with physicists and product leaders to translate clinical requirements into production software * Contribute to architecture, testing, code reviews, and technical decision\-making * Support teammates through collaboration, mentorship, and knowledge sharing ### **Required Experience:** * BS in CS or related field and at least 5 years experience, MS preferred. * Deep programming expertise in a high level programming language, C\#, C\+\+. or Java. * Full Stack developer capable of frontend and backend development in web and cloud systems. * Database experience, Mongo, MS SQL or PostGreSQL. * C\# .NET,HTML, CSS, Javascript, Lit (or equivalent technologies) * Looking for a developer who prefers front\-end programming over backend. * WPF / C\#.NET experience. * Clinical radiotherapy / imaging programming experience with DICOM. * Experience programming over backend. * WPF / C\#.NET experience. * Clinical radiotherapy / imaging programming experience with DICOM. * Experience with HIPAA and Medical Device regulations in software jobs.title: Architectural Designer
jobs.description: Company Description Rapid Permits and Engineering is a premier permitting and engineering firm located in Marathon, Florida, serving clients throughout the Florida Keys. Building on our strong foundation in marine construction engineering, we are expanding our services into custom residential design, additions, and coastal engineering. We specialize in navigating complex local regulatory environments and providing streamlined, code\-compliant solutions to help homeowners and builders bring their projects from concept to permit. Role Overview We are seeking a detail\-oriented **Architectural Designer** to lead drafting operations for our growing residential home design and engineering division in Marathon, FL. In this role, you will work closely with our professional engineers (PEs), permit specialists, and clients to produce complete, permit\-ready residential construction plan sets. The ideal candidate possesses deep working knowledge of Florida construction standards, Monroe County / City of Marathon land development regulations, and coastal building codes. You will be responsible for producing high\-quality architectural, elevation, floor, and structural drafting sets engineered and formatted specifically for PE review, seal, and municipal permit submittal. Key Responsibilities * **Plan Production:** Prepare detailed, high\-quality architectural working drawings and construction documents for new custom single\-family homes, residential additions, remodels, and accessory structures. * **Engineering Pre\-Coordination:** Draft comprehensive plan sets—including foundation layouts, floor plans, exterior elevations, building sections, roof framing, and structural connection details—designed directly to meet Florida engineer\-stamping standards. * **Building Code Compliance:** Incorporate structural, wind\-load, high\-velocity hurricane zone (HVHZ), flood elevation (FEMA/FBC), and energy code considerations directly into CAD deliverables. * **Site \& Zoning Plan Development:** Coordinate site plans with local setback requirements, coastal construction control lines (CCCL), and Monroe County/City of Marathon zoning parameters. * **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Collaborate directly with in\-house Professional Engineers (PE) to revise details, adjust structural calculations, and apply feedback quickly for final stamping. * **Field Verification:** Conduct periodic site visits throughout the Middle and Lower Keys to perform field measurements, document existing conditions, and verify layout accuracy. * **Permit Set Revisions:** Track and execute municipal plan review comments from city/county building departments to ensure prompt permit approvals. Qualifications \& Requirements * **Drafting Expertise:** 3\+ years of experience in residential drafting and plan preparation, with a portfolio of complete residential plan sets. * **Software Proficiency:** Expert knowledge of AutoCAD, Revit, or equivalent 2D/3D BIM drafting software. * **Code Knowledge:** Strong understanding of the Florida Building Code (FBC), residential design standards, coastal flood zone regulations (FEMA), and Florida high\-wind / hurricane resistant detailing. * **Engineer\-Ready Standards:** Experience producing plans formatted specifically for engineering review, structural overlays, and PE seal/signature. * **Education:** Associate degree, Technical Certification in Drafting/CAD, or Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or Building Construction (equivalent professional experience accepted). * **Communication \& Detail:** High attention to structural detail, layout precision, and strong communication skills for working with engineers, contractors, and local planning officials. Preferred Experience * Direct experience drafting residential projects in Monroe County or coastal Florida environments. * Familiarity with elevated construction on pilings/stilt foundations, concrete masonry unit (CMU) design, and tie\-beam detailing. * Experience with 3D renderings or client visual presentations (SketchUp, Lumion, Enscape). All Applications must be sent directly to ashton@rapidpermitting.com with the subject line "**Architectural Designer** **09/2026".** Pay: $30,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Marathon, FL 33050
